info.title: Iraq's Bloody Toll
info.description: This infographic visualizes the casualties and key events of the Iraq War from 2003 to 2011, including coalition and civilian deaths, US troop deployments, and the types of attacks causing the most fatalities. It shows the impact of the war on both coalition forces and Iraqi civilians, providing a statistical and chronological overview of the conflict.

info.title: Male and Female Virgins on a College Campus
info.description: This infographic illustrates the changing percentages of male and female virgins on a college campus from 1963 to 1984. It uses a line graph with two lines, one for males (blue) and one for females (red), to depict the trend over time. The infographic also incorporates playful illustrations of a male and female figure.

info.title: Snapshot of USA Today Readers
info.description: This infographic illustrates the number of readers of USA Today in 1983 and mid-1985, with a goal established in 1983 to reach 2.15 million readers by 1987. It is presented as a time chart within a drawing of a person reading the newspaper.

info.title: Fewer Households Have Middle Class Incomes
info.description: This infographic presents a table showing the percentage of households in different income brackets for the years 1967 and 2009, along with the percentage change between those years. It visually represents the squeezing of the middle class through the metaphor of a wrench tightening around a figure.

info.title: The Squeeze: A WWII Map of the Pacific Theater
info.description: This infographic, published in TIME magazine on July 3, 1944, depicts the Allied forces' strategic squeeze on Japanese-held territories in the Pacific Theater during World War II. The map shows the geographical areas involved, the positioning of Allied forces under commanders like Stilwell, Nimitz, and MacArthur, and key locations like Formosa, Hong Kong, and Saipan. The clamp graphic visually represents the tightening pressure on Japan.

info.title: OPEC's International Current-Account Balance (1976-1982)
info.description: This infographic depicts OPEC's international current-account balance in billions of dollars from 1976 to 1982. The visualization features a stylized illustration of a person with an oil barrel, with data points overlaid to show the fluctuating balance over the years. The data points are connected by a line, indicating a trend.

info.title: Facing Up to Inflation: Components of CPI Increase
info.description: An infographic showing the percentage increase in various components of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) from January 1979 to January 1980. The visualization uses stacked arrows to represent the magnitude of inflation in different categories such as gasoline, energy, mortgages, public transportation, medical care, food, and clothing.

info.title: New York City Job Loss Projections into 2009
info.description: This infographic visualizes the job loss projections in New York City into 2009 from the peaks in 2007 or 2008 across various sectors, including the private sector, financial services, professional and business services, information services, and construction. It shows the number of job losses and the percentage decline in each sector.

info.title: Fluid Retention: Per capita consumption of soda vs bottled water
info.description: This infographic visually represents the per capita consumption of soda and bottled water from 1970 to 1995. It uses a line graph to illustrate the trends over time, with the figure of an overweight person filled with water to emphasize fluid retention.

info.title: The Pinch on Paychecks: Per capita disposable income in 1972 dollars, at annual rates
info.description: This infographic, titled "The Pinch on Paychecks", uses a line chart to illustrate the trend of per capita disposable income in 1972 dollars at annual rates from 1977 to 1979. The line chart is creatively integrated with a cartoon drawing of a man whose body is formed by the chart's grid. The red line represents the income trend, and the man's posture and expression convey a sense of financial strain or worry.

info.title: 2020: Education Funding in Romania
info.description: The infographic visualizes the distribution of education funding in Romania for the year 2020. It shows the allocation of funds across different educational sectors (e.g., environmental education, STEM education), and the involved funding organizations. It also shows a comparison between the number of fundings for the year 2019.

info.title: The Spreading of #MeToo Movement
info.description: This infographic visualizes the geographical spread and linguistic diversity of the #MeToo movement on Twitter, highlighting the countries and languages where the hashtag was most frequently used.

info.title: MeToo Movement Trending on Twitter
info.description: An infographic visualizing the trending of the MeToo movement on Twitter from October 2017 to March 2018. It displays the activity of tweets containing the #MeToo hashtag, positioning tweets relative to their date, showing the number of retweets through distance from the center, and follower count with the size of the 'dandelion seed' representing each tweet. It also highlights key moments and influential tweeters.

info.title: Monstrous Costs: House and Senate Campaign Expenditures
info.description: This infographic illustrates the escalating costs of House and Senate campaigns, using a monster metaphor to visually represent the increasing expenditures. The monster's mouth is shaped to represent a bar chart, with each tooth representing the campaign expenditure in millions for a specific year. The illustration aims to highlight the dramatic increase in campaign spending over time.

info.title: Diamonds Were a Girl's Best Friend: Average price of a one-carat D-flawless
info.description: This infographic depicts the average price of a one-carat D-flawless diamond from 1978 to 1982 using a line chart creatively integrated with an illustration of a woman.

info.title: Urban Residences Connected to Safe and Potable Water Sources
info.description: The infographic visualizes data related to urban residences connected to safe and potable water sources, comparing percentages and renewable water resources across different countries. The infographic aims to highlight the importance of water conservation and the issues of water loss in developing nations.

info.title: Medical Care Expenditures (1965-1979)
info.description: This infographic visualizes the increase in medical care expenditures from 1965 to 1979, showing per capita spending, nationwide total spending, and percentage of GNP.

info.title: Carter Considers a Gas Tax
info.description: This infographic discusses President Carter's consideration of a gas tax as a measure to conserve oil during the Iranian crisis and OPEC's rising petroleum prices in December 1979. It features an illustration of rising oil prices represented by a bar chart overlaid on a cartoon of a horse and rider.

info.title: When Were Musical Instruments Invented?
info.description: This infographic illustrates the estimated age of various musical instruments, categorizing them by instrument family and origin. The age of the instruments are displayed in years.

info.title: Olympic Brand Campaigns on Social Media
info.description: The infographic visualizes the top Google search results and Facebook users associated with various brands in relation to Olympic brand campaigns. It uses a swimming pool metaphor to represent search rankings.

info.title: Global Carbon Footprint: Total Emissions by Nation
info.description: This infographic visualizes the total carbon emissions by nation using proportional circles. The size of each circle corresponds to the total emissions of the respective country. Countries are also color-coded based on their continent (Africa, Asia, Caribbean, Central America, Europe, Middle East, North America, and Oceania, South America).

info.title: Employment Costs for a Steelworker in 1982
info.description: This infographic visualizes the employment costs for a steelworker per hour in different countries during the first nine months of 1982. It includes the average costs in U.S., West Germany, France, Japan, Britain, and South Korea.

info.title: CEO to Worker Pay Ratios in 2013
info.description: This infographic compares the CEO compensation to the median worker salary at five companies: 21st Century Fox, Honeywell, The Walt Disney, Good Year and CVS. The balloon size represents the CEO's compensation, and the height of the balloon basket represents the worker's median salary. The data source is Pay Scale, Inc.

info.title: American Companies That Failed in China
info.description: This infographic shows a timeline of American companies and how long they lasted in the Chinese market before withdrawing. It visually represents the lifespan, in months, of various companies, providing insight into the challenges of doing business in China.

info.title: Panama Canal Traffic
info.description: This infographic illustrates the traffic through the Panama Canal, showing the number of crossings for different market segments, the net tonnage, and types of cargo shipped. It also mentions the impact of drought on canal traffic.

info.title: The World's Biggest Rice Producers
info.description: An infographic illustrating the top 10 rice-producing countries in the world, with China being the largest producer. The visualization uses scaled circles to represent the amount of rice produced in 2019.

info.title: The Most Surveilled Cities in the World
info.description: This infographic visualizes the cities with the most surveillance based on the number of cameras per 1,000 people. It features a radial representation of different cities, primarily focusing on cities in China and India, and showing number of cameras for each city.

info.title: Oil Production by Country in 2022
info.description: This infographic visualizes global oil production by country in 2022, measured in thousands of barrels per day (B/D). It highlights the top oil-producing nations, categorized by OPEC, Non-OPEC, and OPEC+ countries, and also provides regional oil production breakdowns.

info.title: Timeline of Flight Achievements vs. Straw Decomposition
info.description: The infographic presents a timeline comparing significant milestones in aviation history with the decomposition time of a plastic straw. It visually depicts the progression of flight achievements alongside the environmental impact of plastic waste. The design uses a decomposing plastic straw as the timeline's central element, emphasizing the contrast between human innovation and environmental degradation.

info.title: Religious Attire in the Workplace
info.description: The infographic presents data about people's perception of whether it is ethical for various professions to wear religious attire in the workplace, using images and pie chart segments overlaid on the respective attire as a visual representation.

info.title: Daugavpils Municipality Expenditure Structure
info.description: The infographic shows the expenditure structure of Daugavpils municipality, represented visually by a segmented log, with each segment corresponding to a percentage of the total expenditure allocated to different areas.

info.title: Reasons for lack of female panel members at festivals
info.description: The infographic presents the reasons cited for the lack of female panel members at festivals, expressed as percentages. Each reason is associated with a slice of a stacked cucumber.

info.title: U.S. Milk Consumption Decline
info.description: The infographic illustrates the decline in U.S. milk consumption per capita from 1975 to 2011 and shows the sales of different types of milk and milk substitutes in 2012.

info.title: French Fry Consumption by Month
info.description: A bar chart visualizing French fry consumption by month, where the height of the bar is represented by the length of a French fry.

info.title: The Diet of Pirarucu
info.description: This infographic illustrates the dietary preferences of the pirarucu, the largest freshwater fish in the world. It includes bar charts and icons representing the different food groups consumed by the pirarucu, as well as statistics related to its production and size.

info.title: Whale Catches by Country in 2015
info.description: The infographic visualizes the number of whale catches by country for the year 2015, depicting the size of whale segments corresponding to the number of catches in each country.

info.title: Lack of Racial Diversity Among Winners of the Oscars
info.description: This infographic shows the lack of racial diversity among winners of the Oscars. It shows, for four categories (Best Supporting Actor, Best Actor, Best Actress, Best Supporting Actress), a number of Oscar statuettes composed of white and black dots representing the racial diversity in the winners.

info.title: Claims Data vs. EHR Data Comparison
info.description: This infographic compares claims data and EHR (Electronic Health Record) data available for 500 patients. It visualizes the number of records for different categories within claims data and highlights the 'EHR difference', indicating where EHR data provides more detailed information than claims data. The visualization uses an area chart-like representation to show the difference.

info.title: Montreal Tree Diversity
info.description: This infographic shows how diverse the urban trees are in Montreal. The graphic visualizes tree diversity, density and species distribution across different neighborhoods. Each tree-like structure represents a neighborhood, with the size of the circles representing the number or diversity of trees and the height representing average tree diameter and the species.

info.title: The Roots of Deforestation
info.description: This infographic illustrates the root causes and consequences of deforestation, showing the uses of wood, the increase in deforestation and population over time, and the major consumers of wood by region. It uses a visual metaphor of a tree to represent the topic.

info.title: Wine Not? Most Ordered Wines via Instacart in November
info.description: This infographic illustrates the top 10 most ordered wine varietals via Instacart in November, ranked by their share of all orders. The visualization employs a bubble chart-like layout where the size of each circle corresponds to the order share of the respective wine.

info.title: Busiest Ports in the World in 2023
info.description: An infographic showing the busiest ports in the world in 2023. It shows the ports' locations on a map, primarily focusing on Asia, and represents their activity levels by the height of stacked containers on ships. The height corresponds to TEU (twenty-foot equivalent unit).

info.title: Restaurant Spending Q2 2009 Trend
info.description: The infographic shows restaurant spending trends in the second quarter of 2009, indicating a reversal of a five-month declining sales trend. It compares the month-over-month increase in visits by Mint users to different fast food and sit-down restaurant chains.

info.title: Quarterly Review of Fast Food Chains
info.description: The infographic compares the revenues of different fast-food chains (McDonald's, Starbucks, Wendy's, and Taco Bell) using a modified bar chart visualization. Each chain is represented by a fork with prongs representing top-selling menu items. The height of the fork (or the prongs) roughly correlates with revenue numbers.

info.title: UK and US involvement in Afghanistan visualized as a rifle
info.description: This infographic visualizes the costs, resources, and impact of the UK and US presence in Afghanistan, presenting the data in the shape of a rifle.

info.title: Education and Employment Data Visualization
info.description: This infographic presents a radial visualization of education and employment data across different countries. It compares various metrics such as the percentage of the population not engaged in education or training, the percentage with a diploma, the percentage with a degree, and spending on education per student across different age groups.

info.title: Europe's Heaviest Energy Taxation
info.description: The infographic compares the energy taxes in Denmark, Great Britain, Germany, Holland, and Sweden. It uses a stacked bar chart to show the breakdown of energy prices into raw electricity price, transmission & distribution, and taxes & fees. The title states that the Danes are burdened by Europe's heaviest energy taxation. The subtitle indicates that Denmark has cheap electricity but sky-high taxation.

info.title: Animals Killed for Food Worldwide in 2009
info.description: This infographic compares the number of animals killed for food worldwide in 2009. It juxtaposes the consumption of various animals with text discussing human population size and ant populations, using the silhouette of a bird of prey to add a visual element and reinforce the food chain concept.

info.title: Top 10 Countries with the Largest Cumulative Carbon Emissions (1850-2021)
info.description: This infographic presents a bar chart displaying the top 10 countries with the largest cumulative carbon emissions from 1850 to 2021. The chart segments the emissions into exported CO2, imported CO2, and cumulative emissions for each country.

info.title: The Story of Jazz
info.description: This infographic visually represents the history and evolution of Jazz music, from its origins to contemporary forms. It showcases various subgenres, key characteristics, and prominent figures throughout different eras. The layout features a circular timeline resembling a vinyl record, with subgenres branching out from the center, creating a comprehensive overview of Jazz history.

info.title: When Sea Levels Attack! How long have we got?
info.description: An infographic illustrating the potential impact of rising sea levels on various cities and landmarks over different time scales, ranging from 80 years to 8000 years. It visualizes how the melting of ice sheets could contribute to sea-level rise and submerge coastal areas.

info.title: Gender Pay Gap by EU Country
info.description: This infographic illustrates the gender pay gap as the difference between average gross hourly earnings of male and female employees (as a percentage of male gross earnings) across EU countries. The countries are listed vertically, with the pay gap data placed beside each one. The visualization uses a rock climbing theme to visually represent the challenge of closing the pay gap.

info.title: Proportion of Men and Women University Professors in Spanish Universities
info.description: This infographic depicts the proportion of men and women who are professors in different Spanish universities. The visualization uses stylized human figures divided into male and female proportions using color. Blue represents men and red represents women.

info.title: Global Conflicts Timeline (1899-2014)
info.description: This infographic visualizes global conflicts from 1899 to 2014 using a timeline. Each conflict is represented by a poppy, with the stem indicating the duration and the size indicating the number of deaths. The poppy's color represents the region where the conflict took place.

info.title: Worldwide per capita red wine consumption in 2006
info.description: The infographic visualizes the per capita consumption of red wine across the world in 2006. It employs a bubble chart where the size of each bubble corresponds to the consumption level of that country, presented in liters. The layout is creatively designed to resemble a bunch of grapes.

info.title: On the road of development! Jelena and her impact in Forum
info.description: The infographic illustrates the journey and impact of Jelena in a forum, highlighting key projects, locations, and timelines from 2013 to 2021.

info.source: Whisper: Tracing the Spatiotemporal Process of Information Diffusion in Real Time
info.title: Visualization Design of Whisper Based on Sunflower Structure
info.description: The infographic illustrates the visualization design of Whisper, drawing a parallel between the structure of a sunflower and the representation of data related to tweets. It showcases how different elements of a sunflower (disc florets and ray florets) are used as metaphors to represent tweets and user interactions within Whisper.

info.source: TextFlow: Towards Better Understanding of Evolving Topics in Text
info.title: Topic flows of VisWeek publication data
info.description: The infographic shows the selected topic flows of VisWeek publication data from 2001 to 2010, visualized through thread weaving patterns. It focuses on the primary keywords "graph" and "document", and highlights the relationships and evolution of various topics over time, such as 'structure/layout,' 'exploration/analytics,' and 'document/temporal'.

info.source: ThemeRiver: Visualizing Thematic Changes in Large Document Collections
info.title: ThemeRiver: Thematic Changes Over Time
info.description: This infographic, titled "ThemeRiver," depicts thematic changes over time within a collection of patents from a single company. The visualization showcases how the prevalence of different keywords (e.g., 'internet,' 'paradigm,' 'histogram') fluctuates between 1988 and 1998. Each colored stream represents a theme, and its width corresponds to the prominence or frequency of that theme within the patent data at a given time.

info.source: A Visual Backchannel for Large-Scale Events
info.title: Chile Earthquake 2010 Twitter Stream
info.description: This infographic visualizes the Twitter stream related to the Chile Earthquake of 2010. It displays the frequency of different keywords (such as quake, tsunami, magnitude, coast, etc.) over time, from February 27th, 7 PM to February 28th, 8 AM.

info.title: Visual Sedimentation Metaphor
info.description: The infographic illustrates the visual sedimentation metaphor using different visualization types such as bar chart, pie chart, bubble chart, and a state diagram to explain the process of sediment accumulation and stratification. It depicts the transition of 'rocks' to 'aggregated area'.

info.source: How Ideas Flow across Multiple Social Groups
info.title: Focus+Context Timeline as Spring Metaphor
info.description: This infographic illustrates a focus+context timeline which uses a spring metaphor to represent time compression in idea flows. The frequency of the 'spring' encodes the number of time points compressed.

info.source: VAET: A Visual Analytics Approach for E-transactions Time-Series
info.title: KnotLines Visualization of Transactions
info.description: The infographic illustrates a visualization technique called KnotLines, used to represent and analyze transactional data. It shows visual encodings of three-level organizations, knotbunches to encode subgroups, knotlines to represent transactions of a seller, and a bar chart showing the number of commodities in different categories.

info.source: R-Map: A Map Metaphor for Visualizing Information Reposting Process in Social Media
info.title: R-Map Visual Encoding
info.description: This infographic illustrates the visual encoding scheme used in R-Map, a visualization technique for representing reposting trees. It maps reposting activity and user interactions onto a geographical metaphor, using elements like counties, lakes, and rivers to represent different aspects of the reposting network.

info.source: MetroSets: Visualizing Sets as Metro Maps
info.title: The MetroSets Pipeline for Visualizing Set Systems
info.description: This infographic illustrates the MetroSets pipeline, a method for visualizing set systems.  The pipeline takes an input set system (example: characters from The Simpsons) and processes it through several steps to generate a metro map-like visualization of the relationships between sets and elements. The steps include preprocessing, creating a support graph, reinserting discarded elements, creating an initial layout, and finally, schematizing the layout as a metro map with labels.

info.source: Subspace-Map: Interactive Visual Analysis for Subspace Data with a Map Metaphor
info.title: Visual Encodings of Subspace-Map
info.description: The infographic describes the visual encoding used in a Subspace-Map. Each hexagon represents a subspace, and clusters of hexagons represent regions. The infographic uses map metaphors to represent administrative divisions and transportation routes between subspaces.

info.source: Visualization of the Static Aspects of Software: A Survey
info.title: Solar System Metaphor
info.description: This visualization uses a solar system metaphor to represent software components and their relationships. The components, likely Java classes or packages, are represented as planets orbiting a central component, possibly a core class. The size and color of the "planets" may correspond to metrics like Total WMC (Weighted Methods per Class). Connections between the planets are indicated by lines.

info.source: Visualization of the Static Aspects of Software: A Survey
info.title: Code City Visualization
info.description: The infographic presents a visual representation of code structure using a city metaphor. Each element in the city corresponds to a component or aspect of the codebase. The height of buildings or the size of blocks might represent the number of lines of code, complexity, or other relevant metrics.

info.source: Visualization of the Static Aspects of Software: A Survey
info.title: 3D Nested Spheres and Hierarchical Net Visualizations
info.description: The image shows two different visualization techniques. The first one (a) uses 3D nested spheres to display entities related to architecture such as 'metric', 'manager' and 'graph', with smaller cylinders representing sub-entities. The second visualization (b) depicts a hierarchical net connecting various nodes, showing relationships between concepts like 'technology', 'automation', 'service' and their related components.

info.source: Visual Signatures for Financial Time Series

info.title: The 2012 Patent Cliff
info.description: This infographic illustrates the impact of the 2012 patent cliff, where 8 major drug patents expired, opening them up to generic competition. It highlights the revenue generated by these drugs, the potential job losses, and the savings from generic alternatives.

info.title: GDP to CO2 Emissions, G5 Countries
info.description: This infographic compares the GDP per capita and CO2 emissions of the G5 countries (Brazil, Mexico, China, South Africa, and India). The height of the smokestacks represents the GDP per capita, and the size of the cloud made of circles represents the CO2 emissions.

info.title: The effect of age on fertility
info.description: This infographic illustrates the relationship between a woman's age and her pregnancy rate, presenting data across different age groups from 20-24 to 40-44.

info.source: Co-Bridges: Pair-wise Visual Connection and Comparison for Multi-item Data Streams
info.title: Keyword Analysis of Tweets
info.description: This infographic displays the most frequently used words within a selection of tweets, grouped under four different categories: "america", "families", "great", and "#americafirst". The visualizations highlight trending words and themes, offering a glimpse into the topics and sentiment associated with each category over time, spanning from approximately July to September.

info.source: SocialHelix: visual analysis of sentiment divergence in social media
PeopleGarden: Creating Data Portraits for Users

info.title: Facial Emotion Analysis
info.description: The infographic illustrates the analysis of facial emotions, showing the relationship between primary and secondary emotions. It uses a novel visualization to represent the strength of different emotions (happiness, surprise, fear, disgust, contempt, sadness, and anger) from a subject, as well as positive, neutral, and negative expressions.

info.source: VideoForest: Interactive Visual Summarization of Video Streams Based on Danmu Data
VineMap: a metaphor visualization method for public opinion hierarchy from text data

info.title: Old-Age and Survivors Insurance Trust Fund: When the Cash Runs Out
info.description: This infographic uses a 3D line chart to depict the financial status of the Old-Age and Survivors Insurance Trust Fund. The chart illustrates the fund's projected deficits, represented by the line going below zero, and the potential consequences for beneficiaries.

info.title: Prosperity Trickles Away: Inflation vs. Growth
info.description: This infographic depicts the percentage changes from the previous year of inflation (consumer prices) and growth (real G.N.P.) for 24 OECD countries. It uses a creative visualization of a melting world to represent the concept of 'prosperity trickling away'.

info.title: Economic Trends: Dow Jones, Unemployment, Inflation, and Dollar Value
info.description: This infographic presents a series of line graphs visualizing economic trends, including the Dow Jones Industrial Average and several other metrics from 1978-1979, such as unemployment, inflation, interest rates, economic growth, and the dollar's value. The trends of the variables are represented using line charts (fever charts), and the lines collectively form part of an illustration of the U.S. flag.

info.title: Gold's Shine: London Monthly Highs
info.description: This infographic displays the monthly high prices of gold in London using a circular bar chart, sometimes referred to as a 'star graph'. It spans from January 1979 to January 1980.

info.title: Over the Cliff: Profit/Loss of Major U.S. Auto Companies in the Third Quarter
info.description: This infographic depicts the profit/loss of major U.S. auto companies (Ford, General Motors, and Chrysler) in the third quarter of 1979 and 1980. It also shows personal bankruptcies filed with a visualization using the silhouette of people.

info.title: Personal Bankruptcies Filed
info.description: The infographic presents data on personal bankruptcies filed, using a visualization where bars project downwards to represent increasing debt or trouble. It also features bar graphs showing the rising amount of money as debt increases. The top depicts figures going broke with empty pockets.

info.title: Backbreaking Personal Debt
info.description: The infographic illustrates the increase in personal debt in billions of dollars at the year's end from 1975 to 1981. The data is visualized as stacked bars representing household mortgages, installment credit, and other borrowings.

info.title: Soaring Spending
info.description: An infographic depicting the increase in government spending over time, visualized as an eagle with its wings representing budget outlays.

info.title: Major Corporate Headquarters by Assets
info.description: An infographic showing the number of major corporate headquarters by assets in different cities. It displays the number of bank holding companies, utilities, life insurance companies, and financial service companies with 1982 assets of $1.9 billion or more, for cities like Dallas, Seattle, Kansas City, etc.

info.title: The Rise in Cigarette Prices
info.description: This infographic illustrates the rise in average retail cigarette prices per pack (in cents) from 1978 to 1982. The visualization includes a visual representation of a cigarette pack and a horizontal bar chart, where the length of the bar is proportional to the price. The text also mentions that the figures include federal, state, and local taxes and the current federal excise tax. The source of the data is the Tobacco Institute.

info.title: U.S. Oil and Gas Rigs in Operation, 1970-1981
info.description: The infographic shows the number of U.S. oil and gas rigs in operation, in thousands, as yearly averages, from 1970 to April 1981. The data is represented using bar-like visuals that resemble oil rigs.

info.title: Portrait of a Recession: Unemployment in July 1980
info.description: This infographic illustrates the percent share of the unemployed in July 1980, broken down by race, age (adult/teenager), and gender. The data is visualized in a unique way, using segments of a face to represent each demographic group.

info.title: America's Commercial Forests Ownership and Production
info.description: This infographic shows the percentage of commercial forest acreage owned and the annual harvest production from commercial forests by different sectors: industry, government, and private owners.

info.title: Where Iran's Oil Goes
info.description: This infographic illustrates the percentage of Iran's total oil exports to different countries in the first quarter of 1980. The visualization creatively uses a barrel shaped like a leader to symbolize Iran's oil output, with each segment representing a different destination and its corresponding export percentage.

info.title: Soviet and U.S. Nuclear Destructive Force
info.description: A comparison of Soviet and U.S. nuclear destructive force, measured in megatons and warheads, in 1972 and 1982. The visualization uses bar charts to represent the number of warheads at different points in time, combined with mushroom cloud icons and associated megatonnage.

info.title: U.S. Birthrate Fever Chart
info.description: This infographic presents a fever chart illustrating the U.S. birthrate (yearly number of births per 1,000 women) from 1925 to 1980. The chart is humorously overlaid onto a sketch of a baby's diaper, and key historical events such as the baby boom, the availability of the birth control pill, and the impact of the depression era are noted along the chart.

info.title: The Budget Dollar: Where it Comes From and Where it Goes (1980)
info.description: An infographic illustrating the sources of income and expenditures of the US Federal Budget in 1980. The infographic uses two pie charts to visually represent where the budget dollar comes from (income taxes, social security, etc.) and where it goes (benefit payments, defense, etc.). The pie charts are depicted as anthropomorphic figures wearing Uncle Sam hats on a seesaw.

info.title: U.S.-Japan Trade Gap and Rising Gap in Japanese Trade
info.description: This infographic illustrates the trade gap between the U.S. and Japan and the rising gap in Japanese trade using line charts creatively integrated with visual metaphors of a kimono and a samurai warrior on a horse. The data spans from 1974 to 1978, showing trends in exports and imports.

info.title: US Dollar Strength Against Other Currencies
info.description: The infographic visualizes the strength of the U.S. dollar against four other currencies (German Mark, Japanese Yen, British Pound, and French Franc) using a stylized line graph representation. The visualization cleverly uses a weightlifting metaphor, depicting the U.S. dollar as a strongman lifting the weight of the other currencies.

info.title: Government and Business Borrowing Squeezing Out Consumers
info.description: This infographic illustrates how government and businesses are increasingly utilizing available funds for borrowing, leading to a detrimental impact on consumers. It employs a line graph within a stylized 3D representation to depict the trend.

info.title: Financial Thunderstorms: Prime Rate and Money Supply
info.description: An infographic illustrating the fluctuation of prime rate and money supply changes over a period of months, from October to July. It visually correlates these financial indicators with a 'financial thunderstorms' metaphor.  The infographic also features a portrait of Federal Reserve Board Chairman Paul Volcker.

info.title: Bouncing Back: State and Local Operating Balances
info.description: This infographic illustrates the economic trends of the late 1970s and early 1980s using creative visualizations. It displays the prime rate, mortgage rate, and 6-month Treasury bills in relation to a lightning bolt on the left, and depicts state and local operating balances with Uncle Sam on the right. The infographic communicates economic data in a visually engaging manner.

info.title: The American Nightmare: Median Price of New One-Family Homes Sold
info.description: This infographic illustrates the increasing median price of new one-family homes sold from 1971 to 1981. The visualization uses a house-shaped line graph to convey the feeling of a 'nightmare' scenario of escalating housing costs.

info.title: Marijuana Seized by U.S. Authorities (1973-1978)
info.description: This infographic illustrates the amount of marijuana seized by U.S. authorities between 1973 and 1978, measured in millions of pounds. The data is visualized using a modified line graph where the line is shaped like smoke emanating from a joint. The x-axis represents time (years), and the y-axis represents the amount of marijuana seized.

info.title: Prime Interest Rate and Dow Jones Performance
info.description: An infographic illustrating the prime interest rate (% per year, date of rate change) and the Dow Jones Industrials daily closings on specific dates, depicted with a person struggling to hold up the fluctuating values.

info.title: Playing Post Office: The Rising Cost of First Class Letters
info.description: This infographic illustrates the increasing cost of sending a first-class letter in the United States from 1952 to 1981, presented as a line with data points. It also includes information about the Dow Jones and cost of living increases to provide context.

info.title: Currency Value Against the Dollar
info.description: The infographic visualizes the value of several currencies (British Pound, French Franc, German Mark, and Japanese Yen) relative to the US dollar, showing cumulative changes from December 1980 to 1982. The visualization uses a creative approach by depicting the currency values as 'fever charts' and anthropomorphizing them with worried expressions, relating to 'bathroom scales'.

info.title: The Trend in Terror: US Crime Rates
info.description: An infographic showing the trend of murder, rape, robbery, and assault rates per 100,000 population in the US, presented as a line chart overlaid on a map of the United States. The map is stylized to resemble a mask, adding a dramatic effect.

info.title: Runaway Growth: Dow Jones Industrials, Daily Closing
info.description: An infographic visualizing the daily closing of the Dow Jones Industrials over a period of time (August 2nd to August 20th). The visualization is presented as a bar chart, with the bars forming the 'beard' of a face.  The largest one-day rise in history is annotated.

info.title: Choices for Congress: Projected Domestic Oil Production in 1990
info.description: This infographic illustrates projected domestic oil production in the United States in 1990 under different policy scenarios, specifically related to price controls and tax plans. The visualization uses a bar chart-like representation where the height of oil gusher illustrations indicates the projected oil production level under each scenario. The data source is credited to the Congressional Budget Office.

info.title: Oil Sources: U.S. Petroleum Imports
info.description: This infographic visualizes the sources of U.S. petroleum imports, distinguishing between OPEC and non-OPEC countries. It shows the percentage of total U.S. imports from each country in August, along with the price per barrel of representative crude in November 16. It also uses a map of the United States made out of oil.

info.title: The Holders: Who Owns the World's Gold?
info.description: This infographic visually represents the distribution of the world's 2.8 billion ounces of gold among different holders, including governments, individuals, and other entities. A modified pie chart shows the percentages held by each category, with stylized hands literally holding the 'slices' of the pie.

info.title: Deficits and New Revenue Sources
info.description: This infographic illustrates the US federal deficits with and without a tax bill from 1982-1986, and the proposed new sources of revenue from the tax bill, likely under President Reagan's administration. The visualization style is a combination of a line graph and a pie chart, presented in a symbolic and slightly humorous way.

info.title: The handgun in U.S. is unrivaled murder weapon
info.description: This infographic shows the proportion of murders committed with different types of weapons in the U.S. in 1980, with handguns accounting for 50% of murders.

info.title: Iranian Asset Meltdown
info.description: This infographic illustrates the journey of Iranian assets frozen by the Carter administration in 1979. It tracks the funds from their initial state to their eventual release, detailing various locations and accounts involved.

info.title: Coral Reef Bleaching Levels by Location (August 2019)
info.description: An infographic depicting the stress levels of coral reefs worldwide, visualized through a coral-like structure. The branches represent reefs, with the number of dots above each branch indicating the bleaching level as of August 2019 according to NOAA Coral Reef Watch data.

info.title: Threatened Species by Class/Group
info.description: This infographic visualizes the percentage of threatened species within different classes or groups of plants and animals. It illustrates how each branch and its leaves represent a specific class/group, with the bleached area indicating the number of threatened species as a percentage of the total known species in that group. Countries with more than 50% threatened species within a given class/group are highlighted in yellow.  The top leaf in each branch provides the average percentage of threatened species for that class/group, while the other leaves represent countries with the highest number of threatened species.

info.title: U.S. Immigration 1850-2016
info.description: This infographic shows the immigration to the U.S. from 1850 to 2016 based on continent of origin. The visualization is a radial dot chart, where each dot represents an immigrant and the distance from the center represents time, with the innermost ring showing 1850 and the outermost ring showing 2016. Each continent is represented by a different color.

info.title: Cost of living and tourism competitiveness in 50 countries
info.description: This infographic presents a comparative analysis of 50 countries and territories based on their cost of living and tourism competitiveness. It visualizes several indicators, including cost of living, rent, food prices, restaurant prices, purchasing power, and tourism competitiveness index, using a unique "flower" or "leaf" shaped visualization. The countries are positioned according to their geographical location.

info.title: Psychological Exploration of Mobile Children after Adulthood
info.description: The infographic explores the psychological choices of mobile children (children who move frequently) after they grow up. It visualizes their responses to various questions related to life, family, and school, providing a comparative analysis.

info.title: The Choice: Vegetable Distribution Channels
info.description: This infographic visually compares different vegetable distribution channels, from farmers markets to large supermarket chains. It details the processes involved, such as cleaning, packaging, distribution, and redistribution, highlighting potential redundant services and price increases along the way. The infographic aims to educate consumers on the hidden differences between vegetables purchased from various sources and encourage them to consider the quality and true cost of their choices.

info.title: Asia-Pacific Gender Equality: The Good, the Bad and the Parity
info.description: An infographic illustrating gender equality across various Asia-Pacific countries, focusing on economic and political opportunities, wage gaps, and female representation in different sectors. The infographic uses a unique flower petal visualization to represent gender parity scores and includes data on female talent bottlenecks.

info.title: A General View of the Animal Kingdom
info.description: The infographic presents a visual categorization of the animal kingdom, arranging different animal groups in a hierarchical fashion based on their characteristics.  It organizes animals from simple forms like Radiates and Mollusks to more complex ones like Vertebrates, highlighting classifications such as cold-blooded and warm-blooded animals.

info.title: The Clock of Geological Time
info.description: Infographic showing the geological timeline of Earth's history, presented in a spiral format resembling a clock. The clock face indicates millions of years ago, with key events in the development of life on Earth noted along the spiral. It features illustrations of various life forms, from early microorganisms to humans, along the timeline.

info.title: Phylogenetic classification of living beings
info.description: An infographic illustrating a simplified phylogenetic classification of living beings, starting from archea and bacteria and proceeding through various phyla and classes of organisms up to mammals. It represents the evolutionary relationships between different groups, using a spiral-like layout.

info.title: Toxic Jellyfish of Plastic Emission: Plastic Polluted Rivers & Oceans in the World
info.description: This infographic visualizes plastic pollution in rivers and oceans, highlighting top polluting rivers, plastic mass input, and the distribution of plastic particles in the world's oceans in 2013. It emphasizes the relationship between riverine city development, river length, discharge, population density, and plastic emission.

info.title: Nanjing Air Quality and Travel 2018
info.description: This infographic analyzes the air quality of Nanjing in 2018 and its impact on travel decisions. It presents data on PM10, Ozone (O3), and Sulfur Dioxide (SO2) concentrations by month and area, advising tourists to consider air quality when planning trips, recommending July to September for better air quality.

info.title: The OTL of Chicken Restaurants
info.description: This infographic illustrates the high failure rate of chicken restaurants, showing the number of openings and closures over time, alongside the proportion of restaurants that fail within three years. It also contextualizes the saturation of chicken restaurants in Seoul.

info.title: Pasta Production by Country
info.description: This infographic illustrates pasta production in tons by different countries including Italy, USA, Germany, France, Spain and the UK.

info.title: Largest Bankruptcies in History
info.description: This infographic visualizes the largest bankruptcies in history by representing them as sinking ships arranged chronologically. The size of each ship corresponds to the company's pre-bankruptcy assets, and the ships are color-coded based on the company's sector.

info.title: Deep Impact: Visualizing Gene Research
info.description: An infographic illustrating the impact of research on human genes. The primary visualization represents 19,757 genes arranged according to their chromosomal position. The length of bars extending below a plane indicates post-2001 publications, while the height above signifies pre-2001 publications. The breadth of the base reflects associated diseases. Additional visualizations include a number of diseases vs number of publications representation and chromosomes order by number of genes as a radial structure.

info.title: The Gold Tree: Where Gold Comes From and Where It Goes
info.description: This infographic illustrates the sources and uses of gold globally, presenting data on mining, recycling, investment forms, and distribution across various sectors and countries.

info.title: Energy Consumption of Tech Companies
info.description: The infographic visualizes the estimated energy consumption of various tech companies (Google, Facebook, Amazon, Twitter, and Apple) using pie charts within a plug-like design to represent the overall energy usage and its breakdown by different energy sources such as Ren el (Renewable electricity), Naturgas (Natural gas), Kol (Coal), and Kärnkraft (Nuclear power).

info.source: Blowing seeds across gardens: Visualizing implicit propagation of cross-platform social media posts

info.description: This infographic presents an interface overview called "BloomWind" analyzing the diffusion process of topics related to nuclear wastewater pouring across different platforms. It displays a cluster-level propagation view, a timeline view for selecting a time frame and controlling the animation, and a cluster-level detail view listing post and user information by topic and platform.

info.title: Red and White Wines Sweetness Chart
info.description: An infographic illustrating the sweetness levels of various red and white wines using wine glasses as containers to visually represent the sweetness scale from dry to sweet.

info.title: Politicians' Salaries & Income Inequality
info.description: This infographic visualizes the disparity between politicians' salaries (as a multiple of GDP per capita) across different countries, alongside a visual representation of the GINI coefficient for income inequality in these countries.

info.title: Most visited countries based on 2019 visitor arrivals

info.title: Crewed Spaceflights by Country
info.description: The infographic visualizes the number of crewed spaceflights that reached an altitude of at least 100 km by country. It features the USA, Russia/Soviet Union, and China, with their respective flight counts represented as stylized 'rocket exhaust' shapes emanating from a space shuttle.

info.title: Trends Over Time
info.description: This infographic visually represents trends over time, specifically showcasing data points for the years 2007, 2009, 2020, and 2022. It uses a bar chart to display the values for each year, supplemented by illustrative figures that contextualize the data.

info.description: Infographic showing the top-grossing foreign films of all time, presented in the form of a popcorn container. The bars, shaped like popcorn, represent the lifetime gross in dollars for each film, with additional information about the film's title, year of release, country, and language provided.

info.title: Top Rating TV Shows of 2017
info.description: An infographic depicting the top rating TV shows of 2017 based on the number of average demand expressions globally. The ratings are shown in millions.

info.title: Comparing Documentation

It visually represents the data gathered for analysis of consumption patterns and potential savings. The vertical bar chart is designed creatively, resembling a chef's hat, to highlight the energy usage of each person.

info.title: Feelings during the pandemic
info.description: An infographic showing the percentage of people feeling more confident in creative ideas, more gratitude, more inspired, more hope, more excited about the future, and more efficient during the pandemic.

info.description: This infographic presents data on greenhouse gas emissions in Taiwan from 1990 to 2012. It includes overall emission trends, per capita emissions, and emission intensity relative to GDP. The infographic uses a combination of visualizations to present this information.

info.title: Funds Received and Spent Since 2007
info.description: This infographic visualizes the increase in funds received and spent since 2007, using a stylized design with a watering can and raindrops to represent the flow of funds.

The bar chart compares pollution caused versus pollution exposed for White, Black and Hispanic populations.

info.title: COVID-19 Lockdown Statistics
info.description: An infographic illustrating the proportion of the world's population under lockdown due to the coronavirus pandemic as of March 25, 2020, visually representing the number of people under lockdown versus those still conducting business as usual. The infographic leverages a building graphic to represent these statistics.

info.description: The infographic displays divorce rate coefficient per 1000 people, comparing a rate of 1.8 for wooden houses versus 3.1 for apartment buildings. The visual uses building types to represent these rates in a simple comparison.

info.description: This infographic visualizes data related to 'Green' initiatives during the 'Winter' season, showcasing indicators like renewable electricity, CO2 emissions per capita, and GDP per capita using an abstract, tree-like visualization. It's associated with the World Government Summit.

info.description: The infographic provides statistics on suicides in Japan, including the number of suicides reported in 2010, the rate of suicide victims by region, trend numbers of suicide deaths over time, the cause distribution of suicides, and other related data.

info.description: This infographic illustrates the history and evolution of logos from ancient times to the 21st century, highlighting the origins and development of various brand symbols and their significance in different eras.

info.description: This infographic visualizes bird sounds as forest-like structures, where the volume of the sound is represented by the branches, the density of leaves represents the scale range, and the color of the bird represents the color of the forest. info.title: Scoville Scale of Pepper
info.description: This infographic presents the Scoville Scale, which measures the pungency (spiciness or "heat") of chili peppers. It visually compares the Scoville Heat Units (SHU) of various peppers, from mild to extremely spicy, including a description of the peppers.

info.title: National Burden Ratio in Japan from 1970 to 2020
info.description: This infographic illustrates the national burden ratio in Japan from 1970 to 2020, which includes the tax burden and social security burden. It shows the percentage of income that the public bears to support public services such as taxes and social security. The graphic uses a man lifting a barbell with figures representing the burden.

info.title: Inequality Tree Visualization
info.description: This infographic visualizes inequality data using a tree diagram. The 'leaves' represent different aspects of inequality, colored to indicate Income Inequality Index, Gender Inequality Index, and percentage of Female MPs. The structure seems to imply hierarchical relationship, though the nature of the data makes it more of a radial arrangement.

info.title: Wine Production: Sector Numbers in Portugal and the World
info.description: This infographic presents information regarding wine production in Portugal and globally. It includes data on annual wine consumption per capita in Portugal, total wine production evolution, wine production by region, and the top 15 wine-producing countries in 2011.

info.title: Water Infographics
info.description: The infographic presents various statistical data and information using different types of charts. The focus is likely on water-related topics, suggested by the title and the visual elements like water droplets and glasses filled with liquid.

info.title: Crime rates and high school female ratios in Tokyo districts
info.description: The infographic illustrates crime rates across various districts of Tokyo using a custom chart that visually resembles refrigerators. It also displays the ratio of female high school students in different districts using lamp-like figure charts.

info.title: Gun Ownership and Homicide Rates
info.description: This infographic presents a radial chart comparing gun ownership rates and gun homicide rates across various countries. The visualization combines the radial chart with the outline of a gun to emphasize the correlation between the two variables. Also, it's part of a book or poster collection.

info.title: Common New Year's Resolutions
info.description: An infographic showing common New Year's resolutions, presented in the form of a dandelion where each seed represents a different resolution and its corresponding percentage.

info.title: Hot and Cold Temperatures Comparison
info.description: The infographic illustrates the concept of temperature using two thermometers. One thermometer, depicted in red, shows a high temperature reading and is associated with a sun graphic to represent heat. The other, in blue, shows a lower temperature and is paired with a snowflake graphic to represent cold.

info.title: Wage Distribution Across Countries
info.description: This infographic visualizes the distribution of wages across various countries, with a focus on comparing high, medium, and low wages. It employs a radar chart for the primary data representation, associating country wage distribution with points around the circumference. Additionally, it shows the wage distributions related to the categories high wage, medium wage, and low wage with the same visualization type.

info.title: Share of the World's Forests, by Country
info.description: This infographic shows the distribution of the world's forests by country, using a visually appealing design resembling a tree trunk. The slices represent each country's percentage of global forest cover.

info.title: Fossil Fuel Production: The Wrong Direction
info.description: This infographic illustrates the projected trends in fossil fuel production, comparing current trajectories with the levels needed to meet climate goals. It shows the disparity between 'where it's going' based on current plans, 'where they committed to go' based on climate pledges, 'where we'd like to go' to limit warming to 2°C, and 'where we should be going' to limit warming to 1.5°C.

info.title: Total Wildland Fires and Acres 1990-2020
info.description: The infographic visualizes the total wildland fires and acres burned in the U.S. from 1990 to 2020. It uses a line chart to show the trends of both number of fires and acres burned over time, highlighting specific years with significant fire events.

info.title: Shower Time Preferences
info.description: This infographic presents the preferred times of day for taking showers, showing the percentages of people who prefer night showers, morning showers, taking showers at both times, and afternoon showers.

info.title: Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) in Switzerland
info.description: This infographic presents data on the Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) in Switzerland, including certified forests by type and region, forest ownership, timber consumption by use, and certified forests in Europe compared to Switzerland.

info.title: World's Top Export Countries in 2018
info.description: An infographic depicting the top export countries in 2018, showing the export values using a bar chart and representing each country with its flag displayed on a cargo ship.

info.title: Medical Timeline Infographic
info.description: This infographic presents a timeline of medical data options. It uses a stethoscope as a visual element connecting different stages or options related to medical information, each represented by an organ icon and corresponding text.

info.title: The Increasing Number of Vacant Houses in Japan
info.description: This infographic illustrates the trend of increasing vacant houses in Japan, highlighting the rising vacancy rate, regional differences, and potential contributing factors such as population decline. It also touches upon associated issues like urban decay and crime, as well as the taxation aspects of vacant properties.

info.title: The Future of Sea Ice
info.description: This infographic depicts the melting of sea ice over time, from 1979 to 2050. The phrase 'The Ice is Melting' is repeated for each year, with the text gradually becoming more fragmented and distorted to visually represent the increasing rate of ice melt.

info.title: 2015 National Fire Statistics
info.description: This infographic presents the fire statistics for the year 2015 in a specific region. It visualizes the number of fire incidents and property damage over the years from 2011 to 2015 using a column chart with pictorial representations of smoke and burning houses. Additionally, it illustrates the top five causes of fire in 2015, represented with lighters.

info.title: Cell Phones by the Numbers
info.description: This infographic presents statistics on cell phone usage in the United States, including the total number of cell phones, the percentage that are smartphones, the average cost of a phone, and the monthly bill by carrier. The overall visual theme is a tree.

info.title: The US Credit Card Crisis
info.description: This infographic presents data and key facts about the US credit card crisis. It includes information on credit card debt, lobbying efforts, and the number of credit cards in circulation.

info.title: The Browser Wars

It uses a metaphorical representation of a battlefield to depict the rise and fall of different browsers, such as Netscape, Internet Explorer, Firefox, and others. The length and placement of each browser's 'timeline' visually represents its market presence and decline/growth over the years.

info.title: Spring Development: Happy Planet Index, Human Development Index, and GDP per capita
info.description: The infographic uses a unique tree-like structure to represent data related to the Happy Planet Index, Human Development Index, and GDP per capita. The visual metaphor of a tree growing upwards signifies development. Each branch is a data point which is also color-coded with corresponding labels.

info.title: Trump's Twitter Attacks

It uses a Sankey diagram to show the flow and distribution of his attacks across various categories, including Democrats, Republicans, the Media, and specific individuals or outlets.

It highlights that the majority of runners participate in fun runs, 5k, 10k, or half marathon events.

info.title: Divorce Rates: A Comparison Between 1999 and 2020
info.description: This infographic visually represents the increase in divorce rates between 1999 and 2020. A scale is used, with each side representing a year. The number of divorces for each year is indicated numerically, and broken hearts are used as visual elements to represent the divorce rate in each year.

info.title: A Thirsty World: Access to Safe Drinking Water
info.description: This infographic presents data on the percentage of the global population with access to safe drinking water. It highlights progress made over the last two decades, focusing on the disparities in access based on national wealth, income groups and geographic regions. The data visualized primarily shows the percentage of the population with access to safe drinking water in 2020, and how this has changed since 2000.

info.description: The infographic visualizes the total Swiss final energy consumption in 2014, broken down by renewable and non-renewable sources. info.description: Infographic depicting an economic downturn with a line chart showing a dip, and an illustration of a businessman performing a pole vault over the declining line.  The illustration serves as a metaphor for overcoming financial challenges or an economic crisis.

info.title: Financial Growth
info.description: An infographic depicting financial growth using a line chart where the peaks and valleys are marked by stacks of coins. A person is walking along the line, placing a stack of coins at the next high point.

info.title: Career Growth Illustration
info.description: This image shows a bar chart with increasing heights, a spring, and a businessman jumping over the bars. It represents career growth, progress, and overcoming challenges.

info.title: Achieving Goals through Growth
info.description: This infographic illustrates growth towards achieving a target. It shows a man with a bow and arrow standing on a bar chart, aiming towards a target placed at the top of the highest bar, visually representing progress and the ultimate goal.

info.title: Economic Recovery
info.description: An illustration depicting a person pulling an economic line graph upwards using a bow and arrow, symbolizing efforts to recover or improve the economy. Initially, the line trends downward but then changes to an upward trend.

info.title: Currency Juggling on a Growth Curve
info.description: This infographic depicts a person riding a unicycle along an upward-sloping arrow, juggling coins representing various currencies. It symbolizes the balancing act required in managing finances or investments for growth.

info.title: Growth Trajectory with Rocket and Paper Airplane
info.description: This infographic depicts two line graphs, one ending with a rocket and the other with a paper airplane, symbolizing different trajectories or growth strategies. The background grid suggests a coordinate system, implying a quantitative representation of growth over time.

info.title: Teamwork Leads to Success
info.description: An illustration representing teamwork and collaboration leading to success. Three figures, presumably representing team members, are walking upwards on a green arrow, symbolizing growth and progress, towards a flag, which symbolizes achieving the goal. The background includes a grid and clouds.

info.title: Rocket Launching Success
info.description: An infographic showing a rocket launching upwards, superimposed over a line graph depicting growth. The background includes a light blue grid, a crescent moon, and clouds, suggesting a business concept of growth and reaching for the stars.

info.title: Business Growth Illustration
info.description: An illustration depicting business growth with a businessman riding a skateboard on a rising bar chart and arrow.

info.title: Fight against COVID-19 and Flatten the Curve
info.description: An infographic depicting the concept of 'flattening the curve' during the COVID-19 pandemic, visualizing the reduction of the infection rate to prevent overwhelming healthcare systems.

info.title: Pie Chart Hot Air Balloon
info.description: The image depicts a stylized pie chart represented as a hot air balloon. The pie chart sections are divided into three parts, with one section detached from the rest of the circle. The balloon's basket has a tic-tac-toe pattern on it. The text 'Pie Chart' is displayed below the image.

info.title: COVID-19's Impact on Economy
info.description: The infographic visually represents the negative impact of COVID-19 on the economy, symbolized by a virus shattering stacks of coins representing financial growth.

info.title: Business Growth and Decline
info.description: An illustration depicting a person balancing on a line graph that shows growth followed by a sharp decline, symbolizing the challenges of maintaining stability in business.

info.title: Gas Price Breakdown
info.description: The infographic compares the breakdown of gas prices in Cheyenne, Wyoming and San Luis Obispo, California. It shows the cost per gallon and breaks down the price into components like crude oil, distribution and marketing, refining, federal taxes, state taxes, and miscellaneous costs.

info.title: The Most Travelled Global Businesses by Sector
info.description: This infographic visualizes the air miles travelled by different global business sectors. It shows the ranking of the sectors based on air travel, with 'Music & Entertainment' at the top and 'Communications' at the bottom, using curved lines and airplane icons to represent each sector and its corresponding air miles.

info.title: Teenage Pregnancies in Canada
info.description: This infographic visualizes the total teen pregnancy rate in Canada per thousand from 1974 to 1984, showing a decreasing trend. It includes a line graph, illustrative figures, and contextual information.

info.title: Peak Month of Flu Viruses Since 1982
info.description: This infographic depicts the peak month of flu viruses since 1982, represented with noses and green mucus-like lines to indicate the frequency of peak months for each month of the year, from October to March. The vertical axis represents the number of times a month was the season peak since 1982.

info.title: Crop Production by Type
info.description: This infographic displays the gross gathering of different types of crops in ton per annum. The crops are categorized into cereal, legumes, vegetables, potatoes, and forage, with each category represented by its percentage and weight of total crop yield.

info.title: Balance Comparison
info.description: The infographic uses a balance scale metaphor to compare six items, represented by stacked blocks of different colors and sizes. Each item has a placeholder title and descriptive text, along with a percentage value.

info.title: LEGO's Revenue Growth
info.description: This infographic shows LEGO's revenue growth from 2003 to 2023. The vertical axis indicates revenue in billions of dollars, and the horizontal axis represents the years. LEGO bricks are used to visually represent the revenue for each year. Key events, such as the release of the LEGO Star Wars video game and The LEGO Movie, are marked on the timeline.

info.title: Most Popular Sushi in the US
info.description: This infographic shows the most popular types of sushi in the US, ranked by preference among men and women (western style). The preference percentage is displayed on the Y axis, and sushi types are shown on the X axis.

info.title: Segments Financed by M&M Financial Services
info.description: This infographic presents the asset under management (AUM) mix in percentage for segments financed by M&M Financial Services. The segments include SMEs, auto/utility vehicles, cars, tractors, pre-owned vehicles, and CVs. The data is visualized using a bar chart to show the proportional representation of each segment.

info.title: Visualizing the Race for EV Dominance
info.description: This infographic visualizes the market share of EV companies in 2020 and projected for 2025, along with EV sales data and predictions regarding the EV charging market and the potential for EVs to outsell gas cars by 2040.

info.title: Ski Resorts Comparison
info.description: This infographic compares ski resorts around the world based on various factors such as course length, cost, and elevation. It visually represents the relative positions of each resort along a vertical axis representing altitude, and uses lines to connect the resort locations on a world map.

info.title: Whales killed since 1985 ban
info.description: This infographic presents a bar chart showing the number of whales killed since the 1985 ban, broken down by country. The data excludes illegal killings and includes only IWC member countries. The bars are plotted on a faded world map.

info.title: Oil Infographic
info.description: An infographic about the oil industry, including data on oil reserves, consumption, major importers and exporters, historical prices, and alternative sources.

info.title: Animal Speed Comparison
info.description: This infographic compares the speeds of different animals and a human sprinter. It uses a simple visual representation to rank them from fastest to slowest, indicating their speeds in kilometers per hour.

info.title: U.S. Oil Imports in 2021
info.description: This infographic visualizes the breakdown of U.S. oil imports in 2021, showing the amounts from different countries and regions, and compares that to domestic production.

info.title: Global Beer Consumption by Country
info.description: An infographic showing the global beer consumption by country, with a focus on the top consumers and some contextual information about the history and popularity of beer.

info.title: Currency Wars: Who is Winning the Race to the Bottom?
info.description: This infographic illustrates the 'currency wars' by showing the percentage change of major currencies since 2010, and the real GDP % change in 2012 and 2013. The first part uses a race analogy with cyclists representing different currencies to show the changes in currency value. The second part highlights the 'Currency Winners' based on real GDP percentages.

info.title: Down Goes the Dollar
info.description: An infographic illustrating the decrease in value of the U.S. dollar against the West German mark, displayed across yearly, monthly, and daily timeframes. The data is visually represented using U.S. dollar bills.

info.title: World's Top 20 Beer Consumption
info.description: This infographic illustrates the world's top 20 countries in beer consumption per capita. It uses a bar chart to rank the countries and includes the flags of each country at the bottom of the bars. Beer bottles are above the bars to represent the beer of the country. The visualization also highlights the average consumption of beer per person per year.

info.title: Global Petrol Prices: Cost of 1 Litre Around the World
info.description: This infographic compares the price of 1 litre of petrol in selected countries, expressed in Indian Rupees (₹). It visualizes the data using a radial chart, highlighting price variations across different nations and providing context on factors influencing petrol costs, such as taxes, domestic production, and oil reserves.

info.title: Oil Consumption by Country
info.description: An infographic showing leading oil consuming countries and their consumption in million barrels per day. The infographic uses a combination of country flags and oil drum imagery to present the data.

info.title: Richest Indian Employees by Net Worth
info.description: This infographic showcases a bar chart-like visualization depicting the richest Indian employees by their net worth. The 'bars' are represented by stacks of money, making the comparison of wealth more visually engaging. Each employee's name, net worth, and company are listed.

info.title: Top Selling Sneaker Brands
info.description: The infographic illustrates the top-selling sneaker brands based on their revenue in billions of dollars. The visualization uses a sneaker image, with color blocks proportional to the brand revenues.

info.title: McDonald's Nickname Usage Rate Map by Prefecture in Japan
info.description: This infographic shows the usage rate of the nickname "Macdo" for McDonald's by prefecture in Japan. It presents a map of Japan where each prefecture is represented, and the usage rate is indicated by a stack of burger images, with higher stacks representing higher usage rates. Specific percentages are noted for some prefectures, and a color-coded legend is provided to understand the burger stack height to usage rate conversion.

info.title: The World's Largest Lithium Producing Countries
info.description: The infographic visualizes lithium production and reserves by country. It includes a bar chart comparing lithium reserves in million tonnes for various countries, and a visualization representing the lithium production by country in tonnes.

info.title: Nike's Business: How Nike Makes Money
info.description: This infographic illustrates how Nike generates revenue across different product categories, showcasing the percentage contribution and corresponding dollar amounts from equipment, Converse, apparel, and footwear.  It also shows the total revenue generated by Nike.

info.title: Top Global Airlines by Market Cap
info.description: This infographic displays the top global airlines ranked by market capitalization. It shows the airline's flag, logo, name, and corresponding market cap value in billions of dollars. The infographic also includes a world map as a backdrop.

info.title: World's Biggest Cocoa Producers in 2022
info.description: The infographic visualizes the world's biggest cocoa producers in 2022, measured in tonnes. It uses a treemap-like structure where the size of each rectangle represents the production volume of a country or region. Each region (Africa, Asia, South America/Caribbean) is segmented to show each country's contribution to the global cocoa production.

info.title: Estimated Drinking Water and Wastewater Infrastructure Needs and Funding Sources for FY2017 and FY2018
info.description: The infographic presents the estimated drinking water and wastewater infrastructure needs and their funding sources for fiscal years 2017 and 2018. It visualizes the proportion of funds coming from different sources for both drinking water and wastewater projects.

info.title: The European Union's Energy Dependency
info.description: This infographic visualizes the EU-27's energy dependence and its top import partners. It includes a map showing energy dependency percentages for each country, as well as charts breaking down the sources of crude oil, solid fuel (coal), and natural gas imports.

info.title: How Far Can You Go With One Barrel Oil?
info.description: This infographic illustrates the distance various vehicles (motorbikes, cars, trucks, boats, and airplanes) can travel on the fuel derived from one barrel of oil.

info.title: Breaking Down the Cost of an EV Battery Cell
info.description: An infographic detailing the cost breakdown of a lithium-ion battery cell used in electric vehicles, showing the percentage costs associated with cathode, manufacturing and depreciation, anode, separator, electrolyte, and battery housing.

info.title: Business Growth and Opportunity
info.description: An illustration depicts a bar chart overlaid with a curved arrow indicating growth. The final bar transitions into an open door, through which a person points towards the arrow, symbolizing opportunity and success.

info.title: Ramen Calories Comparison
info.description: An infographic comparing the calorie content of different ramen chain restaurants. It uses a bar chart to display the calorie counts for each restaurant's ramen, accompanied by images of ramen and the restaurant logo.

info.title: Proven Natural Gas Reserves by Country (as of 2021)
info.description: This infographic shows the proven natural gas reserves by country as of 2021. The total world reserves amount to 188.1 trillion cubic meters. The reserves for each country are represented as a portion of the total amount, shaped like a gas container.

info.title: Oil Production by Country in 2021
info.description: This infographic visualizes global oil production by country in 2021, measured in thousands of barrels per day. It uses a modified bar chart to represent the oil production of each country and region, and also provides additional information about OPEC and non-OPEC countries.

info.title: The World's Busiest Ports
info.description: An infographic showing the top 50 container ports in the world, by volume in million TEU (2016), with additional information on share of volume by region.

info.title: The World's Top 10 Nickel Mining Companies
info.description: This infographic presents the world's top 10 nickel mining companies based on 2020 production and market capitalization. It also provides insights into the use of nickel in batteries and the geographical distribution of nickel resources.

info.title: Smoking Awareness Survey
info.description: This infographic presents the results of a survey on awareness and attitudes towards smoking, broken down by gender. It includes data on smoking prevalence, opinions on second-hand smoke, and perceptions of smokers.

info.title: Religion Distribution in a Hypothetical World Village of 100 People
info.description: This infographic visualizes the distribution of different religions in a hypothetical world village consisting of 100 people. The data is presented in a simplified manner, showing the number of people belonging to various religious groups, as well as those identifying as others or atheists, using a candle flame as the metaphor of the amount of followers.

info.title: Largest Coal Companies in the World
