info.description: The infographic visualizes the largest coal companies in the world, ranked by market capitalization. It uses a creative visual metaphor of coal carts on a train track to represent each company's value.

info.title: Products Made from a Barrel of Crude Oil (Gallons)
info.description: The infographic shows the different products that can be made from a barrel of crude oil, measured in gallons, and the corresponding amount for each product.

info.title: Web Trend Map 2007/V2
info.description: An infographic illustrating the web trend in 2007, showing the connections between various websites, platforms, and services. The infographic uses a network-like structure to represent relationships and relative importance, categorized by type (sharing, tools, technology, know-how, moneymaker, news, social news, community, design, movies, music, Chinese line, connections, political blogs) with subjective metrics.

info.title: Obesity Rates by Country
info.description: An infographic illustrating the percentage of the population older than 15 with a body-mass index greater than 30 in various countries, using stylized figures with national flag colors.

info.title: Who owns who in the automotive industry
info.description: This infographic depicts the ownership and relationships between various car manufacturers globally. It uses a subway-style map to illustrate engineering links, manufacturer lines, shareholder interests, major group relationships, and joint ventures. Key players like Ford, GM, Toyota, and DaimlerChrysler are highlighted along with their respective subsidiaries and partnerships.

info.title: Software Wars
info.description: The infographic visualizes the "Software Wars" landscape in 2006, portraying the competition and relationships between various software companies and products. It uses a war metaphor to illustrate the market dynamics, with arrows representing attacks and influences between different entities.

info.title: LEGO Brick 50th Anniversary Timeline
info.description: This infographic shows the timeline of LEGO brick's 50th anniversary.

info.title: Google PageRank Explained
info.description: This infographic explains Google's PageRank algorithm using a mountain climbing metaphor. It depicts the ranking of different websites, from 0 to 10, based on their level of effort. The ranking is also categorized into levels from 'Below Average' to 'Elite'.

info.title: California Dieting Reasons
info.description: This infographic uses the California flag as a visual metaphor to illustrate the percentage of people in California who diet for different reasons, including symbolic acts against consumerism, health reasons, peer influence, and the desire to look good on YouTube.

info.title: SEO Crawlability Issues
info.description: The infographic illustrates common SEO crawlability issues, visually representing how a search engine spider encounters problems while crawling a website. It highlights issues such as unfriendly SEO-CMS systems, orphan pages, bad server configurations, session-based coding, cloaking and no error handling. The spider represents the crawler and the connected dots represent pages of the websites, and the dotted lines between the circles represents the links that the spider follows.

info.title: World Map Made of App Icons
info.description: An image of a world map constructed entirely from various app icons. The icons are arranged to represent the shapes of the continents and oceans.

info.title: New York by Walkman: A Musical Subway Map
info.description: An infographic presenting a stylized map of the New York City subway system, with each station named after a different musical artist, presumably representing a connection or inspiration associated with the artist and the city.

info.title: Vampire Energy
info.description: This infographic illustrates the energy consumption of household appliances in standby mode, often referred to as "vampire energy." It presents a bar chart comparing the kilowatt hours used annually and the associated costs for various devices, distinguishing between passive and active standby modes.

info.title: Breakdown of Average Student Budget
info.description: This infographic illustrates the breakdown of an average student's budget, including tuition fees, room and board, books, and other expenses. It also shows data about student income, credit card debt, and ownership of electronic devices.

info.title: Total Daily Intake of Media
info.description: The infographic shows the breakdown of a typical person's total daily media intake of 9 hours, categorized into gaming, social networking, news, microblogging, and entertainment.

info.title: The Best Movies of All Time Map
info.description: This infographic visualizes a curated list of the best movies of all time, presented in a map-like format. Movies are arranged along colored lines representing different genres and themes, with key film titles and their release years. The infographic uses a subway map metaphor, indicating connections and relationships between films across different categories.

info.title: The Top 8 of 2008 CEO Compensation
info.description: The infographic displays the top 8 highest paid CEOs in 2008, comparing their compensation with how many minimum wage earners their salary could support.

info.title: Christmas by the Numbers
info.description: This infographic presents data and facts about Christmas, covering topics such as Christmas tree harvesting, holiday spending, and the impact of LED lights, as well as some historical origins.

info.title: Historical Spread of Smallpox and Leprosy
info.description: This infographic visualizes the historical spread of smallpox and leprosy across the globe, along with key events related to malaria. It uses a world map to show the movement of these diseases through time, connecting locations with lines indicating their paths of transmission and featuring descriptions alongside key events in time.

info.title: My Visual Mapping Blogroll
info.description: This infographic represents a subway-style map of blogs related to cartography of information and visual mapping, categorizing them into different themes and topics.

info.title: Don't Flush Your Credit Down the Drain
info.description: This infographic illustrates the consequences of not paying credit card bills on time, showing how many days late a payment is and how that impacts your credit score.  It uses a pipeline metaphor to visually represent the downward spiral of credit scores as payments are increasingly delayed.

info.title: 5 Year CD vs 1 Year Rollover CD vs CD Ladder
info.description: This infographic visually compares the growth of investments using three different strategies: a 5-year CD, a 1-year rollover CD, and a CD ladder. The graphic represents each strategy as a building, with each year's interest accumulation shown as a step on a ladder. The infographic highlights the benefits of setting up a CD ladder for higher interest rates.

info.title: Underskin: Human Anatomy as a Subway Map
info.description: This infographic presents the human body's anatomical systems as a subway map. Different systems such as arterial, CNS, digestive, lymphatic, muscular, respiratory, urinary, and venous are represented by different colored lines. Key organs and anatomical locations are depicted as stations along these lines.

info.title: The Shocking Disparities of Labor Cost
info.description: This infographic visually compares how long it takes to earn the USA annual minimum wage in different countries around the world. The data is presented as the number of months/years required to earn $15,080 (USA annual minimum wage) in each country. The infographic uses the size of the triangle (road sign) to represent the difference between minimum wages around the world.

info.title: Map of All Yahoo! APIs and Services
info.description: This infographic presents a map-like diagram illustrating the connections and relationships between various Yahoo! APIs and services. It uses a network-like structure with lines connecting different services to show their interdependencies.

info.title: Subway Science: A whistle-stop journey through modern science
info.description: This infographic depicts a subway-style map representing the history of modern science. Each subway line represents a different scientific discipline, and the stations along the lines represent prominent scientists in that field. The map extends from the 16th century to the 21st century.

info.title: The 2010 Social Networking Map
info.description: An infographic representing the landscape of social networking sites and other internet points of interest in 2010, visualized as a map where the size of each area corresponds to the estimated number of users.

info.title: The most widely spoken languages and the countries they are spoken in
info.description: The infographic illustrates the most widely spoken languages and the countries where they are spoken, using a subway map metaphor. The lines represent languages, and the stations represent countries. The number of speakers worldwide is also provided for each language.

info.title: Web 2.0 Points of Control: The Battle for the Network Economy
info.description: This infographic visualizes the landscape of the Web 2.0 era as a map, with different regions representing key sectors and companies within the network economy. Each region is named to represent a category of business or a sector, and logos of respective companies are placed within those regions. The map also includes thematic elements like seas and mythical creatures, adding a cartographic feel.

info.title: Brazilian Presidential Elections: Twitter Analysis
info.description: This infographic visualizes the Twitter activity surrounding the Brazilian Presidential Elections in August 2010. It tracks the mentions of candidates Dilma and Serra over time, highlighting key events such as TV debates and news appearances, and indicating the volume of tweets associated with each candidate.

info.title: Halloween Report
info.description: An infographic providing information about the history of Halloween, facts about pumpkin production, and candy corn consumption.

info.title: The Blog Tree
info.description: An infographic in the shape of a tree that visualizes popular blogs related to marketing and technology. The leaves of the tree represent individual blogs, grouped into categories such as Personal Branding, News, How To, Venture Capital, and Social Media. The roots show the most important websites.

info.title: Evolution of the Cell Phone
info.description: The infographic illustrates the evolution of the cell phone from 1985 to 2020, showcasing key features introduced over time. It also humorously depicts the difference between battery expectations and reality with cell phones.

info.title: Tech Company Hierarchy
info.description: A cartoon infographic depicting the hierarchical structure of various tech companies including Amazon, Google, Facebook, Microsoft, Apple, and Oracle. Each company's structure is visually represented as a node-link diagram, illustrating the relationships between different levels or departments. The diagrams incorporate humorous elements and visual metaphors that caricature the company's perceived culture or organizational style.

info.title: The Apple Tree: Apple Product Timeline
info.description: This infographic visualizes the timeline of Apple products, from 1976 to 2011, represented as branches of a tree. Each branch corresponds to a specific year and displays the products released during that year.

info.title: Outbreak: Deadliest Pandemics in History
info.description: This infographic illustrates the deadliest pandemics in history, showcasing diseases like measles, HIV/AIDS, smallpox, and the Spanish Flu. It provides information on the death toll for each pandemic, a brief description of the disease, and some of the symptoms associated with them.

info.title: Cycling Injuries Revealed
info.description: This infographic provides information about cycling injuries, including common injury locations, reasons people ride bikes, common places to ride, helmet facts, and statistics on traumatic brain injuries among cyclists.

info.title: The Blog Tree - New Growth
info.description: An infographic depicting a tree whose leaves and roots represent different blogs categorized by their blog level score and persona/category, respectively. The tree trunk represents established companies and design/data, indicating a metaphorical growth and connection of various elements within the blogging ecosystem.

info.title: The future of loyalty is social
info.description: This infographic shows how frequent flyers use social media, based on a study of people who fly at least 5 times a year. It breaks down which social media platforms frequent fliers use the most, their level of participation on those platforms, and how likely they are to follow or like airlines on Twitter and Facebook.

info.title: U.S. Oil Usage and Global Consumption
info.description: This infographic visualizes U.S. oil usage, including sources of imports and domestic production, where the oil goes, and a comparison of global daily oil consumption by country.

info.title: Oh, The Horror! An Ode To Horror Cult Classics
info.description: This infographic visualizes the movie budget, box office revenue, and Rotten Tomatoes critic's rating for a selection of influential horror films, categorized by genre.

info.title: Global Carbon Emissions by Country
info.description: This infographic illustrates the percentage of global carbon emissions produced by India, China, and the USA. The emissions are visually represented as smoke clouds shaped like each country over a factory, with percentage values included.

info.title: Global Hotel Price Changes H1 2010 vs H1 2011
info.description: The infographic displays global hotel price changes comparing the first half of 2010 with the first half of 2011 in major cities around the world. It uses a radial bar chart to illustrate the percentage increase or decrease in hotel prices, and includes additional text to highlight specific regions and factors affecting price fluctuations, such as economic crises and currency exchange rates.

info.title: Most Requested EMR Software Platform
info.description: This infographic shows the market share of different EMR software platforms in 2011, represented by a syringe filled proportionally to the market share each platform holds. Windows is the most popular platform with 61% market share, while other platforms like Apple, Linux, and cloud-based systems have smaller shares.

info.title: The Definitive Guide to Biscuit Dunking
info.description: This infographic presents research on the optimal dunking time for various biscuits in tea or coffee, indicating the risk of sogginess and potential "floppage." It features a circular visualization with biscuit types arranged around a central cup, along with a rating scale represented by emoticons.

info.title: Streamlining Your Digital Life with the New iPad
info.description: This infographic illustrates the evolution of portable electronic devices leading up to the iPad, showcasing how the iPad consolidates the functions of various gadgets. It also includes a section on how consumers spend their time on the iPad and an estimated value of devices consumers may trade in to subsidize the cost of a new iPad.

info.title: Eagle Scouts Among Astronauts
info.description: This infographic visualizes the presence of Eagle Scouts among astronauts, highlighting the proportion of astronauts who were Eagle Scouts and Boy Scouts. It also includes a word cloud of notable Eagle Scouts and their associated character traits, linking the achievements of astronauts to the values instilled by the Boy Scouts of America.

info.title: Android App Developer Survey
info.description: This infographic presents data from a survey of Android app developers. It visualizes the distribution of independent developers versus companies, the number of people working in their company, and the number of apps published by the developers.

info.title: Travellers and Mobile Technology
info.description: This infographic presents data related to how travellers are using mobile technology. It includes statistics on smartphone usage, Wi-Fi connectivity, flight information access, and social media engagement in the travel industry.

info.title: The Union and The Union Flag
info.description: This infographic visually represents the historical formation of the United Kingdom through a timeline-like diagram illustrating the union of England, Scotland, Wales, and Ireland. It also shows the evolution of the Union Flag and discusses its naming conventions.

info.title: Water Rich vs. Water Poor Lifestyles
info.description: This infographic compares and contrasts water consumption and related issues between "water-rich" and "water-poor" lifestyles. It highlights the amount of water used in everyday items and activities in developed countries, and contrasts that with the struggles faced by communities with limited access to clean water, including the health and economic burdens.

info.title: America's New Minority: The Writing is on the Fence for the GOP
info.description: This infographic illustrates the shift in the American electorate, focusing on the declining percentage of white voters/population from 1980 to 2050. The infographic presents presidential election voter turnout data from 1980 to 2012 and US Census population projections from 2020 to 2050. The data is presented in a visually engaging manner, using a fence metaphor to highlight the changing demographics.

info.title: Geosocial Universe 3.0
info.description: An infographic showing the relative sizes and mobile usage of different social media platforms as of February 2013. Platforms are arranged along a vertical axis representing decreasing size, with their user counts and percentage of mobile users displayed.

info.title: Pie Chart of Pie Images Sliced by Flavor
info.description: This infographic presents a pie chart illustrating the distribution of 85,748 images of pie, categorized by flavor. The pie chart is visually represented as an actual pie, with each slice corresponding to a different flavor. It is designed for Pi Day.

info.title: Ink Costs More Than Human Blood
info.description: An infographic comparing the cost per milliliter of various liquids, including ink, human blood, penicillin, and other common substances, visualized using syringes filled to varying levels to represent cost.

info.title: Speed Comparison Chart
info.description: The infographic is a speed comparison chart showing the maximum speeds of different man-made objects, ranging from the Apollo 10 capsule to the motorway speed limit. It compares these speeds against a linear scale in MPH, with descriptive text providing additional context for each entry.

info.title: The History of Music Media: From Vinyl to Bitstream
info.description: This infographic visualizes the evolution of music media formats from vinyl to bitstream over time (1980-2012). It shows the changing prevalence of various formats such as LP/EP, Cassette, CD, downloads, and streaming over the years.

info.title: Periodic Table of Alcohol
info.description: This infographic presents a periodic table of alcoholic beverages, categorizing various cocktails and drinks based on their ingredients and types. It includes illustrations, names, alcohol percentages, and the year of creation for each beverage, grouped by base spirits like cider, mixed beer, wine, brandy/cognac, vodka, whiskey, rum, gin, and liqueurs. The infographic is organized in a table format and includes a key explaining the graphical elements.

info.title: Life Expectancy at Birth by Country (2013)
info.description: An infographic showing the average life expectancy at birth for various countries in 2013, grouped by continent. The data is presented in a way that allows for easy comparison of life expectancies across different regions.

info.title: Mobile Shopping Locations
info.description: The infographic displays the percentage of women vs. men who shop via mobile at various locations: work, waiting room, class, and meeting.

info.title: Posting Dead Zones on Social Media
info.description: This infographic illustrates the worst times to post on various social media platforms, showing the specific time ranges when engagement is likely to be low. The graphic utilizes bar chart-like visualizations for each platform and incorporates a skeleton arm visual metaphor to represent 'dead zones'.

info.title: Popular Car and Truck Types in May 2012
info.description: The infographic visualizes the popularity of different car and truck types based on purchases made in May 2012. It displays percentages alongside car and truck type illustrations, showing the proportion of purchases for each category.

info.title: Missing Money: US National Debt
info.description: This infographic illustrates the growing US national debt from 1999 to 2013. It uses a bar chart to show the debt, surplus, and deficit over those years, with an image of Uncle Sam to emphasize the theme.

info.title: Old World Language Families
info.description: This infographic visualizes the relationships and historic spread of old world language families. It uses a tree diagram to show how different languages are related, and maps to illustrate their geographic distribution.

info.title: Music Visualization
info.description: A visualization of musical notes, represented as bars with heights corresponding to note intensity, positioned above a keyboard layout.

info.title: World War II Casualties (1942-1945)
info.description: This infographic visualizes the number of casualties during World War II from 1942 to 1945. It displays a timeline with casualty counts represented by figures, showing a significant increase in casualties during the later years of the war, and a decline when war ends.

info.title: Never BUI: Boating Under the Influence
info.description: This infographic highlights the dangers of boating under the influence (BUI), focusing on the percentage of boating deaths caused by alcohol in the U.S. by region in 2014, as well as the comparison of boating deaths vs. alcohol-related boating deaths by region in 2014. The overall message encourages safe and sober boating.

info.title: Video Status on YouTube within 24 Hours of Upload
info.description: The infographic visualizes the status of videos on YouTube within 24 hours of being uploaded. It shows the percentage breakdown of videos that are taken down by users, have user accounts terminated, are taken down by right holders, are monitored or monetized, and those without any action taken.

info.title: Average Video Length by Category
info.description: This infographic visualizes the average video length for different content categories, presented in a clock-like format. The categories are arranged around the clock face, and the time given corresponds to the average video length in minutes and seconds.

info.title: Time Spent on Category Based on Daily Uploads
info.description: This infographic illustrates the distribution of time spent on various content categories, such as Gaming, Entertainment, and Education, based on daily uploads. It uses a visual metaphor of a laptop screen segmented into colored bars, each representing a different category, with corresponding percentage values indicating the proportion of time spent on each category.

info.title: Monetary Love for Moms: Spending Over Time
info.description: This infographic depicts the increasing monetary value associated with mothers over the years from 2005 to 2015. It uses a rainbow-shaped visualization to represent the yearly spending, indicating a general upward trend with some fluctuations, emphasizing that spending has reached an all-time high.

info.title: Mother's Day vs Father's Day Spending
info.description: This infographic compares spending habits for Mother's Day and Father's Day, highlighting the types of people who receive gifts, perceived expectations, and average spending.

info.title: A mostly complete chart of Neural Networks
info.description: The infographic presents a chart illustrating various types of neural network architectures. Each network type is depicted using a node-link diagram with different colored nodes representing different types of cells or layers within the network. The infographic includes a key explaining the meaning of each color, and is used to distinguish different types of input, hidden and output layers in the neural networks.

info.title: The Agile Landscape v3
info.description: This infographic presents an overview of agile development methodologies, frameworks, and related concepts, visualized as a subway-style map. It connects various approaches like Scrum, Kanban, Design Thinking, and DevOps along different lines, providing a high-level view of the agile landscape.

info.title: The Perfect Temperatures for Beers, Wine & Beverages
info.description: This infographic illustrates the ideal serving temperatures for a variety of beverages, including coffee, tea, wine, beer, and cider. It uses a visual thermometer to display the temperature ranges for each drink, alongside relevant quotes and advice on how to judge the best temperature for each category of beverage.

info.title: The winding path to victory
info.description: An infographic showing the path to victory in the US presidential election, with states arranged along a winding path to represent the electoral college votes needed to win. States at the ends of the path are expected to vote for one candidate by a large margin, while states in the middle are expected to be closer races. The infographic also shows the margin of victory for each candidate.

info.title: Which Countries Think WWIII is Coming?
info.description: This infographic visualizes survey data on the percentage of people in different countries who somewhat or strongly agree that a world conflict involving superpowers similar to World Wars I and II could occur in the next 25 years.

info.title: Nature Timespiral
info.description: This infographic illustrates the history of the Earth and the universe in a spiral timeline, marking major geological events, evolutionary milestones, and astronomical phenomena.

info.title: Humanity Today and Humanity's Past
info.description: This infographic visualizes the scale of current human population in the context of the overall human population throughout history. An hourglass represents all humans who have ever lived. The top portion contains green sand representing those alive today and those born each year. The bottom portion contains red sand representing those who have died. The infographic relates the total population to historical events and proportions of populations, such as those who have died.

info.title: Mahindra Group's Sectoral Distribution
info.description: This infographic illustrates the sectoral distribution of the Mahindra Group, showcasing the percentage contribution of different sectors such as Automobile & Auto Components, Information Technology, Financial Services, Realty, Consumer Services, and Capital Goods. The data is represented using a modified bar chart where the green section of the bar represents the percentage, placed on the bed of the truck.

info.title: Human Body Subway Map
info.description: This infographic presents a creative visualization of human anatomy as a subway map. Different organ systems are represented by different colored subway lines, mimicking the structure and connectivity of a transportation network. This analogy provides a unique and engaging way to understand the complex relationships within the human body.

info.title: Visualizing the World's Largest Copper Producers
info.description: This infographic visualizes the world's largest copper producers in 2021, showing production by country in million tonnes (MT). It includes a visual representation of production volume by country, key facts about Chile and China's copper industry and usage, and the source of copper in the United States. The visualization resembles a roll of copper wire sitting on a pallet.

info.title: U.S. Petroleum Consumption by the Numbers
info.description: The infographic illustrates the breakdown of U.S. petroleum consumption in 2022 by refined petroleum product. It visually represents the proportion of gasoline, diesel, hydrocarbon gas liquids, jet fuel, and other products in the form of a barrel.

info.title: How Big is the Oil Market?
info.description: This infographic compares the market size of crude oil with the combined market size of the top 10 metals, showing the production value in 2022.

info.title: A Breakdown of Americans' Credit Card Spending
info.description: This infographic visualizes a breakdown of Americans' credit card spending by month across various categories such as travel, general merchandise, restaurants, groceries, clothing/shoes, home improvement, healthcare, online services, entertainment, and gas. It also highlights the areas where Americans have reduced spending during the pandemic.

info.title: Oil Infographic Elements
info.description: This infographic provides various charts and elements related to the oil industry, including line graphs, pie charts, icons, and a world map indicating locations of interest. It uses a monochrome color scheme.

info.title: La France monarchique
info.description: This infographic showcases a selection of events in French history from the end of antiquity to the French Revolution. It uses a spiral timeline to display historical events, key figures, and cultural developments over the centuries.

info.title: How Long Do Animals Live?
info.description: The infographic illustrates the average lifespan of various animals, categorized by type (mammals, birds, other vertebrates, and invertebrates), and positioned along a timeline ranging from 0 to 150 years.

info.title: Budget 2015-16: Where the Money Goes
info.description: An infographic detailing the Hong Kong budget for 2015-16, showing where the money comes from (revenue), where it goes (expenditure), financial statistics, and future saving plans.

info.title: Space Exploration Timeline vs. Plastic Straw Decomposition
info.description: This infographic visually compares the timeline of space exploration milestones to the decomposition time of a plastic straw. It uses a timeline to illustrate key moments in space history, drawing a parallel to the long duration it takes for plastic straws to decompose, highlighting the environmental impact.

info.title: Timeline of Communication Inventions vs. Straw Decomposition
info.description: This infographic illustrates a timeline of significant inventions in communication technology, juxtaposed with the decomposition time of a plastic straw. The timeline spans from 1447 (printing press) to 2004 (Facebook), while highlighting the 500-year decomposition time of a plastic straw.

info.title: The doping ranking
info.description: This infographic visualizes the ranking of cyclists accused of doping in the seven Tour de France races won by Lance Armstrong, from 1999 to 2005. It tracks the positions of various cyclists and indicates their doping status, using colored lines and icons to represent different categories of doping accusations.

info.title: Roller Coaster of the World
info.description: This infographic presents a ranking of the world's fastest roller coasters. It showcases the top 10 roller coasters, their location, speed, height, length, ride time, and country. The infographic uses visual elements to represent the speed, height, and length of each roller coaster, along with additional information regarding the evolution of roller coasters.

info.title: Top 20 Amusement Facilities in Japan
info.description: This infographic presents the ranking of top 20 amusement facilities in Japan based on annual attendance. It includes a timeline highlighting Tokyo Disneyland's attendance figures over the years, a bar chart showcasing the top 20 facilities, and annotations providing context and explanations.

info.title: U.S. History of Taxation on Cigarettes
info.description: This infographic shows the history of taxation on cigarettes in the U.S. from 2002 to 2010. The state and federal tax collections in billions of dollars are represented by the height of the cigarettes.

info.title: Population Density and Migration in Europe
info.description: The infographic shows two charts: The left chart displays the typical population densities in different countries and time periods. The right chart shows the migration patterns of important countries between 1920 and 1927, indicating the influx and outflux of people.

info.title: Pixar's Box Office Successes
info.description: An infographic depicting the box office earnings of Pixar films, visualized within the shape of Pixar's iconic lamp mascot. Each colored section represents a different movie, displaying its title, earnings, year of release, and awards received.

info.title: Argentina's Wine Production for the World
info.description: This infographic showcases Argentina's wine production and export statistics, including its position as a leading producer in South America, key export destinations, market distribution, primary wine types exported, and regional production breakdown.

info.title: Balance Infographic
info.description: This infographic illustrates the concept of balance using a see-saw analogy. Two sets of text and icons are positioned on either side of the see-saw, representing two different elements or factors being compared. The percentage values (75% and 25%) indicate their relative weight or importance.

info.title: How far can JPY 1000 bring you by taxi at world's major cities?
info.description: This infographic compares the taxi fares in major cities around the world, showing how far you can travel with 1000 Japanese Yen (JPY). It uses a visual representation of a road with different taxi types placed along it, indicating the distance each taxi can travel for that amount.

info.title: Life Satisfaction in Selected Countries
info.description: This infographic presents the life satisfaction scores of four countries (Switzerland, Austria, Germany, and Hungary) on a scale from 0 to 10. The data is visually represented using party favor tubes, where the height of each tube corresponds to the life satisfaction score of the respective country. The data is sourced from the OECD Better Life Index 2014.

info.title: Searches for Hangover Cure Throughout the Week
info.description: An infographic depicting the search volume for "Hangover Cure" throughout the week, visualized as a line graph. The line representing search volume is creatively extended to resemble a person vomiting, with a peak in searches on Sunday, presumably after weekend alcohol consumption.

info.title: Top 20 World Smoking Rates and Tobacco Prices
info.description: This infographic visualizes the top 20 countries by smoking rate alongside the price of a pack of Marlboro cigarettes. It uses a combination of a world map to show country locations and a bar chart to compare smoking rates and cigarette prices.

info.title: When Will 50% Of Politicians Be Female?
info.description: The infographic shows a line chart predicting the year when 50% of UK Members of Parliament (MPs) will be female. The vertical axis represents the percentage of female UK MPs, while the horizontal axis represents the year. The line is drawn in the shape of an arm.

info.title: Improved Quality of Life
info.description: This infographic illustrates how various initiatives, including energy efficiency, biomass and biofuels, carbon emissions reduction, advocacy, irrigation, and solar energy, contribute to improving the quality of life for 150,585,000 people.

info.title: The World: Facts, Trends, News about Super Bowl
info.description: This infographic illustrates facts, trends, and news related to the Super Bowl, covering ticket prices, economic impact, viewer spending, advertising costs, player bonuses, and ticket allocation.

info.title: When Americans Eat Pizza
info.description: This infographic illustrates when Americans eat pizza, using a pie chart where each slice of pizza corresponds to a meal occasion: Dinner, Lunch, Breakfast, and as a snack.

info.title: Pets Perishing On Planes
info.description: This infographic visualizes the number of pet deaths per 100,000 animals transported by different airlines (Hawaiian, United, Delta, American, Alaska). It uses a bar chart where each bar is represented by a series of drawn dogs. The data is presented on a grid paper background, adding to the casual, hand-drawn style.

info.title: Most Popular Dog Names in New York
info.description: This infographic presents the popularity of dog names in New York using an unusual bar chart where dog tails represent the bars. The height of each tail indicates the popularity of the corresponding dog name.

info.title: Olympic Medals Composition and Value
info.description: This infographic illustrates the metal composition of Olympic gold, silver, and bronze medals and their approximate monetary value.

info.title: Iranian Oil Importing Countries
info.description: This infographic illustrates the countries that import Iranian oil, showing the volume of exports and the percentage of Iranian crude in their imports. It also highlights countries with the largest proven oil reserves.

info.title: American Nose Jobs
info.description: This is a hand-drawn infographic on graph paper showing the number of nose job procedures performed in America. The visualization is an area chart where the area is shaped like a nose.

info.title: Greek GDP Per Capita
info.description: This infographic visually represents the GDP per capita of Greece over time, using a hand-drawn style. It plots the data on a simple grid, with the years (2002, 2006, 2010, 2014) along the x-axis and GDP per capita (in thousands of dollars) along the y-axis. A drawing of a diver's body is used to represent the decline of the GDP, metaphorically.

info.title: Niqab Fines in France (2011-2015)
info.description: The infographic represents the number of niqab fines in France from 2011 to 2015. The visualization is in the shape of a niqab, using the area of the shape to represent the number of fines.

info.title: Creative Salaries for 2012
info.description: This infographic visualizes the average salaries for various creative roles (Creative Director, Art Director, Graphic Designer, Interaction Designer) in 2012, based on years of experience.

info.title: Estimated Number of People in Washington: Donald Trump's Inauguration vs. Women's March Protest
info.description: This infographic compares the estimated number of people in Washington during Donald Trump's inauguration on January 20 and the Women's March protest on January 21, using hand drawings with different sizes that are in coordination with a scale on the y axis.

info.title: America Is Not America
info.description: This infographic illustrates the impact of excluding immigrants, people of color, and women on the American population. It uses a bar chart overlaid on an American flag to visualize the percentage of U.S. adults that each group represents.

info.title: Nukes Ready to Fly
info.description: This infographic visualizes the number of immediately available nuclear weapons of several countries. It shows the launchers and warheads for the United States, Russia, United Kingdom, France, Israel, Pakistan, China, and India, using a concentric radial layout to represent the quantities.

info.title: The Rise Of The Right
info.description: The infographic depicts the rise of right-wing parties in European Parliament elections. It uses hand illustrations to represent the percentage of votes each party received, with longer hands indicating a higher percentage.

info.title: Where People Die
info.description: This infographic visualizes the places where people die, represented as percentages. The data is shown using a bar chart with buildings and vehicles illustrating each location: Hospital Inpatient, Home, Nursing Home, All Other Places, and Emergency Room.

info.title: Average Age of Motherhood & Fatherhood
info.description: The infographic compares the average age of motherhood (26 years) and fatherhood (31 years) with illustrations.

info.title: The Washer Paradox
info.description: This infographic humorously depicts the disparity between the time spent on washing and drying clothes versus the time spent waiting for someone to empty the washing machine. The washing machine graphic uses color to visually represent these two different time periods.

info.title: For Every $1 A White Man Earns...
info.description: This infographic visualizes the gender and racial wage gap, demonstrating how much different demographic groups earn compared to a white man's dollar, using actual dollar bills to represent the amounts.

info.title: Emissions Ranking of Vehicles
info.description: The infographic provides a ranking of vehicle emissions (gCO2/km) for different types of cars. It also displays the evolution of European emission objectives and the cost of energy for 100km in the city for combustion and electric engines. Furthermore, it illustrates the charging point availability in several cities.

info.title: Changes in Global Beer Consumption
info.description: This infographic presents changes in global beer consumption by region and country between 2002 and 2012. It uses a beer mug metaphor, where the size of the mug represents total global consumption, and bubbles within the mug represent national consumption of top 12 countries.

info.title: U.S. Historical Rates of Cigarette Consumption
info.description: This infographic presents the historical rates of cigarette consumption in the U.S. from 2001 to 2010. It uses a visual representation of cigarettes to show the number of cigarettes consumed each year, with the height of the cigarette stack corresponding to the consumption rate.

info.title: Our Weather: Comparing London and New York
info.description: An infographic comparing the rainfall and temperature extremes of London and New York.

info.title: The Rise of Tablets in Small Businesses
info.description: An infographic showing the increasing adoption of tablets in small businesses, the reasons for adoption, and the features that are most important to small businesses.

info.title: Spilling the History of Heinz Ketchup
info.description: This infographic presents a timeline of key events in the history of Heinz Ketchup, starting from 1844 to present day. It visually represents the progression of the company, its products, and marketing milestones.

info.title: Too Late to Start? Startup ages of world's top 2000 company CEOs
info.description: This infographic illustrates that it's never too late to start a business. It presents a timeline of life, highlighting "quarter-life crisis" and "mid-life crisis", and then shows the ages at which various CEOs of top global companies started their ventures. It starts with Mark Zuckerberg at 19 and then shows many other CEOs and their starting age.

info.title: Composition of Genius
info.description: This infographic is a humorous illustration depicting the different components that contribute to genius, such as inspiration, perspiration, improvisation, aspiration, contemplation, exploration, daily frustration, imitation, desperation, and pure elation. The infographic uses illustration and percentage values.

info.title: Geologic Timeline: Human Hand Perspective
info.description: This infographic presents a geologic timeline visualized as a human hand, showing major events and eras in Earth's history from the Proterozoic Eon to the present day.  Events like the emergence of Eukaryotic single-celled organisms, the Cambrian period, the age of dinosaurs, mass extinctions, ice ages, and the emergence of humans are depicted within the context of the timeline, represented by the length of the hand and its fingers.

info.title: Evolution: life on Earth is one big extended family
info.description: This infographic shows the evolution and diversity of life on Earth, illustrating how all living things are related through common ancestry. It features a visual representation of life's family tree, tracing branches back through time and highlighting major evolutionary events and mass extinctions.

info.title: The History of Energy Transitions
info.description: This infographic illustrates the global primary energy consumption by source from 1800 to 2020, highlighting the shift in energy sources over time due to economic and technological advances.

info.title: Pizza Consumption in Germany
info.description: This infographic presents data on pizza consumption in Germany, including the most popular types of pizza, reasons for ordering pizza, where people eat pizza, and the average cost of pizza by region.

info.title: Aircraft Carriers by Country
info.description: The infographic visualizes the number of aircraft carriers operated by different countries. It divides the countries into NATO and non-NATO members, displaying each country's flag and the number of aircraft carriers in service.

info.title: Map of the World's Manufacturing Output in 2018
info.description: This infographic shows the manufacturing output of different countries in 2018, broken down by region (North America, Europe, Asia, Latin America, and Africa). The visualization includes a map where the manufacturing output of each country is visually displayed. The percentage share of manufacturing output of each region is also given.

info.title: The Top Cotton Producers 2022
info.description: This infographic presents the top cotton producing countries in 2022, highlighting their production in 1,000 metric tons. It also provides context about cotton's importance as an agricultural product, its water usage, and its role in global employment.

info.title: Telecom Companies Market Share as of March 31, 2023
info.description: This infographic displays the market share of various telecom companies in terms of wireless subscribers as of March 31, 2023. It uses a visual metaphor of telecom towers, with the height of the tower representing the market share percentage for each company (Jio, Airtel, VI, BSNL, Others).

info.title: Obesity in America
info.description: The infographic shows the adult obesity rates that could be reached by 2030 if current trajectories continue, focusing on the 13 states where rates could exceed 60%. The information is based on a 2012 report.

info.title: Petrol Pumps by Indian Company
info.description: This infographic illustrates the number of petrol pumps operated by various Indian companies. The data is represented visually using different sized and colored drop shapes, each corresponding to a specific company. The size of the drop represents the number of pumps; larger drops indicate more pumps.

info.title: A Graphic Depiction of Beer
info.description: This infographic provides a general overview of beer. It covers the history of beer brewing, the alcohol content of different beers, the difference between ales and lagers, and the effect of beer consumption on the human body.

info.title: All The Discovered Gold In The World in One Chart
info.description: This infographic presents data about the world's gold, including total above-ground gold stocks, identified underground reserves, and the distribution of gold across different sectors and countries. It quantifies the amount of gold mined, remaining reserves, and its allocation in various forms like jewelry, private investment, official holdings, bars, coins, and ETFs.

info.title: College Students Alcohol Consumption
info.description: The infographic shows the data of college students' alcohol consumption habits. It includes favourite alcoholic beverages, percentage of male/female blacking out, and the average number of drinks per week.

info.title: India's Top Courier Companies
info.description: An infographic showcasing the top courier companies in India, displaying their revenue and percentage change. The companies are visually represented as boxes stacked on a truck.

info.title: Fatal Police Shootings in 2015: A Washington Post Investigation
info.description: An infographic presenting findings from a Washington Post investigation into fatal police shootings in 2015, including the number of shootings, demographics of victims, and circumstances surrounding the incidents.

info.title: Crude Awakening: Countries Reliant on Libyan Oil
info.description: This infographic visualizes the dependence of various countries on crude oil imported from Libya, displaying the amounts in thousands of barrels per day. It highlights Europe as the most affected region and Italy as the biggest customer, while also providing context on Libya's crude oil production and the impact of unrest on its exports.

info.title: What You Should Know About Vegetarianism
info.description: This infographic provides a general overview of vegetarianism, including United States statistics, types of vegetarians, reasons for a vegetarian lifestyle, health risks on a vegetarian diet, and life expectancy statistics.

info.title: Cigarette Price Increase Survey
info.description: The infographic presents survey results on public opinion regarding a proposed increase in cigarette prices in Korea. It shows the percentage of people who agree, disagree, or are unsure about raising prices, broken down further by smokers and non-smokers, and also shows what they think would be a reasonable increase.

info.title: Rainfall and Water Sharing
info.description: This infographic visualizes and compares the average annual rainfall and average annual rainfall per capita in the world, Japan, and Greater Tokyo Area. It presents numerical data using simple visual representations.

info.title: Top 10 Coffee Consumption Ranking by Prefecture in Japan
info.description: This infographic visualizes the top 10 prefectures in Japan with the highest coffee consumption. It also shows a map of Japan with coffee cup icons representing the relative consumption in each prefecture. In addition, it shows the quantity of coffee purchased and expenditure in the top 10 prefectures.

info.title: Coral Reefs: The Dying Ecosystem
info.description: This infographic presents the decline of coral reefs over time, projecting the complete loss of all coral reefs by 2070. It highlights factors contributing to this decline such as rising temperatures, human interaction, and CO2 emissions.

info.title: Reported cases of forced disappearances
info.description: This infographic visualizes the number of reported cases of forced disappearances in different Latin American countries. The data is represented through proportionally sized triangles, arranged in a way that they form a face with tears.

info.title: A pathway towards a regenerative society
info.description: The infographic visualizes a conceptual pathway from a "Growth Economy" to a "Post Growth Economy", highlighting the transition through a "Degrowth Economy". It uses a roller coaster metaphor to represent the trajectory of global emissions and economic models over time.

info.title: Total Humanitarian Aid 2006-2008
info.description: This infographic visualizes the total humanitarian aid from government donors to recipient countries from 2006 to 2008. It presents the data using a combination of vertical bars indicating aid distribution to different countries, ranked by the amount received, and a bomb-shaped container to represent total aid. The filling within the 'bomb' denotes government donation, while the outer value represents Total humanitarian aid.

info.title: South Korea's Smartphone Addiction
info.description: This infographic illustrates statistics about smartphone usage and dependency in South Korea. It presents various data points related to how people use their smartphones, their feelings about being without them, and the physical effects of excessive use.

info.title: School Violence Survey
info.description: This infographic presents statistics and data related to school violence in Korea. It covers the prevalence of school violence, types of violence, locations where violence occurs, times when violence occurs, and responses to school violence.

info.title: Ballooning CEO Salaries and Mass Layoffs
info.description: This infographic compares CEO compensation and employee layoffs in top US firms during the recession (2008-2010). It visualizes CEO salaries as the size of hot air balloons and employee layoffs as the number of figures falling from the balloons, showing the disparity between executive pay and job losses. It also includes visualizations comparing CEO pay to unemployment benefits.

info.title: The Evolution of Energy Employment 2022-2030
info.description: This infographic depicts the projected changes in global energy employment by 2030, as estimated by the International Energy Agency (IEA) under a current policy scenario. It illustrates how the energy transition will lead to job creation in sectors like renewable energy and job losses in sectors like fossil fuels, highlighting the importance of worker support and education during this transition.

info.title: Lego Licensed Lines: Number of Sets vs. Revenue
info.description: This infographic visualizes the relationship between the number of Lego sets in various licensed lines, the company's total revenue, and the cost of licensing deals over time. It also shows the year each licensed line was introduced and the estimated cost to buy the whole line.

info.title: Less Taxing: Impact of GST in India
info.description: This infographic illustrates the potential impacts of implementing the Goods and Services Tax (GST) in India. It covers various aspects, including GST rates compared to other countries, expected GDP growth, benefits to specific sectors, and the government's compensation plan for states.

info.title: Water: A Resource That Needs to Be Conserved
info.description: This infographic presents information about global water consumption, water footprint, domestic water consumption in France, water resources, and uneven distribution of water across the globe.

info.title: The Quality of Drinking Water Around the World
info.description: An infographic visualizing the quality of drinking water around the world based on each country's EPI (Environmental Performance Index) score as given by Yale University. The infographic uses a map with circular nodes positioned on each country, sized and colored according to the water quality score, ranging from 'Least Safe' to 'Safest'.

info.title: How Much Water Do We Use?
info.description: The infographic uses a pie chart in the shape of a water droplet to display the percentage of water usage for different household activities. The data is from the American Water Works Association Research Foundation in 1999.

info.title: Water Footprint in Selected Asian Countries
info.description: This infographic visualizes the water footprint in selected Asian countries. It shows the geographic distribution of countries with circles sized according to their water footprint, and an additional visualization comparing the blue and gray water footprints for the industry sector in selected Asian countries.

info.title: Unilever: Levers of Change - Water
info.description: This infographic by Unilever highlights the company's efforts to conserve water and suggests ways for individuals to reduce their water consumption. It presents data on Unilever's initiatives in raw materials, energy, packaging, and transportation, as well as tips for consumers regarding washing, shampooing, renewables, and recycling.

info.title: The Global Water Footprint
info.description: An infographic illustrating the global water footprint, including the amount of freshwater available, water footprint per capita by country, countries most dependent on water imports, highest renewable water resources, and the water footprint of different foods.

info.title: Eco Infographics Elements
info.description: An infographic illustrating ecological trends from 1990 to 2020, featuring various charts and icons.

info.title: Tracking Carbon Emissions
info.description: This infographic presents a footprint comparison of total carbon dioxide emissions by nation and per capita. It utilizes bubble charts positioned on maps to represent the magnitude of emissions, with bubbles scaled according to emissions data. It juxtaposes two maps showing emissions by nation (total) versus emissions per capita.

info.title: Top 10 Countries with the Biggest Ecological Footprint Per Person
info.description: The infographic presents two bar charts, one showing the top 10 countries worldwide and the other showing the top 10 African countries with the largest ecological footprint per person. Each country is represented by a footprint icon with a number on top indicating the ecological footprint value. The flags of the countries are displayed beneath their names.

info.title: Post-Modernist Ideas of Philip Johnson
info.description: This infographic presents a timeline of Philip Johnson's life and career, highlighting his contributions to architecture and his embrace of post-modernism. It includes key events, quotes, and examples of his buildings.

info.title: Sales and Net Sales from 2003 to 2014
info.description: The infographic presents two bar charts illustrating sales in tons and net sales in million TRL from 2003 to 2014.

info.title: The Shocking Scale of Australia's Bushfires
info.description: This infographic visually compares the extent of areas burned by bushfires in different regions, specifically California in 2018, the Amazon in 2019, Siberian Fires in July 2019, and Australia in 2020.

info.title: Carbon Footprint Comparison for Different Transportation Modes
info.description: The infographic compares the carbon footprint of various transportation modes for a short-distance trip (350 miles) and a cross-city trip (20 miles). It shows the pounds of CO2 emissions for each mode, allowing for a visual comparison of their environmental impact.

info.title: EU imports of solid fuel by partner in 2014
info.description: This infographic shows the percentage of solid fuel imports to the EU by partner country in 2014, using piles of fuel to represent the quantities.

info.title: Top 10 Umaibo Flavors and Their Origin Places
info.description: An infographic showing the top 10 popular Umaibo (a Japanese puffed corn snack) flavors, their popularity percentage based on votes, number of votes, and the country of origin of each flavor. The visual uses bar charts and country flags.

info.title: Fracture Rates by Age Group
info.description: This infographic illustrates the percentage of arm fracture patients in various age groups over the past 5 years. It highlights a significantly higher incidence among the 10-20 age group compared to older demographics.

info.title: Hoki: Local and Sustainable
info.description: This infographic depicts the decline of Hoki fish by-catch numbers in New Zealand fisheries from 2001 to 2008. Each fish icon represents 100 units, showing a visual representation of the decreasing numbers over the years. The message promotes eating local Hoki fish to support sustainable practices.

info.title: Consolidated Net Profit and Production (2003-2014)
info.description: The infographic presents two bar charts illustrating the consolidated net profit (in million TRL) and the production (in '000 tons) of a company from 2003 to 2014. Each bar is filled with representative imagery to enhance visual appeal and context.

info.title: Elemental Composition of the Universe, Sun, Earth, Earth's Crust, and Seawater
info.description: This infographic illustrates the elemental composition of five different entities: the Universe, the Sun, the Earth, the Earth's crust, and seawater. Each entity is represented with a visual, and the percentage of various elements are listed. The visual metaphors show the relative abundance and importance of each element within its respective context.

info.title: The World's Thirst for Water Management
info.description: This infographic illustrates the global challenges and costs associated with water management, focusing on issues like leaky pipes, aging infrastructure, water waste, and increasing water usage in comparison to population growth.

info.title: What Makes Your Online B2B Marketing Footprint Unique?
info.description: This infographic illustrates the various components that contribute to a unique online B2B marketing footprint, highlighting the interconnectedness of different marketing strategies, platforms, and customer engagement tactics.

info.title: Influenza Vaccination Recommendation
info.description: This infographic provides information about influenza (the flu), including symptoms, when to get vaccinated, recommended vaccination targets, and vaccine supply.

info.title: Gluten in America
info.description: The infographic shows the amount of gluten in various food products, placed within a silhouette of a shopping basket, indicating gluten content levels in common foods consumed in America. It also notes that approximately 1% of Americans have Celiac Disease and that gluten is primarily found in wheat, barley, and rye.

info.title: Reported Cases of Infectious Diseases in Greece, 2016
info.description: This infographic presents data on reported cases of various infectious diseases in Greece up to 2016. It includes an overview of total cases over the years, cases by NUTS 2 region, diseases with zero reported cases, and trends for specific illnesses like influenza, viral meningitis, salmonellosis, tuberculosis, and malaria.

info.title: Income and Salt Intake in South Korea
info.description: This infographic illustrates the correlation between income level and salt intake in South Korea, as well as the prevalence of diabetes and hypertension among different income groups. It visualizes the average daily sodium intake (in mg) of the highest and lowest income groups, alongside the percentages of diabetes and hypertension prevalence in each group, implying that lower income is correlated with a higher prevalence of these diseases and high sodium intake.

info.title: Increasing Familicide Crimes
info.description: The infographic illustrates the increasing trend of familicide crimes, focusing on incidents of domestic violence, assault, intimidation, and arrest/imprisonment. It shows the number of crimes detected and the number of familicide perpetrators over the years. It also highlights the different categories of crimes such as assault, injury, intimidation, and arrest/imprisonment.

info.title: The Economic Winners and Losers of the Pandemic
info.description: This infographic presents a horizontal bar chart showing the GDP change in selected OECD countries between Q4 2019 and Q3 2021. The data highlights the economic impact of the pandemic, differentiating between countries that experienced growth (winners, shown in green) and those that faced decline (losers, shown in red).

info.title: Countries with Highest Gold Reserves
info.description: An infographic showing the countries with the highest gold reserves in 2023, visualized using stacks of coins to represent the amount of gold each country holds.

info.title: Country-wise Space Exploration Budget
info.description: An infographic visualizing the space exploration budget of different countries, represented by rockets scaled according to the budget size.

info.title: Countries with Highest Gold Reserves
info.description: This infographic shows a ranking of countries with the highest gold reserves, using stacked coins to represent the amount in metric tons (mt). The data source is World of Statistics, data as of 2023.

info.title: Taking on the world: UK exports in 2013
info.description: An infographic displaying the UK's exports in 2013, including the total exports, share of global trade over time, top export commodities, and top export markets.

info.title: Company Milestones
info.description: A timeline infographic depicting company milestones with a rocket launch metaphor, highlighting key years and corresponding achievements.

info.title: Navigating Market Volatility
info.description: Illustration depicting a person with an umbrella walking on a line graph that fluctuates with some clouds and lightning indicating risk and volatility.

info.title: Business Growth Illustration
info.description: This image depicts a man in a suit jumping across a bar chart that leads to an arrow pointing upward, symbolizing growth.

info.title: Growth and Progress Visualization
info.description: An infographic depicting a man climbing a ladder and drawing a line graph that shows an upward trend. It symbolizes progress, growth, and achievement.

info.title: Slow Progress/Growth
info.description: The infographic depicts a bar chart showing a decrease in values, with a businessman riding on a snail, symbolizing slow progress or growth.

info.title: Jumping over Growth Hurdles
info.description: This infographic depicts a businessman jumping from a trampoline over increasing bar chart columns, illustrating growth and overcoming obstacles. The image conveys the concept of using strategic tools or opportunities (represented by the trampoline) to achieve progress and success in a business or career.

info.title: The Internet Marketing Tree
info.description: This infographic uses a tree diagram to illustrate the various components and strategies involved in internet marketing. It starts from the roots representing research, strategy, branding, and content, which lead to web site development and design, and then branch out into different marketing channels such as email marketing, social media marketing, online advertising, and public relations.

info.title: Foreign Holders of U.S. Debt
info.description: The infographic illustrates the foreign holders of U.S. debt as of December 2022. It displays the amount of U.S. debt held by various countries and regions, including key details about changes in holdings and the impact of factors like the strengthening U.S. dollar.

info.title: Where Semiconductors Are Made
info.description: This infographic visualizes the global semiconductor manufacturing landscape by market share, highlighting the largest contract chip manufacturers and their geographical distribution. It shows the proportion of semiconductor production attributed to various regions and companies.

info.title: Countries Most Reliant on Coal
info.description: This infographic visualizes the reliance on coal as a percentage of total energy consumption for several countries as of 2022. The data is presented using a visually engaging approach with coal carts whose size is proportional to the coal percentage for each country.

info.title: Top Chocolate & Cocoa Companies Worldwide
info.description: The infographic presents a bar chart comparing the revenue of top chocolate and cocoa companies worldwide. The chart shows revenue in billions of US dollars, with chocolate bars stacked on top of the respective company's product packaging.

info.title: Petrol Prices Around the World
info.description: The infographic shows a horizontal bar chart-like visualization of petrol prices per liter in INR for different countries around the world as of September 18, 2023. The countries are listed vertically on the left, with their corresponding flag icons. The prices are displayed numerically on the right, and bars connecting the country names to the prices.

info.title: A Dollar's Worth: Purchasing Power of the U.S. Dollar
info.description: This infographic illustrates the decline in the purchasing power of the U.S. dollar over the past century, linking it to historical events, economic policies, and the cost of everyday goods.

info.title: Deforestation in the Americas
info.description: This infographic visualizes deforestation in the Americas, illustrating the amount of rainforest remaining and destroyed in different countries, along with the causes of deforestation.

info.title: Apple's Ecosystem
info.description: The infographic visualizes Apple's ecosystem and its influence beyond Macs, detailing various aspects such as Apple's share of AT&T's business, app designer earnings, and the impact of Apple devices on content consumption.

info.title: Economic Rebound
info.description: This infographic depicts an illustration of an economic rebound, where a businessman jumps from a trampoline (representing the economy) along an arrow pointing upwards, showcasing positive growth after a decline.

info.title: COVID-19 Impact: No School, No Food?
info.description: This infographic illustrates the impact of school closures during the COVID-19 pandemic on food security for children. It highlights the percentage of households with children who were food insecure in 2018, and the number of students living in households where they are unsure when they might get their next meal.

info.title: Battery Manufacturing Capacity by Country in 2022 and 2027
info.description: The infographic presents a comparison of battery manufacturing capacity by country for the years 2022 and projected 2027. It highlights the dominance of China and projects significant growth in battery production capacity.

info.title: The World's Largest Container Shipping Companies
info.description: An infographic showcasing the top 10 largest container shipping companies in the world. It uses container blocks to represent TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Units) capacity and ship icons to represent fleet size. Size comparisons with landmarks are used for scale.

info.title: Visualizing the World's Largest Iron Ore Producers
info.description: This infographic shows the iron ore production by country in 2021, measured in million tonnes. It highlights the largest producers like Australia, Brazil, and China, and provides additional information about iron ore mining and its uses.

info.title: The Addiction Tree
info.description: This infographic depicts different types of addictions using a tree metaphor. The root represents the underlying damage of shame, wounding, and division. The trunk branches out into different categories of addictions such as feeling, thought, activity, substance, and people addictions.  Each branch represents a specific type of addiction.

info.title: Who's the Best James Bond?
info.description: An infographic comparing the six actors who have played James Bond in official Eon films across eight categories. The infographic uses proportionally sized colored blocks within bar charts to represent different categories of statistics for each actor.

info.title: All the World's Carbon Emissions in One Chart
info.description: This infographic visualizes the global carbon emissions in 2017 by country, along with the share of global emissions in an individual's lifetime based on their age.

info.title: Do You Believe in the Santa Claus Rally?
info.description: This infographic explains the Santa Claus rally, which is a stock market rally that frequently occurs during the holiday season (the last five trading days of December and the first two of the New Year). It also shows the trends in recent years for the S&P 500 Santa rallies and the last week of trading.

info.title: America's Biggest Retailers: Global Retail Sales in 2022
info.description: This infographic presents the global retail sales of the biggest retailers in America for the year 2022. It uses a modified bar chart format to compare the sales figures of various companies, including Walmart, Amazon, Costco, Kroger, Home Depot, Target, CVS Health, Walgreens, Lowe's, Albertsons, Apple, Ahold Delhaize, Publix, Best Buy, and Aldi.  The infographic also provides additional context with short text blurbs about specific retailers.

info.title: European Sovereign Debt Crisis and Fukushima Nuclear Disaster
info.description: This infographic discusses the European Sovereign Debt Crisis of 2009 and the Fukushima Nuclear Disaster. It presents data about the debt-to-GDP ratio of several European countries involved in the debt crisis and the impact of the Fukushima disaster on various stock market indexes and earthquake magnitude.

info.title: Is Brexit the First of Many Dominoes?
info.description: The infographic presents data and analysis on the Brexit vote and its potential impact on other European countries. It includes the final vote tally, regional breakdowns of the vote, and an indication of which other countries might be considering a referendum. The infographic uses a combination of maps, bar charts represented with dominoes, and percentage values to convey information.

info.title: Uranium Market Analysis
info.description: This infographic analyzes the uranium market trends from 2011 to 2017, focusing on the U3O8 spot price and the URA Global X Uranium ETF. It highlights key events affecting the market, such as the Fukushima disaster, rollbacks in programs, and the US election.

info.title: China is Leading the Charge in Lithium-ion Battery Production
info.description: This infographic illustrates China's dominant role in the global lithium-ion battery megafactory landscape, particularly in the growth of battery production capacity from 2016 to 2020. It highlights the significant increase in China's battery production capacity compared to other countries and identifies key companies and regions driving this growth.

info.title: China's Debt Bomb
info.description: This infographic visualizes China's debt and its composition across different sectors compared to other countries like South Korea, USA, Germany and Canada. The infographic employs a stacked bar chart, creatively represented as missiles, to illustrate the total debt as a percentage of Debt-to-GDP, and breaks it down by Corporate, Households, Financial Institutions, and Government sectors.

info.title: China's Debt Bomb: The Risk of Non-Performing Loans
info.description: This infographic illustrates the escalating debt situation in China, specifically focusing on the risk posed by non-performing loans (NPLs). It contrasts official estimates with independent research to highlight the potential scale and impact of the problem on the financial system.

info.title: Community Solar Farms Taking Off in 2015
info.description: The infographic shows the trend of community solar farm capacity growth from 2010 to 2020. It features a line graph illustrating the total community solar capacity in Megawatts (MW) and the global share of US PV installations over the years. It also highlights the average annual installations before and after 2015.

info.title: The Companies Responsible for the Most Global Carbon Emissions
info.description: Infographic showing the top 20 companies responsible for the most global carbon emissions from 1965 to 2017, highlighting their cumulative contributions in megatonnes of CO2 equivalent.

info.title: Which Companies Dominate the Global Arms Trade?
info.description: This infographic presents data on the world's top defense companies by arms sales in 2016. It visualizes the top 10 companies, their arms sales figures, and relevant contextual information. It also includes information on arms transfers from 1950 to 2015.

info.title: Shrinking Market Caps: The Impact of COVID-19 on "BEACH" Stocks
info.description: This infographic illustrates the significant decline in market capitalization of "BEACH" stocks (Booking, Entertainment & Live Events, Airlines, Cruises & Casinos, Hotels & Resorts) due to the COVID-19 pandemic. It highlights the substantial loss in value for major companies within these sectors, comparing market caps from February 19, 2020, to March 24, 2020.

info.title: How Currency Impacts Your Investments
info.description: This infographic explains how the Canadian dollar's strength or weakness affects purchasing power and investments, particularly in relation to the U.S. dollar. It visualizes the impact on vacations, clothing purchases, and income in U.S. dollars, and shows the fluctuations in Canadian dollar value over time.

info.title: How Currency Impacts Your Investments
info.description: This infographic illustrates how currency exchange rates can affect the cost of investments, specifically focusing on the example of a US hotel for Canadians.

info.title: Christmas Gift Spending Research
info.description: This infographic visualizes the results of a survey asking single women in their 30s and 40s how much a man should spend on a Christmas gift if he wants to win their heart. The data is presented in a pie chart format, with each slice representing a different spending range and the corresponding percentage of respondents who selected that range.

info.title: Esports vs Sports: Comparing Esports Companies with the Big Leagues
info.description: An infographic comparing the valuations of major esports companies to the median and range of valuations for franchises in the NFL, NBA, MLB, and NHL. It highlights how esports is growing but still has a long way to go to match the established sports leagues in terms of value.

info.title: Palestinian Casualties in Gaza (Oct 6-26, 2023)
info.description: Infographic detailing the number of Palestinian casualties in Gaza from October 6-26, 2023. It breaks down the data by age group and gender. It also includes the percentage of babies and children killed.

info.title: Facebook's Volatile Year
info.description: The infographic illustrates the volatility of Facebook's stock market value throughout 2018, highlighting key events and their impact on the company's valuation.

info.title: Putting the Gen Z Unemployment Rate in Perspective
info.description: This infographic visualizes the unemployment rates of Gen Z (15-24 year-olds) compared to older generations (25-74 year-olds) in OECD countries, highlighting the significant gap between the two age groups, particularly in the context of the global pandemic.

info.title: Top 5 Jurisdictions by R&D Expenditure (2015)
info.description: The infographic displays the top 5 jurisdictions ranked by their Research and Development (R&D) expenditure in 2015. It uses stacks of money to represent the amount spent by each jurisdiction, which includes the United States, China, European Union, Japan, and South Korea.

info.title: Greece's Economy: Debt and GDP Analysis
info.description: This infographic illustrates Greece's economic problems, focusing on debt and GDP trends from 2001 to 2013, along with a breakdown of Greece's debt by creditor.

info.title: Five Strategies Jeff Bezos Used to Build Amazon & The Future for Amazon
info.description: This infographic presents five key strategies employed by Jeff Bezos in building Amazon, paired with insights into Amazon's future ventures. It showcases Bezos's strategic thinking, emphasizing innovation, risk-taking, and customer-centricity alongside Amazon's developments, with a timeline-like structure.

info.title: The 2015 Hedge Fund Rich List
info.description: This infographic depicts the performance of hedge fund managers since 2008, highlighting the decline in earnings and the minimum wage required to qualify for the Top 25 list.

info.title: History of Pandemics
info.description: An infographic showing the history of pandemics, their death toll, and the years they occurred. It plots major pandemics on a timeline, visually comparing their impact.

info.title: Top 10 Most Innovative Fintech Companies in 2015
info.description: This infographic presents the top 10 most innovative fintech companies in 2015, according to H2 Ventures and KPMG. The companies are displayed as buildings, ranked from 1 to 10. Each company includes its name, a brief description, and a flag representing its country of origin.
