info.title: Fintech Unicorns with the Highest Valuation
info.description: This infographic visualizes the top fintech unicorns with the highest valuation, expressed in billion-dollar startups. It displays the companies, their valuations, and the country of origin, represented by flags beneath each valuation.

info.title: The Cost of Text Message Scams in the U.S.
info.description: This infographic illustrates the financial losses incurred due to various types of text message scams in the United States. It presents the cost of different scam categories, such as investment advice, romance scams, business imposter scams, job scams and employment scams, government imposter scams, online shopping scams, prizes, sweepstakes, and fake check scams. The infographic employs visual elements to enhance understanding and highlight the financial impact of these scams, and uses a speech bubble metaphor to emphasize the text messaging aspect.

info.title: America's Student Debt by State
info.description: This infographic visualizes the student debt balance per capita in the United States. It uses a map to represent each state, with the states colored according to the student debt balance ranges. Specific values are given for each state.

info.title: Pensions Are Fading
info.description: The infographic illustrates the decline in private-sector workers covered by defined-benefit pension plans from 1974 to 2004.

info.title: Household Debt Increase (1972-2006)
info.description: The infographic illustrates the increase in credit card and revolving debt per household from 1972 to 2006. The visualization features a line with an arrow to show an increasing trend, numerical values, and an illustration of a person running, giving a visual representation of the rising debt.

info.title: Rising Healthcare Costs
info.description: This infographic illustrates the increase in health-care costs per household from 1972 to 2005, showing the rise in employer- and individual-paid insurance plus out-of-pocket spending.

info.title: Trends in Crime and Overseas Travel in Japan
info.description: This infographic presents two time-series datasets: the number of heinous crimes (murder, robbery, arson, rape) and the number of overseas travelers in Japan, both spanning from 1900 to 1990.

info.title: Global CO2 Emissions from 1900 to 1980
info.description: This infographic illustrates the increase in global CO2 emissions from 1900 to 1980. The size of the balloon being blown by a person represents the volume of emissions during different decades.

info.title: Japan's CO2 Emissions (Carbon Equivalent, 10,000 tons)
info.description: This infographic visualizes the trend of Japan's CO2 emissions in carbon equivalent tons from 1900 to 2020. The visualization uses cartoon drawings of cars with exhaust pipes representing the amount of CO2 emitted at different points in time.

info.title: International Tourism Receipts per $1,000 of GDP, Top 10
info.description: This infographic shows the top 10 countries with the highest international tourism receipts per $1,000 of GDP. Each country's name and tourism receipt amount are displayed next to its flag, which are depicted as stickers on a suitcase.

info.title: India Economy: Market Size - Current and Projected Growth
info.description: The infographic illustrates the current and projected growth of the Indian economy, focusing on online retail spending. It showcases the market size and e-commerce revenue growth between 2012 and 2016 in developed and emerging markets.

info.title: Accelerating the Evolution: The Road to Mainstream EV Adoption
info.description: This infographic presents findings from a Castrol study on the key challenges to mainstream electric vehicle (EV) adoption. It highlights the five critical challenges: price, charge time, range, charging infrastructure and vehicle choice, and presents data on consumer expectations and perceptions in each area. The infographic also shows the potential market size if these challenges are addressed.

info.title: U.S. Majors with the Highest Unemployment Rates
info.description: This infographic visualizes the top 10 U.S. college majors with the highest unemployment rates. It presents the majors ranked by unemployment rate alongside their underemployment rates, with a comparison to the average unemployment rate of college graduates.

info.title: Median Age of Countries by Continent
info.description: This infographic visualizes the median age of countries across different continents. Each country is represented by a line extending from its respective continental region, with the length of the line possibly indicating the median age. The infographic also highlights key facts about the age demographics of Africa, Asia, Europe, and North America.

info.title: What the Most Profitable Companies Make Per Second
info.description: This infographic visualizes the net income per second for the most profitable companies. The visualization uses a unique approach, showing the companies positioned around the perimeter of a clock-like graphic, with their corresponding annual net income represented as bars extending outwards. The companies are categorized by industry, indicated by color-coding. The ranking of the companies in Fortune 500 is also shown.

info.title: The Most Dangerous Cities in the U.S.
info.description: This infographic shows the most dangerous cities in the U.S. in terms of violent crimes per 1,000 residents, presenting the cities on a map.

info.title: Most Spoken Languages 2023
info.description: This infographic presents the most spoken languages in the world in 2023, ranked by the number of speakers. It uses speech bubble shapes to display each language, along with the number of speakers and the language name in English and its native script.

info.title: Human Evolution: From Protocells to People
info.description: This infographic illustrates the major milestones and key adaptations that have shaped the course of human evolution, showing how humans have emerged from 4 billion years of change, from protocells to contemporary humans.

info.title: Number of Pages in the Federal Tax Code
info.description: The infographic illustrates the increase in the number of pages in the Federal Tax Code over time, from 1913 to 2014. The data is represented by stacks of paper, where the height of each stack corresponds to the number of pages at that time.

info.title: Retail Apocalypse 2017
info.description: This infographic illustrates the increasing number of retail bankruptcies from 2010 to 2017, attributing it to the 'retail apocalypse' caused by the shift to online shopping. It uses a bar chart (represented by stacks of boxes) to visualize the number of bankruptcies each year, and includes a visual metaphor of a closed JCPenney store to emphasize the decline of brick-and-mortar retail.

info.title: Retail Investors' Most Popular Stocks
info.description: An infographic illustrating the top 10 stocks favored by retail investors year-to-date as of February 15, 2023, based on retail net flows. It uses proportionally sized circles to represent the amount of money invested in each stock.

info.title: Security Responsibilities Across Teams
info.description: This infographic illustrates how security responsibilities are distributed across different teams within an organization, focusing on roles such as CISO, DevOps, and Engineering. It presents the percentages of organizations that share security responsibilities across teams, or assign them to specific departments.

info.title: The Business of Airbnb
info.description: This infographic provides insights into the company's financials and unique business model. It visualizes the annual gross booking value, monthly bookings, number of listed rooms, and revenue and losses of Airbnb, as well as comparison to other competitors.

info.title: Decline in Oil Discoveries
info.description: The infographic shows the decline in oil discoveries since 1964 and the remaining types of oil reserves.

info.title: Wine Around The World
info.description: This infographic illustrates various aspects of the global wine industry, including consumption patterns, revenue generation by country, the origin of wine preferred in Canada, wine exporting/importing countries, the increase in Chinese vineyards, Indian taste for Argentinian wine, and the relationship between age and wine consumption.

info.title: Brand Value Growth of Tech Companies
info.description: The infographic visualizes the brand value increase of several tech companies from 2016-2017. The visualization uses rocket illustrations to represent the percentage change in brand value, with the height of the rocket corresponding to the percentage increase. The companies are Alibaba, Salesforce, Facebook, Amazon, Netflix, Tencent, and Samsung, along with their brand values in billions of dollars.

info.title: Tobacco Use Around the World
info.description: This infographic illustrates the prevalence of tobacco use across various countries, differentiating between male and female usage rates. It uses a scatter plot to represent the data, visually comparing tobacco consumption rates worldwide. The infographic also highlights countries with the highest and lowest rates.

info.title: Ranking the Top 50 Most Popular Fast Food Chains
info.description: An infographic showing the ranking of the top 50 most popular fast food chains in the U.S. based on 2019 sales. The chains are organized into categories (Snacks, Sandwiches, Pizza, Global, Chicken, Burgers) arranged like slices of a pizza, with higher ranking chains placed towards the middle.

info.title: The World's Largest Importers in 2022
info.description: An infographic depicting the world's largest importers by value in 2022. It highlights the top countries and their share of global imports, providing context about economic conditions and trade relationships.

info.title: U.S. Metro Markets with the Most Vacant Offices
info.description: An infographic showing the U.S. metro markets with the most vacant offices. It visualizes the change in vacancy rates from Q4 2019 to Q1 2023, highlights statistics related to office space obsolescence, national average vacancy rates, and the drop in new supply of office real estate.

info.title: U.S. Consumer Debt Approaches $16 Trillion
info.description: The infographic shows the trend of U.S. consumer debt from 2003 to Q4 2021, focusing on housing debt and non-housing debt, as well as a breakdown of non-housing debt into credit card, auto loan, other, and student loan categories.

info.title: Falling Births in Japan
info.description: The infographic visualizes the trend of falling births and rising deaths in Japan from 2013 to 2023. It uses a bar chart style representation, with the top section showing the decreasing number of births and the bottom section showing the increasing number of deaths.

info.title: Social Media Universe 2020
info.description: This infographic visualizes the landscape of social media networks, representing each platform as a planet based on monthly active users (MAUs) in 2020. It highlights the dominance of Facebook and other major platforms, and also includes smaller social networks. The size of each "planet" corresponds to the number of users.

info.title: The Largest Producers of Natural Gas
info.description: This infographic visualizes the largest producers of natural gas in the world, showing their production in billion cubic meters in 2021. It also highlights some of the key factors affecting the natural gas market, such as the war in Ukraine. The visualization uses a wheel-like structure to present the data.

info.title: Valuation of Unicorn Companies Around the World
info.description: This infographic visualizes the distribution and valuation of unicorn companies (startups valued at over $1 billion) across different countries. The size of the circles represents the company's valuation, and the colors represent the industry they operate in. The map shows the geographical distribution of these unicorns.

info.title: The Race to $1 Trillion
info.description: An infographic illustrating the market capitalization of top automakers and their 'race' to reach a $1 trillion valuation. It uses a road-like metaphor to show the current standings of each company, with Tesla leading the race.

info.title: The Nebula of NES Games
info.description: An infographic illustrating the timeline of Nintendo Entertainment System (NES) games released between 1985 and 1996, categorized by genre and presented in a spiral arrangement, resembling a nebula. Each point on the spiral represents a game, with the distance from the center loosely correlating with its release year. Genres are color-coded.

info.title: Unemployment by Industries, 1932
info.description: The infographic visualizes unemployment rates across various industries in 1932, using isotype symbols to represent the percentage of workers employed and unemployed in each sector.

info.title: BOOOOOOOOOOM!: A Breakdown of the Explosions in Michael Bay's Films
info.description: This infographic visualizes the number of explosions in Michael Bay's films using a pie chart. Each slice represents a movie, and the size of the slice corresponds to the number of explosions.

info.title: Time Management: Freshman Year and Beyond
info.description: This infographic provides advice on time management for college students, contrasting high school and college time structures. It visualizes how the average student spends their 168 hours per week and gives general advice for time management.

info.title: Startups in Italy
info.description: This infographic visualizes the number of startups generated in various Italian cities since 2008. It also breaks down the startups by industry sector.

info.title: Decapitated Animals Found in New York Parks (2004-2014)
info.description: This infographic depicts the number of decapitated animals found in New York parks between 2004 and 2014. The data is visualized using a modified bar chart where the height of the 'blood' represents the count for each animal type: Chickens, Pigeons, Goats, Squirrels and Cats.

info.title: Streaming Platforms: US Subscribers in 2027
info.description: Infographic visualizing the projected number of US subscribers for various streaming platforms in 2027. The data is presented in a treemap format, where the size of each rectangle corresponds to the number of subscribers. The infographic is designed to resemble a television set.

info.title: Gender (In) Equity: Gender Equity Index 2012
info.description: This infographic visualizes the gap between women and men in education, economy, and political empowerment per country, using data from the 'Gender Equity Index 2012'. The chart uses an artistic approach by overlaying a bar chart on an image of a woman's face, visually representing the subject matter.

info.title: NFI Bike MS City to Shore Ride 2012
info.description: This infographic illustrates the items tracked, warehoused, and transported by NFI for the 2012 Bike MS City to Shore Ride. It highlights the quantity of various items, the date of the event, and the monetary contribution to MS150.

info.title: Oil Under-Recoveries Allocation
info.description: The infographic illustrates the allocation of under-recoveries in the oil sector among the central government, upstream companies, and downstream companies for the years 2008/09, 2009/10, and 2010/11. The visualization uses pie charts placed atop oil drums to represent the total under-recoveries and the proportion allocated to each stakeholder.

info.title: Hot Topics in Social Media Conversations
info.description: This infographic depicts the top issues driving profanity in social media conversations about political candidates. The data is visualized using thermometer-style charts, representing the percentage of profanity associated with each topic: Foreign Policy & War, Iran, Energy, and Economy. It also provides context by highlighting events that caused significant spikes in profanity related to specific topics.

info.title: 5 Most Valuable Non-Alcoholic Beverage Brands In The World In 2020
info.description: The infographic illustrates the top 5 most valuable non-alcoholic beverage brands worldwide in 2020, using a visual bar chart representation. The brands are Coca-cola, Pepsi, Red Bull, Nescafe, and Monster, with their respective values in million U.S. dollars displayed above each bar.

info.title: Non-voters overtake Red-Green
info.description: An infographic showing the percentage of second votes for SPD/Greens and non-voters in % of eligible voters over time. It shows how the percentage of non-voters surpassed the percentage of votes for SPD/Greens.

info.title: Toilet Paper Consumption per Person by Country
info.description: An infographic illustrating the number of toilet paper rolls used per person annually in different countries. The infographic compares the consumption in the United States, Germany, United Kingdom, Japan, Australia, Spain, France, Italy, China and Brazil.

info.title: TV Ownership by Brand in the U.S. 2023
info.description: This infographic shows the TV ownership by brand in the U.S. in 2023, based on a survey of 8,062 American adults. It presents the percentage of ownership for various brands, grouped by country of origin.

info.title: The Content Strategy Burger
info.description: This infographic visualizes content strategy as a burger, with each ingredient representing a different aspect of the strategy. The bun represents digital channels, the meat represents the audience, and other layers represent content theme, voice and tone, and content format. Each ingredient is represented by relevant icons.

info.title: Rollercoasters Gone Wrong
info.description: An infographic detailing the percentage of deaths by ride type and number of deaths on rollercoasters by year.

info.title: Bike-opolis: City Cycling Commutes
info.description: This infographic presents data on the percentage of residents who commute by bike in various North American cities. It features a creative visualization of this data by overlaying the data labels on the cyclist figure.

info.title: Car Sales in the US: One Very Bumpy Road
info.description: This infographic illustrates the trend of car sales in the US and the percentage change in car sales between May '09 and May '10 for various car brands.

info.title: Doordash vs Uber Eats Revenue ($M)
info.description: A line graph comparing the revenue of Doordash and Uber Eats from 2018 to 2022, with figures for Q2 2022 highlighted.

info.title: The Most Valuable Companies In The World (as of 2022)
info.description: This infographic presents a bar chart that visualizes the market capitalization of the most valuable companies in the world as of 2022. The companies are listed along the x-axis, while the y-axis represents their market cap in USD.

info.title: Population Growth
info.description: This infographic illustrates population growth over time, represented by a line graph and the use of illustrated faces to visually represent the increasing population size.

info.title: Magical White Beards Power by Beard Length
info.description: An infographic comparing the "magical powers" of several fictional and historical figures (Marx, Santa, Dumbledore, Saruman, Gandalf, and God) based on their beard length.

info.title: Future Missions to the Moon
info.description: This infographic visualizes future missions to the moon that are funded and under development, showing the countries and organizations involved, as well as the planned launch years.

info.title: Religions with the Most Followers Around the World
info.description: This infographic illustrates the percentage of followers for different religions worldwide, presented in a creative style using book spines to represent each religion.

info.title: A Tally of Life Under Threat: Are We in the Midst Of a Sixth Mass Extinction?
info.description: This infographic illustrates the assessment of various species by the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) to determine their threat levels. It uses a visual tally system where each animal/plant symbol represents 100 species. The infographic categorizes species into groups like birds, mammals, amphibians, reptiles, fish, arachnids, insects, crustaceans, mollusks, flowering and non-flowering plants, showing the number of threatened and non-threatened species within each group.

info.title: Years with a Female Head of State
info.description: The infographic visualizes the number of years that various countries have had a female head of state, using arm lengths to represent duration. The length of each arm represents the number of years, ranging from 0 to 25.

info.title: Annual Average PM10 Concentration in Major Cities Worldwide
info.description: The infographic shows a bar chart representing the annual average PM10 concentration in micrograms per cubic meter (µg/m³) for major cities worldwide. Each city is represented by its landmark and flag, with Seoul having the highest concentration, followed by Tokyo and Paris (both equal), and Washington D.C. having the lowest.

info.title: Airbus vs Boeing: Plane Range Comparison
info.description: An infographic comparing the range and passenger capacity of various Airbus and Boeing aircraft models. It also illustrates the flight durations and distances between different global cities, along with the longest non-stop flight in the world.

info.title: Deepening Plastic Ocean: Amount of Plastic Waste Discharge by ERP System in Korea
info.description: This infographic illustrates the amount of plastic waste discharge in Korea from 1965 to 2016, broken down by different sources (construction, household, workplace) and showing the total amount.

info.title: Prepare to Submerge
info.description: This infographic illustrates the potential sea level rise due to melting Arctic ice and its impact on various cities around the world. It shows how much the sea level is expected to rise over time and how it would affect the landmarks and cities.

info.title: Tallest Buildings in Each State in the United States
info.description: This infographic visualizes the tallest buildings in each US state, with a US map highlighting the location of the tallest building for each state. Bar charts compare building heights and building purposes. Top 10 U.S. Cities With the Most High-Rise Buildings are shown as numbers.

info.title: 2000 US Paper Production: A Paper Pie Chart
info.description: This infographic visualizes the 2000 US paper production data using a pie chart made from actual paper samples, creatively embedded in a tree stump. It showcases the percentage breakdown of different paper types like Containerboard, Printing & Writing, Boxboard, Newsprint, Tissue, and Packaging.

info.title: Top Sugar Producing Countries 2021/2022
info.description: The infographic presents the top sugar-producing countries for the year 2021/2022 in million metric tons, alongside data on top Indian sugar stocks and their CMP (Current Market Price).

info.title: Agricultural Equipment Statistics
info.description: Infographic showing the amount of different types of agricultural equipment purchased in 2014, along with percentage increases and additional unit counts. The equipment types include forage harvesters, grain harvesters, and tractors. The infographic uses a visual representation of farmland to display the data.

info.title: Days of Paid Mandatory Annual Leave and Actual Vacation Use
info.description: The infographic visualizes the amount of paid mandatory annual leave days in different countries and some data about actual vacation use. It shows that in the United States there are 0 paid days of mandatory annual leave.

info.title: All in the Family Tree
info.description: This infographic visually represents the interconnectedness of the television series 'All in the Family' and its spin-offs through a tree-like structure. It displays the relationships between actors, characters, and shows, including production years and episode counts.

info.title: Prevalence of Rheumatoid Arthritis by Age Group
info.description: This infographic displays the percentage of individuals affected by Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) across different age groups, ranging from 16-24 years to 75-84 years. The data is presented using a bar chart with human silhouettes on each bar to represent the age group. The percentage values are shown above each bar.

info.title: Wheat Area Harvested and Production
info.description: The infographic visualizes wheat area harvested and production from 2005/2006 to 2014/2015. The top chart shows 'Wheat Area Harvested' using wheat icons with varying heights representing the area harvested in 1000 Ha. The bottom chart shows 'Production' using bread icons with varying numbers representing the production in 1000 MT.

info.title: Resettlement After Cyclone Idai
info.description: This infographic visualizes the resettlement efforts following Cyclone Idai in Mozambique. It displays the displaced population across various districts and the types of sites (schools, community centers, etc.) used for resettlement, as well as the percentage of displaced population accessing these sites.

info.title: Best in Show: The ultimate data-dog
info.description: This infographic visualizes dog breeds based on several characteristics such as public popularity, intelligence, size, and type. It uses a scatter plot layout with dog silhouettes as data points, positioned according to their popularity (y-axis) and a combined data score derived from intelligence, longevity, ailments, costs, grooming, and appetite (x-axis). The breeds are also categorized by size (small, medium, large) using the size of the silhouettes, and type (herding, hound, non-sporting, sporting, terrier, toy, working) using color coding. The placement of each breed communicates how it scores across these attributes, providing a visual comparison of different breeds.

info.title: Ups and Downs in Shipbuilding
info.description: This infographic shows the ups and downs in shipbuilding in the United Kingdom from 1906 to 1938, using Isotype symbols to represent 50,000 net tons built. The chart highlights a decrease during the war period around 1915.

info.title: Most and Least Purchased Items Online
info.description: An infographic showing the most and least purchased items online, represented using a bar chart variation where the bars are depicted as network cables.

info.title: Low Wages and Unemployment as Sources of Poverty (1899 and 1936)
info.description: This infographic presents a comparison of the causes of poverty in 1899 and 1936, based on a survey of York. The visual uses Isotype symbols to represent cases of poverty, differentiating causes through color: red for low wages, black for unemployment and irregular work, and green for other causes. Each full colored symbol represents 1 case of poverty among 200 workers.

info.title: The Long Unemployed at Various Ages, England and Wales
info.description: This infographic visualizes the proportion of long-term unemployed individuals across different age groups in Wales, North England, and South and Midlands England. The visualization uses a pictogram chart, where each black figure represents one long-term unemployed person out of 100 persons at that age.

info.title: 30-minute workout routine
info.description: An infographic presenting a 30-minute workout routine consisting of 8 exercises, illustrating each exercise with a stick figure and providing instructions. It also lists necessary equipment.

info.title: Micromobility: Country Readiness for Scooters and Rides to Work
info.description: This infographic presents survey data regarding preferred micromobility vehicles for commuting across several countries. It shows the percentage of respondents in each country who prefer bicycles, e-kickscooters, mopeds, or other forms of transport.

info.title: Soft Drink Industry Revenue and Market Share
info.description: The infographic provides a snapshot of the soft drink industry's revenue and market share. It highlights the industry's total revenue, displays market share percentages for various soft drink brands (Coca-Cola, Diet Coke, Pepsi, Mountain Dew, and Dr. Pepper), and also shows the overall market share for soft drinks within the single beverage category.

info.title: Facebook Friends Annoyances
info.description: The infographic presents data on what Facebook users find most annoying about their Facebook friends, using percentages to indicate the prevalence of various behaviors.

info.title: Spring Flowering Bulbs: Sequence of Bloom, Height, and Planting Depth
info.description: This infographic illustrates various spring flowering bulbs, categorizing them by their bloom time (early, mid, and late spring). For each flower type, it shows the approximate height they reach, the recommended planting depth, and their relative blooming sequence.

info.title: ASEAN Internet Speed Index 2014
info.description: An infographic showing the average internet speed for ASEAN countries in 2014, along with the global average and speeds of other countries for comparison.

info.title: The History of the Computer Motherboard
info.description: This infographic illustrates the history of the computer motherboard, highlighting key milestones, innovations, and form factors from 1981 to 2009. It showcases the evolution of motherboard technology, including the introduction of various standards and the emergence of major manufacturers.

info.title: More Than Common: Mental Health Issues in America
info.description: This infographic uses instant ramen noodles to represent the number of Americans affected by various mental health issues, providing a visual comparison of prevalence.

info.title: Percentage Who Say They 'Always' Orgasm by Sexual Orientation
info.description: A hand-drawn bar chart showing the percentage of people who report always experiencing orgasm, broken down by sexual orientation (heterosexual, homosexual, and bisexual). The y-axis represents the percentage, ranging from 0% to 80%. The x-axis represents the different sexual orientations. Each bar is represented by a stream of water flowing down from a brain-like shape, with a figure inside, presumably representing a person.

info.title: Land Bank Distribution
info.description: The infographic visualizes the distribution of a land bank, showing how the land is allocated for various agricultural purposes such as forage cows, sheep, vegetables, crops, and agricultural premises, as well as agricultural technical units. The infographic uses a sliced pie chart to illustrate these proportions.

info.title: Number of lightsabers by color in 'Star Wars'
info.description: This infographic shows the number of lightsabers by color in Star Wars, considering both canon and the extended universe Legends stories. A bar chart is used to display the count for each color, with illustrations of lightsaber hilts at the bottom of each bar.

info.title: 2012 Presidential Election Forecast
info.description: An infographic displaying the electoral vote forecast for Barack Obama and Mitt Romney during the 2012 US presidential election, as of September 26th, 2012. It shows Obama leading in electoral votes.

info.title: Methods of Getting Groceries
info.description: This infographic visualizes the common ways people get their groceries.

info.title: Height Comparisons of Famous Monuments
info.description: The infographic compares the heights of several famous monuments around the world, specifically highlighting the Big Ben. It uses a bar chart style visualization to show the relative heights of the Leaning Tower of Pisa, the Statue of Liberty, Big Ben, and an obelisk.

info.title: The 5 Tallest Buildings in Asia
info.description: This infographic compares the heights of the five tallest buildings in Asia, providing their height in meters and feet, along with their name, location, and year of construction.

info.title: European Internet Usage by Country (September 2011)
info.description: This infographic shows the internet usage by country in Europe, specifically focusing on total unique visitors in September 2011. The data is presented for Italy, United Kingdom, France, Germany, and Russia, ranked by the number of unique visitors.

info.title: Investing in the Games: Who's Lifting the Weight?
info.description: This infographic visualizes the financial contributions of different entities, including the central government, national lottery, Greater London Authority, and London Development Agency, towards a specific project (likely the Olympic games based on the title). The amounts are represented by the size of weight plates on a barbell, providing a clear comparison of the magnitude of each entity's investment in British pound sterling.

info.title: Infographics: Infographic Energy Clean Air
info.description: This infographic visually represents data related to energy and clean air using the imagery of a bicycle and various charts.

info.title: Personal Choices to Reduce Your Contribution to Climate Change
info.description: The infographic illustrates the impact of various personal choices on reducing contribution to climate change, categorized into low, moderate, and high impact based on annual climate savings (tCO₂e).

info.title: Social Progress Index 2015
info.description: The infographic visualizes the Social Progress Index 2015 across a sample of nations, divided by geographical areas. It analyzes personal freedom and tolerance, highlighting the best and worst countries within each region.

info.title: Years with a Female Head of State
info.description: The infographic shows the number of years various countries have had a female head of state, represented by horizontal bars made of illustrated arms and fists.

info.title: Live Musical Performance Attendance Survey
info.description: This infographic visualizes survey responses regarding the frequency of attending live musical performances, displaying percentage breakdowns for different attendance motivations. The guitar image is divided into sections which relate to the percentages.

info.title: Web Developer Annual Salary by Country
info.description: This infographic illustrates the annual salary of web developers in US dollars across various countries. The visualization uses stacks of money to represent the salary amounts, making it easy to compare the earnings in different locations.

info.title: All The President's Men: Male Nominees in Trump's Government
info.description: A bar chart showing the percentage of male nominees in various departments of Trump's government. The chart uses illustrations of suited arms and fists to represent each department's percentage.

info.title: Comparison of Crocodilian Sizes
info.description: An infographic comparing the size of various crocodilian species, both extinct and extant, visualized through silhouettes next to a human figure for scale. The infographic presents a visual comparison of the species' lengths and provides data on their skull length and estimated weight.

info.title: Climate Change and Asylum Applications
info.description: This infographic shows the predicted increase in asylum applications under uniform climate change scenarios, visualizing the relationship between rising average temperature and the increase in asylum applications, with confidence intervals for the predictions.

info.title: Distribution of Annual Incomes in Great Britain in 1941
info.description: This infographic visualizes the distribution of annual incomes in Great Britain around 1941, using isotype symbols to represent income receivers. Each symbol represents 100,000 individuals, and groups of symbols represent 1 million income receivers. Different colors indicate different income brackets.

info.title: Missions to the Moon: Successes and Failures
info.description: This infographic presents a comparison of the total number of missions to the moon versus the number of successful missions for different countries, namely, the USA, Russia, China, Japan, India, Europe and Israel.

info.description: This infographic presents a line graph illustrating the trend of erectile dysfunction rates over the years from 2003 to 2013. The line is creatively depicted as a wilting flower, visually representing the decline in rates.

info.title: Urban Areas with Over 10 Million People
info.description: This infographic illustrates the populations of major urban areas around the world, comparing population sizes in 1950, 2010, and projected populations for 2025. It uses bar charts and a world map to visualize the data, along with iconic building silhouettes representing each city.

info.title: Occupational Distribution Visualized as a Garment
info.description: An infographic displaying the distribution of occupations and long-term unemployment as proportions, represented through a garment with different fabrics corresponding to the percentages. Each section of the garment symbolizes a different occupational category or unemployment status, with its respective percentage displayed beside it.

info.title: Holiday Preference Analysis
info.description: An infographic illustrating holiday preferences, segmented by the number of children in the household and overall popularity represented in percentages. The visualization uses popsicle-shaped bars to depict the number of children and 3D pie charts to represent the percentage of people preferring each type of holiday.

info.description: This infographic illustrates health trends among adults in Korea, showing changes in obesity rates by gender, walking habits, breakfast skipping, binge drinking, and hypertension prevalence between 2005/1998 and 2016.

info.description: This infographic presents the top 10 most read books in the world, based on the number of copies sold over the last 50 years. The visualization uses a bar chart to represent the sales figures for each book, with the books visually represented by their spines.

info.description: The infographic displays the percentage of non-voters in German federal elections from 1949 to 2009. The data is presented with years and percentage values superimposed on an image of a cut cheese. The visual metaphor attempts to represent the decreasing "slice" of voters.

info.title: Office Rents in Global Cities
info.description: This infographic compares office rents in various global cities, showcasing the cost per square foot in areas such as Shanghai, Beijing, Los Angeles, and others. The visualization uses skyscraper silhouettes to represent each city, with the corresponding rental prices displayed below.

info.title: Control Fugitive Dust: The Culprit of Air Pollution
info.description: This infographic presents information on fugitive dust (particulate matter) as a major cause of air pollution, showing the status of reported business sites, regional complaints, and management technology.

info.title: Median Salary of Managers by Marital and Parental Status
info.description: An infographic depicting the median salary of managers, broken down by their marital status (single or married) and whether or not they have children. It uses bar charts to visually compare salary levels across the different categories.

info.title: Business Growth Under Construction
info.description: An infographic depicting business growth as a construction project. Workers are building bar charts with the help of a crane, indicating progressive development. Includes percentages and sample text for further details on different business aspects.

info.title: R&D investment: China is catching up to the US
info.description: This infographic illustrates the share of global R&D expenditures for the US and China from 1995 to 2019. It shows how China's R&D investment has increased significantly, approaching the US levels. The infographic also suggests ways to expand the nation's innovative capacity.

info.title: Belief in Aliens vs. Belief in Jesus
info.description: The infographic compares the percentage of people who believe the US government is hiding evidence about aliens versus those who believe Jesus is the son of God, visualized with a book and UFO.

info.title: Length of Toes Bar Graph
info.description: This infographic presents a bar graph illustrating the length of toes from the ball of the foot to the tip, comparing the left and right feet. It uses colorful bars directly over an image of the feet to represent toe lengths.

info.title: Top 10 Most Read Books In The World
info.description: An infographic visualizing the top 10 most read books in the world based on the number of copies sold. The books are represented as their actual spines, arranged in a row, with a bar chart displaying the number of copies sold.

info.title: There's Always Room For Pie
info.description: This infographic presents data on pie preferences in America, determined by a 2012 NPR survey, and compares the cost and time involved in making a pie crust from scratch versus buying a ready-made crust.

info.title: Rate of Left-handedness by Year of Birth
info.description: An infographic illustrating the rate of left-handedness by year of birth, depicted using a line graph where the line is formed by a hand's middle finger.

info.title: Pollution: Fish Pharm
info.description: This infographic illustrates the presence of pharmaceutical drugs in fish found in Chicago's North Shore Channel. The relative amounts of four drugs (Diltiazem, Norfluoxetine, Diphenhydramine, and Carbamazepine) are visually represented by the distribution of pills shaped like a fish.

info.title: Earnings Gap Between Women and Men
info.description: An infographic illustrating the earnings gap between women and men from 1960 to 2010. It visually represents the percentage of men's earnings earned by women in each of the shown years, along with the dollar amount representing men's earnings.

info.title: Comparison of Tallest Buildings
info.description: This infographic compares the heights of various famous buildings around the world. It uses a bar chart-like visualization where the height of each building is represented proportionally.  It provides facts and features of each building including its height, location, and other unique characteristics.

info.title: The History of Bruce Springsteen
info.description: An infographic detailing the history of Bruce Springsteen's top albums, showcasing Spotify popularity, song types, and US album sales rank. It also provides a brief overview of his career and specific album releases.

info.title: Trust Indices
info.description: This infographic presents data about Russian people's trust in various aspects of society and information sources, visualized using a metaphor of burning candles. It shows the percentage of people who trust in specific areas like presidential elections, central television, nanotechnology, the direction of Russia's development, the existence of UFOs, and the changes in the police force.

info.title: Endangered Safari
info.description: This infographic visualizes the distribution of endangered animals in Africa, using animal silhouettes to represent the geographic location. The color of each silhouette indicates the animal's conservation status, ranging from "Critically Endangered" to "Least Concern".

info.title: Motor Cars, Telephones, Radio Sets per 50 Population in 1937
info.description: This infographic displays the number of motor cars, telephones, and radio sets per 50 people in the United States, Great Britain, France, and Germany in 1937. It uses pictograms to represent the quantities, allowing for a visual comparison between the countries.

info.title: Highest Ocean Plastic Waste Polluters
info.description: This infographic shows the annual estimation in metric tons of plastic waste polluting the ocean by different countries and regions. It highlights the countries that contribute the most to ocean plastic waste, with the Philippines, 'Rest of the world', and India being the top three polluters.

info.title: Transportation Mode Comparison
info.description: The infographic compares different modes of transportation, displaying numerical values associated with each, visually represented with balloons above each icon.

info.title: Immigrant Arrests from January 20 to March 15 (2014-2017)
info.description: The infographic shows a bar chart of immigrant arrests from January 20 to March 15 between 2014 and 2017. The bars are divided into two sections, representing arrests 'with criminal records' and 'without'. There is a hand-drawn figure placed between the 2015 and 2016 bars.

info.title: Economic Impact of Averted Losses Due to an Intervention
info.description: This infographic illustrates the economic impact of averting losses in treatment costs, caretaker wages, and lifetime productivity due to disability and death, with a syringe metaphor to represent intervention.

info.title: Top 5 Medal-Winning Countries
info.description: An infographic displaying the top 5 medal-winning countries based on the total number of gold, silver, and bronze medals won. The infographic uses a bar chart to represent the total medals and pie charts below each bar to show the distribution of gold, silver, and bronze medals for each country.

info.title: World's Top 25 Tea Consuming Countries
info.description: This infographic presents the top 25 countries with the highest tea consumption per capita. It uses a bar chart to compare the annual supply per person in kilograms, with each bar visually represented as a stack of teacups and topped with a teapot indicating the specific quantity. The infographic also includes information on different types of tea, categorized by their level of fermentation (green tea, oolong tea, black tea, and pu-erh tea), accompanied by brief descriptions.

info.title: OneZoom Tree of Life
info.description: The infographic visualizes the evolutionary tree of placental mammals. It presents a hierarchical structure showing the relationships between different groups of mammals, including monotremes, marsupials, and placental mammals. The diagram indicates the number of species within each group and the estimated time of divergence in millions of years (Mya).

info.title: Spritzentausch (Syringe Exchange)
info.description: This infographic displays the number of syringe exchanges from 2004 to 2011. The numbers are presented above the heads of people holding a yellow tube, which visualizes the trend of the syringe exchanges. The title "Spritzentausch" is German for "Syringe Exchange."

info.title: United States and Great Britain in the World
info.description: This infographic illustrates the population distribution and racial demographics of various countries and regions, using a pictographic approach where each figure represents 30 million people.

info.title: American Presidents: Length of Inaugural Addresses
info.description: An infographic depicting the length of American Presidential inaugural addresses, where bar color represents number of terms served, and symbols indicate unusual circumstances in office.

info.title: The Space Race to Total Connectivity
info.description: This infographic illustrates the total revenue (as of 2016) of 25 companies leading the 'space race' to a totally connected IoT (Internet of Things) world. The companies are represented as rockets, with the height of each rocket corresponding to the company's total revenue in dollars. The rocket's flame colors indicate the industry that the company belongs to, based on the provided key.

info.title: Coffee Consumption vs. Blood Type Frequency
info.description: The infographic presents two distinct data sets: coffee consumption habits and the frequency of different blood types within the world population. On the left, a pie chart within a coffee cup illustrates the percentage of coffee consumed during breakfast, with other meals, and between meals. On the right, the frequency of different blood types is visualized using a blood bag to represent the percentages.

info.title: Top 10 Albums from each Decade
info.description: This infographic shows the top 10 albums from each decade, categorized by genre (Jazz, Rock, Pop). It visualizes the timeline of music and its evolution, including the media formats introduced over time. The infographic also highlights observations about genre popularity and the shift from vinyl to digital formats.

info.title: Gun Homicide Rates in Various Countries
info.description: This infographic visualizes gun homicide rates per 100,000 residents across different countries, highlighting the significant difference between the United States and other high-income nations.

info.title: Percentage of People Who Wear a Jewish Yarmulke to Work
info.description: Infographic displaying the percentage of people in different professions who wear a Jewish yarmulke to work. It shows the percentages for judges, nurses and doctors, fashion designers, and schoolteachers/tutors.

info.title: Affordable Housing: Total Owners Percentage and Housing Tenure Distribution
info.description: This infographic displays the total owners percentage and housing tenure distribution across various countries, showing regional variations in house prices using stylized house icons and a stacked bar chart.

info.title: Restaurant Meal Sizes: 1950s vs. Now
info.description: This infographic visually compares the sizes of typical restaurant meal components (french fries, burger, soda) between the 1950s and the present day, highlighting the increase in portion sizes.

info.title: BTUs per Dollar of GDP Over Time
info.description: This infographic shows the trend of BTUs (British Thermal Units) per dollar of GDP from 1950 to 2010. It presents a downward sloping line graph with the data points marked along the line. An electrical tower is used in the background.

info.title: Energy-related CO2 per Million Dollars of GDP (2005-2011)
info.description: This infographic shows the trend of energy-related CO2 emissions per million dollars of GDP from 2005 to 2011. It uses a creative line chart where the line representing the data is shaped like smoke emanating from industrial buildings.

info.title: Hop Trial No.1 Results
info.description: This infographic presents the results of the Hop Trial No.1, focusing on hop ratings and dominant hop characteristics. It includes ratings for aroma, flavor, and bitterness, along with the percentage breakdown of dominant flavor profiles like citrus, hay/grassy, tropical, piney, spicy/herbal, floral, and onion/garlic.

info.title: Food Assistance: September 2008 to May 2009
info.description: This infographic visualizes the number of Americans receiving food assistance (food stamps) from September 2008 to May 2009. The data is represented using rows, where each row corresponds to a month and displays the number of recipients along with stylized icons of food items.  'New Record' indicators mark months with the highest recorded numbers of recipients.

info.title: Girl Scout Cookies Sales Distribution
info.description: This infographic visualizes the sales distribution of various Girl Scout cookie flavors, represented as slices of a pie chart made of actual cookies.

info.title: Europe's Chocolate Consumption in 2015
info.description: This infographic visualizes chocolate consumption in kilograms per person in Europe in 2015, represented by chocolate drips of varying lengths.

info.title: Anatomy of Bowie's Lyrics
info.description: This infographic visualizes the frequency of words used in David Bowie's lyrics by arranging words of related topics into the shape of his face.

info.title: The Magnificent Bears of Finland
info.description: This infographic visualizes the density of bears in Finland approximately before and after 2010. The map of Finland is filled with bear illustrations, with the color of the bears indicating the amount of individual bears per 1000 km². It also includes interesting facts about bears in Finnish culture and nature.

info.title: Oscar-Winning Best Pictures and Best Director Nominations
info.description: An infographic showing the percentage of Best Picture winners that also had a Best Director nomination for various categories. The 'filling' of the Oscar statues represents the percentages.

info.title: Americans Vacation Technology Usage in 2011
info.description: This infographic shows the percentage of Americans who brought various electronic devices on vacation in 2011 for work or fun.

info.title: Vertical Overview of 138 Companies
info.description: The infographic presents an overview of 138 companies categorized by business type (B2C, B2B, B2B/B2C, HCT) using a stylized sword-shaped graphic to represent the different categories.

info.description: This infographic illustrates the top countries by car sales. The size of the cars, stylized with the respective countries' flags, represents the number of cars bought, with China leading in sales volume and the USA leading in total sales revenue.

info.title: US Land Usage for Food Production
info.description: This infographic depicts the percentage of land used for food production in the US and its distribution across various categories like other general purposes, fruits, vegetables, nuts, and cattle feed. The infographic is structured around an illustration of a buffalo to emphasize the agricultural nature of the topic.

info.title: Who comments more?
info.description: This infographic illustrates the percentage of men and women who comment more, using a visual metaphor of a dress for women and pants for men. It shows that 64% of comments are made by men, while 36% are made by women.

info.title: The Food Categories Dominated by Ready-to-Eat Dishes
info.description: This infographic illustrates which food categories are most heavily dominated by pre-made, ready-to-eat dishes. It presents a ranking of various dishes and ingredients, with a numerical index indicating their prevalence in the ready-to-eat market. The data source is Alibaba's 1688 wholesale website, analyzed based on the keyword "ready-to-eat dishes" as of September 28, 2023.

info.title: Largest Branded Coffee Chain in China by 2023
info.description: The infographic presents the number of stores of the largest branded coffee chains in China by 2023. The visualization is designed like a coffee cup, with different brands occupying differently sized wedges based on the number of stores they have.

info.title: India's Smartwatch Market Share Q2CY23

info.title: AI Models With Lowest Hallucination Rates
info.description: This infographic presents a horizontal bar chart showing the hallucination rates of various AI models. It defines hallucination rate as the frequency that an LLM generates false or unsupported information in its outputs and lists the models in ascending order of hallucination rate.

info.title: Crypto Growth by Region
info.description: The infographic shows the growth of cryptocurrency by different regions. The regions are Middle East & North, Latin America, North America, Central & Southern Asia, and Eastern Europe. The crypto growth percentages are displayed as 48%, 40%, 36%, 35%, and 22% respectively.

info.title: Miracles in Madison: Dairy Queen Blizzard Sales
info.description: An infographic showing the number of Blizzards sold (in thousands) by the Dairy Queen in Madison, SD, from 2006 to 2023. The Dairy Queen in Madison, SD, has outsold every other participating store each year since Miracle Treat Day began.

info.title: Top-selling concert tours of all time
info.description: This infographic illustrates the top 10 highest-grossing concert tours of all time, displaying each tour's name, the artist, the years of the tour, the number of shows, and the total gross revenue adjusted for inflation as of November 2024.

info.title: Constructing a Cleaner Economy
info.description: The infographic illustrates the value and job growth in the green nonresidential construction industry. It shows the value of the industry in billions of dollars for the years 2005, 2010, and 2015, alongside an estimation of job growth between the periods of 2000-2008 and 2009-2013.

info.title: Cycling Fatalities per 100 Million Miles Biked by Race/Ethnicity (2016-2018)
info.description: This infographic presents cycling fatality rates per 100 million miles biked in the United States from 2016 to 2018, broken down by race/ethnicity, and includes the average across all demographics.

info.title: Distribution of Business Types by Floor in Seoul
info.description: This infographic shows the distribution of different business types across floors (basement, 1st floor, and 2nd floor) in Seoul, based on data from properties registered on Jumpo Line between January and June 20, 2014. It highlights the top 5 most common business categories on each floor, as preferred by business owners. The infographic also includes average monthly rent per square meter for each floor.

info.title: Number of Patients with Toothache by Age Group
info.description: This infographic illustrates the number of patients who visit the dentist due to toothache, categorized by age group. The data is sourced from the Health Insurance Review & Assessment Service, with the base year being 2013, and the unit is in thousands.

info.title: Wine Bottle Sizes
info.description: An infographic displaying various wine bottle sizes, ranging from Piccolo to Melchizedek. It visually represents the relative volumes of each bottle size compared to the standard 75cl bottle, using both volume in liters (L) and centiliters (CL) and multiples of the standard bottle.

info.title: Cruel Summer: Number of Summer Days in the Northern Hemisphere
info.description: The infographic illustrates the increase in the number of summer days in the Northern Hemisphere over time, from 1952 to 2011, and projects the number for 2100. It uses an illustrative approach.

info.title: Cricket Boards with the Highest Revenue
info.description: This infographic showcases the top cricket boards globally based on their revenue, presenting them in descending order along with their respective logos and revenue figures in crore.

info.title: Right-Wing Extremists Most Often Resort to Firearms
info.description: This infographic shows the number of attacks involving firearms, broken down by phenomenon (ideological) category, counted in LAPOS (Lagebild Auswertung politisch motivierte Kriminalität) from 2001 to 2018. The categories include Right-wing, Left-wing, Foreign ideology, Religious ideology, and Unattributable.

info.title: Freor LT Sales Growth
info.description: The infographic visually represents the sales growth of UAB "Freor LT" due to SEB bank's solutions. The lengths of the trucks parked side-by-side in a parking lot are proportional to the sales growth.

info.title: U.S. Vehicle Production Trend Analysis
info.description: This infographic presents a trend analysis of U.S. vehicle production share from 1975 to 2020, highlighting the shift in preference towards SUVs and trucks over time. It includes significant events that influenced vehicle production trends.

info.title: Top 20 Countries of Wine Consumption
info.description: The infographic depicts the top 20 countries with the highest wine consumption. The main chart is a bar chart showing the amount of wine consumed per capita, and country flag representation at the bottom of the chart. It also features the shapes of different wine bottle styles.

info.title: Thailand's Unpaved Roads Compared to Other Countries
info.description: This infographic compares the percentage of unpaved roads in Thailand to that of other countries. It visualizes the data using bars that represent percentages, with the length of each road bar illustrating the proportion of unpaved roads in the respective country's total road network. Data is from 2013.

info.title: Privacy: A Question of Balance
info.description: This infographic by First Data examines consumer privacy in the context of online and mobile technology. It explores consumer perspectives on data usage, the importance of trustworthiness, and the benefits and concerns surrounding geo-tracking. It also touches on government actions related to consumer privacy protection.

info.title: The Fastest Rubik's Cube Solvers
info.description: This infographic presents a visual history of the fastest official Rubik's Cube solve times, starting from the first official event in 1982. It showcases the progression of records, highlighting key individuals and their achievements in speedcubing, while also providing insights into the factors that influence solve times.

info.title: Facebook Privacy Settings Changes Over Time
info.description: This infographic illustrates the changes in Facebook's default privacy settings from 2005 to 2010. It visualizes how information access evolved from being limited to friends and networks to potentially being visible to the entire internet. The infographic emphasizes the increasing number of people with access to user information and raises concerns about privacy.

info.title: Automated world: Robot Density by Country
info.description: This infographic, published by the South China Morning Post, visualizes the density of industrial robots per 10,000 industrial workers in various countries. It presents an overview of robot production and automation levels globally, focusing on China's role and comparing it with other nations. The infographic includes a line chart illustrating the trend of robot production in China and a ranking of the top 27 countries by robot density, using a custom visualization to represent the data. It further touches upon the shifts in China's employment sectors related to automation.

info.title: Oceans Apart: Comparing Chinese and Japanese Naval Power
info.description: This infographic from the South China Morning Post compares the naval capabilities of China and Japan, showing the number of different types of vessels and naval personnel for each country. It also shows historical trends in vessel numbers using line charts and provides visual representations of vessel quantities using silhouettes.

info.title: Get Ready for the Year of the Snake
info.description: This infographic provides information about the upcoming Year of the Snake in 2025 according to the Chinese zodiac and customs. It details the meaning of the Wood Snake year, the Chinese Five Elements theory, compatibilities between zodiac signs, important days and customs during the 15-day Lunar New Year celebration, and notable celebrities born under the sign of the snake.

info.title: Sky's the Limit: Skyscraper Construction in China
info.description: An infographic illustrating China's ambition in skyscraper construction, highlighting existing and planned tall buildings in China compared to the world's tallest.

info.title: The Rolling Stones: 50-Year Discography
info.description: An infographic detailing the discography of The Rolling Stones over a 50-year period, showing album releases and their success based on the Official Albums Chart in Britain. It visualizes the timeline of their albums, peak positions on the charts, and album sales.

info.title: Three decades of PlayStation evolution
info.description: This infographic showcases the evolution of the PlayStation console family, from the original PS1 in 1994 to the PS5 Pro. It illustrates the timeline of releases, units sold, the evolution of PlayStation controllers, and price comparisons (both at launch and adjusted for inflation).

info.title: Hong Kong's Weather Extremes and Energy Consumption (1970-2017)
info.description: This infographic illustrates the relationship between weather extremes (hot and cold days) and energy consumption in Hong Kong from 1970 to 2017. It highlights how energy consumption corresponds to weather patterns, how the ratios of hot/cold days have changed, and provides insights into energy consumption breakdown by sector.

info.title: The Sum of the Parts: China's Regional Economic Growth
info.description: An infographic illustrating China's regional economic growth from 1996 to 2015, using triangles to represent the growth in gross regional product (in percent) over the previous year. The infographic includes a map of eight economic regions of China, with each region color-coded and numbered to match a list of provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions. The numbers correspond to those in brackets in the list.

info.title: Cashing in on gold
info.description: This infographic visualizes the cash rewards offered by different countries to their athletes for winning gold medals at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics. The size of the yellow circles represents the US$ reward for a gold medal or the total cost in US$ for gold medals won, and the number of rings around each circle shows the number of gold medals won. The infographic also includes a section about countries that do not offer cash rewards.

info.title: High Office: Height of World Leaders
info.description: This infographic explores the relationship between the height of world leaders and their perceived power. It presents the heights of various political and religious figures, comparing them to national averages and displaying their lifespans and tenures in office on a timeline.

info.title: America's Cash Crunch: US Debt
info.description: This infographic from the South China Morning Post illustrates the US national debt and its potential implications. It visualizes the growth of the debt over time, compares it to the GDP, and provides hypothetical examples of what the debt could finance, such as giving cash to every citizen, buying the world's gold, funding space programs, and addressing climate change. The infographic also offers a brief historical overview of the US debt ceiling.

info.title: Which movies do you like?
info.description: The infographic compares the audience ratings from the Internet Movie Database (IMDb) for popular movies of 2017, specifically focusing on the differences in scores given by men and women. It also shows costs and revenues associated with some of the listed films.

info.title: Measuring Olympic Success
info.description: This infographic illustrates the efficiency of various national delegations in the Olympic Games based on the number of athletes and medals won. Rings representing each delegation are positioned from most to least efficient, colored by continent, and sized according to the number of athletes.

info.title: Love Me Do: The Beatles and US Album Sales
info.description: The infographic explores the career of The Beatles, commemorating the anniversary of their first single, Love Me Do. It visualizes the timeline of their UK releases, and compares the US album sales of The Beatles with other major artists in the music industry.

info.title: Decoding Covid-19
info.description: This infographic provides an overview of Covid-19, including its spread, severity, potential for reinfection, and vaccine development timeline. It also discusses the differences between the seven human coronaviruses and their impact on human health.

info.title: Full Tank, Empty Pocket: Petrol Prices in Hong Kong
info.description: This infographic discusses the high petrol prices in Hong Kong compared to other countries, the factors contributing to the high prices, the consumption and import levels of petrol, a comparison between petrol car and electric car costs, and the number of licensed electric vehicles.

info.title: Hong Kong Sevens Tournament: Facts and Results
info.description: An infographic providing facts, figures, and historical results related to the Hong Kong Sevens rugby tournament.

info.title: Pandemic Dance: Hong Kong's Dance Club COVID-19 Outbreak
info.description: This infographic illustrates how COVID-19 spread through dance clubs in Hong Kong, detailing the visits of individuals of different age groups to various dance venues over a 15-day period. It uses a node-link diagram to show connections between individuals and locations, categorized by age and gender.

info.title: Lives up in smoke
info.description: This infographic from the South China Morning Post, published on October 29, 2015, examines smoking rates, cigarette prices, and taxes in various countries. It includes a scatter plot comparing the total tax on cigarettes as a percentage of price against the price of cigarettes in US dollars. It also features line graphs that illustrate the prevalence of smoking and cigarette consumption trends in China over several decades. The infographic also discusses the health and economic impacts of smoking, especially in China.

info.title: The Brick: World's First Mobile Phone
info.description: An infographic comparing the size and dimensions of the Motorola DynaTAC prototype, the world's first mobile phone, to top smartphone models of 2022, Nokia 1110 and Apple iPhone SE.

info.title: Hong Kong Rainfall History
info.description: This infographic visualizes the history of rainfall in Hong Kong from 1884 to 2020, showcasing the driest and wettest years, along with the number of days with and without rain.

info.title: A Red Tide: Wine Sales on the Mainland
info.description: This infographic illustrates the surge in China's wine market. It presents data on total wine sales and sales by wine type (red, rose, white, champagne, and rice wine) over the years, per capita wine consumption by country in 2010, and compares wine consumption to other alcohol types.

info.title: Hong Kong Housing Supply and Demand Imbalance
info.description: An infographic illustrating the housing supply and demand imbalance in Hong Kong from 1997 to 2017, incorporating data on living quarters, domestic households, and property prices.

info.title: Sales Register: Hong Kong Retail Spending in 2001 and 2011
info.description: This infographic compares retail spending in Hong Kong in 2001 and 2011 across various categories of goods. It uses bar chart variations to represent the spending amount, with different bar heights indicating the value for each category in Hong Kong dollars. The infographic highlights the percentage increase in spending from 2001 to 2011 for select categories and notes some key trends.

info.title: Darren Long at the Post
info.description: A commemorative infographic about Darren Long, the creative director of the South China Morning Post, highlighting his contributions and the awards received under his direction. The infographic incorporates a portrait of Darren Long composed of square blocks representing the awards received, alongside descriptions of his personal interests.

info.title: How the iPhone has Changed
info.description: This infographic shows the evolution of the iPhone from 2007 to 2017, highlighting the changes in design, features, and sales figures over the years. It also indicates countries where iPhones are not available.

info.title: Big Brother is watching you: A look at global surveillance
info.description: This infographic explores the prevalence of CCTV surveillance in cities around the world, focusing on the top surveilled cities, software recognition accuracy, facial recognition technology, and Hong Kong's public surveillance system. It discusses the balance between crime reduction and privacy concerns, and highlights advancements in gait recognition technology.

info.title: How the coronavirus spread in Hong Kong
info.description: This infographic visualizes the origin and spread of COVID-19 cases in Hong Kong as of April 23, 2020. It details both imported cases and local transmissions, showing the number of cases originating from different countries and tracing local clusters to specific events and locations.

info.title: Child Bearing Trends in Hong Kong (1997-2011)
info.description: This infographic presents the trends in child bearing in Hong Kong from 1997 to 2011, focusing on the number of births to mainland Chinese mothers compared to local mothers. It uses pictogram charts to show the overall increase and decrease in births, accompanied by a timeline of events influencing these trends.

info.title: Rain patterns in Hong Kong from 1990 to 2013
info.description: This infographic shows the rain patterns in Hong Kong from 1990 to 2013. It visualizes the daily rainfall and tropical cyclone warning signals, as well as the total annual rainfall.

info.title: Global Confidence in Donald Trump: A 2017 Survey
info.description: An infographic showing the results of a 2017 survey among 37 countries regarding confidence in Donald Trump's leadership. It visualizes the proportion of respondents who have confidence versus those who have little to no confidence, using a combined visual and numerical approach.

info.title: Shrimp Inspiration Scale
info.description: This infographic uses a line graph to represent inspiration level, using the color change of shrimp to visually depict percentage increase. It links this scale to motivational text about inspiration and restructuring ideas.

info.title: Prevalence of Chronic Conditions in Prison
info.description: The infographic illustrates the prevalence of chronic conditions among prisoners. It uses a stylized bar chart where each bar represents the prevalence of a different chronic condition, visually resembling jail bars. The infographic compares prevalence of chronic condition or infectious disease among state and federal prisoners with prevalence of chronic condition or infectious disease in general population.

info.title: Italy surpasses France in the industrial system
info.description: This infographic compares the 'fatturato' (revenue) and export performance of Italy and France within the industrial system. It uses a visual representation of ribbons, measuring tape, balls of yarn, and buttons to display percentage data related to textile and apparel industries.

info.title: Company Value and EBITDA in the Stock Exchange (2003-2014)
info.description: The infographic presents two bar charts comparing the company value in the stock exchange and EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization), both measured in million TRL (Turkish Lira), from 2003 to 2014. The bars are creatively designed with nature-themed elements. The company value chart uses a red floral/leaf pattern, while the EBITDA chart uses a green leaf/wheat pattern.

info.title: Raj Kamal Aich: Infographic Resume
info.description: This is a creative and playful infographic resume of Raj Kamal Aich, who works as an infographist, photographer, and illustrator. It features a mix of handcrafted visual elements like a Lego figure of himself, a bread and cheese pie chart, a pen and brush timeline, and digitally included elements.

info.title: Hoki vs. Jack Mackerel Bycatch in 2008
info.description: This infographic compares the bycatch of fish when fishing for Hoki versus Jack Mackerel in 2008. The visualization uses the area of the fishing nets to represent the relative quantity of bycatch.

info.title: Bark Beetle Timber Harvest in the Bavarian Forest
info.description: The infographic illustrates the increase in timber harvest due to bark beetle infestation in the Bavarian Forest from 2002 to 2012. The visual uses a bar chart with tree trunk-shaped bars to represent the volume of timber harvest, measured in 'Festmeter'. The illustration includes images of bark beetles and pine trees to provide context.

info.title: The Beatles Infographic
info.description: An infographic about The Beatles, presenting various statistics related to their album sales, chart performance, and cultural impact, including RIAA certifications, Billboard chart achievements, and viewership of their Ed Sullivan Show appearance.

info.title: Fruit Smoothie Composition
info.description: This infographic uses a 'pie chart' composed of real fruit segments to visually represent the ingredients and their respective percentages in a fruit smoothie. It lists orange (37%), pineapple (40%), banana (20%) and lemon (3%)

info.title: Adiós Hambre Despues del Gym
info.description: An infographic illustrating the composition of a post-gym meal to eliminate hunger. It uses a part-to-whole visualization with food items arranged within a circle, each representing a percentage of the total meal composition. The items include asparagus, mushrooms, lettuce, and Philadelphia cheese.

info.title: Churro Consumption by District
info.description: An infographic showing the churro consumption in different districts. The data is presented as a modified line graph with churros themselves forming the visual representation of data points.

info.title: Font Comparison via Ink Level in Pens
info.description: A visual comparison of different fonts based on how much ink they would use. Each pen represents a different font, and the remaining ink level in the pen visually represents the ink usage of that font. The pen with the lowest ink usage corresponds to the font that uses the least amount of ink.

info.title: Raj Kamal Aich: Infographic Resume
info.description: This infographic presents a creative resume of Raj Kamal Aich, an infographist, photographer, and illustrator. The resume uses food items and objects to represent different aspects of his profile, such as skills, experience, and education.

info.title: Public Perception of Gang-Related Crime
info.description: The infographic visualizes survey data on public perception and behavioral changes related to gang-related crime. It displays the percentage of people who are afraid in specific places because of gang-related crime, and the percentage of people who have changed their behavior because of gang-related crime.

info.title: Customer Satisfaction with Flowers
info.description: This infographic visualizes customer satisfaction levels using flower imagery. The flowers' condition corresponds to satisfaction levels. Text and percentage labels detail satisfaction levels.

info.title: What Creatives Do in Meetings
info.description: This infographic presents a humorous take on what creative professionals do during meetings, using a coffee cup analogy. Each layer of the cup represents a different activity with its corresponding percentage, such as paying attention, wondering about free sandwiches, or browsing social media.

info.title: Frequency of masturbation per month
info.description: This infographic visualizes the frequency of masturbation per month, with the height of each vegetable corresponding to the percentage of respondents indicating that frequency. For example, the radish represents 22% and corresponds to 1-5 times per month.

info.title: Creativity in Changing Work Environments
info.description: This infographic visualizes how people perceive their creativity levels in response to changes in their working environment. It uses a stacked percentage representation to show the proportions of people feeling 'more creative', 'just as creative', and 'less creative'.

info.title: Sausage Proportion
info.description: This infographic uses the metaphor of a cut sausage to represent proportions of different categories, likely in response to a question.

info.title: The Real Tear Jerker: Retail Price of Onions
info.description: This infographic shows the retail price of onions in ₹ per KG for August 2013, July 2013, and August 2012. It visually represents the price changes over time using an image of an onion and connecting lines to the price data.

info.title: Cycling around the entire island
info.description: This infographic visualizes the distance of cycling around an entire island, which is approximately 1,200 km. It also mentions the popularity of this activity and some characteristics of participants.

info.title: Salaries that don't reach
