info.description: An infographic illustrating the proportion of workers' salaries in relation to dependency in Argentina, showing the percentage of people earning within different income brackets using an image of a sliced loaf of bread.

info.title: Plastic Habitat: Marine Plastic Pollution
info.description: This infographic, titled "Plastic Habitat," visualizes the issue of plastic pollution in the marine environment. It highlights the sources of plastic waste, the impact on marine animals, the process of microplastic formation, and potential solutions to mitigate the problem. Statistics about the percentage of plastics in the ocean, and the harm done to species in the foodchain are visually presented. The infographic also emphasizes the amount of plastic entering the ocean annually and the effects of plastic consumption on specific marine species.

info.title: Company Shareholders Pie Chart
info.description: This infographic illustrates the share distribution among company shareholders using a pie chart. Each slice of the pie represents a shareholder's percentage ownership, with additional context provided by the 'controlling interest' and 'blocking minority' descriptions.

info.title: One Year of Design Weeks
info.description: This infographic visualizes the founding year of design weeks around the world until 2013. Each city is represented by a pencil shaving, where the size corresponds to the founding year of the recurring design week, and the color indicates the continent. The size of the shaving correlates with the founding year of the design week.

info.title: Emotions Exposed: How My Emotions Influenced My Decisions
info.description: This infographic presents a creative visualization of personal emotions and their impact on decisions, using the human body as a canvas to display different data points and emotions.

info.title: Data Security: Online Banking vs. Google
info.description: An infographic visually comparing the percentage of data vulnerability related to online banking (74%) and Google (1%). It aims to convey the message that 'My data is safe' and 'not passed on to third parties.'

info.title: Worry of Deadly Police Force Victimization Among White and Black Americans
info.description: An infographic visually representing the disparity in concern about being a victim of deadly police force between white and black Americans.

info.title: What Creatives Do When They Win a Clio
info.description: This infographic creatively visualizes what creatives do when they win a Clio award. It uses a deconstructed champagne bottle to represent the stages of celebration, each associated with a percentage indicating the likelihood of that activity.

info.title: How long the Chancellors were in office
info.description: The infographic shows the duration in years that different German Chancellors were in office. The visualization uses different types of glasses filled with different liquids, where the amount of liquid in each glass represents the number of years the respective Chancellor served. The names of the chancellors are written below the glasses.

info.title: Global Fish Production: Aquaculture, Freshwater Fish, and Saltwater Fish
info.description: This infographic illustrates the global production of fish from aquaculture, freshwater, and saltwater sources, highlighting the top 10 producing countries for each category.

info.title: Legislative Responses for Policing in 2020
info.description: This infographic visualizes the number of bills introduced in 2020 related to policing, categorized by different areas: Executive Orders, Training Standards and Certification, Oversight and Data, Use of Force, Policing Alternatives and Collaboration, and Technology. The visualization uses the buildings in a cityscape as bars, where each window represents one bill.

info.title: Added Sugar Consumption in the U.S.
info.description: This infographic illustrates the amount of added sugar consumed by the average American daily, its sources, and the associated health implications.

info.title: Cultural Access and Happiness
info.description: The infographic depicts the influence of access to culture on happiness, presenting the results of a survey. It displays percentages indicating the degree to which individuals feel that culture is essential, important, residual, or indifferent to their happiness, represented in a visually creative way with a painter's palette and corresponding bars.

info.title: Show do Milhão: Corn Facts and Statistics
info.description: This infographic presents various facts and statistics about corn (milho in Portuguese). It covers aspects such as corn's dimensions, growth period, calcium content, production trends, applications, and leading producers. The infographic uses an image of corn as its central element, visually representing the data.

info.title: Housing in Nantes Métropole, 2011
info.description: This infographic illustrates the distribution of housing types in Nantes Métropole in 2011, showing the percentages of social housing renters, private renters, and homeowners.

info.title: Tabouret H Stool Catalog
info.description: An infographic displaying information about the "Tabouret H" stool, showcasing its various specifications such as height, materials, and prices.

info.title: Number of Sexual Partners: A Zipper Analogy
info.description: This infographic uses an analogy of zippers to represent the number of sexual partners people have had. Each zipper represents a different range of partners, with the percentage indicating the proportion of people within that range.

info.title: People Taking Action on Racial Equality
info.description: The infographic shows the percentage of people taking action on racial equality in different ways, based on survey data. It includes conversations with family and friends, posting or sharing content on social networking sites, contributing money, and contacting a public official to express their opinion. The data is superimposed on an aerial photograph of a street filled with protesters, with colored outlines highlighting different areas of the crowd.

info.title: Global Comparisons
info.description: The infographic presents a series of comparisons using numbers from various global contexts. It compares the number of people following Lady Gaga, the fortune of Carlos Slim, Facebook users, populations of countries and cities, employees of McDonalds, and other figures to provide context and perspective on their scale.

info.title: Air Pollution Levels in Italy are Decreasing
info.description: This infographic visualizes the decreasing trend of air pollution levels (PM2.5 and NO2) in Italy from January 20th to March 20th. The visualization uses scattered circles to represent the pollution levels over time, displayed on a blue sky background with a building at the bottom.

info.title: U.S. Workers Benefit from Working From Home
info.description: The infographic presents data on the benefits experienced by U.S. workers from working from home, as indicated by the percentages who report experiencing various positive outcomes.

info.title: Professional Athletes Giving Back
info.description: This infographic visualizes the charitable contributions of various professional sports teams, showing how much each team has donated, with the Golden State Warriors leading at 1 million and other teams like the Philadelphia 76ers, Orlando Magic, and Detroit Pistons also contributing.

info.title: Donations to Bail Funds in Support of BLM
info.description: An infographic showing the amount of donations to bail funds in support of BLM movement, visualized using footprints on a street.

info.title: Fun of the Run: Training for My First Half Marathon
info.description: This infographic visualizes a training plan for a half marathon, showing the time and type of runs over several weeks, with a key explaining the visual elements used to represent different aspects of the training.

info.title: 15 Diverse Cocktails: A Recipe Wheel
info.description: This infographic illustrates the composition of 15 different cocktails. It uses a circular visualization to show the proportions of different spirits and mixers in each drink. The infographic also lists the spirits, mixers, and garnishes used in the cocktails. The infographic also specifies an example cocktail (Iceberg) and its composition of Vodka, Peppermint Schnapps and Lemonade.

info.title: Coffee Recipes
info.description: This infographic shows a visual representation of different coffee recipes, displaying the proportions of ingredients such as espresso, water, milk, vodka, whipped cream, and chocolate syrup. It also includes a small section about Voltaire's coffee consumption habits.

info.title: Advisory Status: Lifted vs. In Effect
info.description: An infographic comparing the number of lifted advisories to the number of advisories still in effect. The visual uses a 3D bar to represent the overall advisory status, with lines extending to show specific numbers for lifted and in-effect advisories.

info.title: Panel Members Representation with Melons
info.description: The infographic creatively uses melon slices to represent panel members. A whole melon signifies the total number of members, while a sliced melon shows the percentage of panel members, visually demonstrating a proportion or share.

info.title: Test Results: Viral Hepatitis and Harm Reduction
info.description: An infographic showing test results related to infectious diseases, particularly viral hepatitis. It highlights the burden on those affected and notes the stabilization of Hepatitis C infections due to harm reduction efforts. It shows the percentage of HIV, HCV AK, HCV PCR, and HBV AK tests.

info.title: Varsity Gameday Activity Summary
info.description: The infographic shows a person's activity summary for a 'Varsity Gameday', displaying the fuel consumed, duration of activity, calories burned, and heart rate, along with social media interactions and photos.

info.title: Number of Information and Consultation Meetings
info.description: The infographic presents the number of information and consultation meetings from 2008 to 2011. The data is visualized through a creative bar chart metaphor, where each bar is represented by a portion of a crosswalk lane covered with patterned material, giving a visual representation of growth over the years.

info.title: Nantes Métropole: Real Estate Market
info.description: The infographic presents data about real estate transactions in Nantes Métropole, showing the number of transactions per year and the distribution between new and old properties.

info.title: Freshwater Withdrawal by Country of G7 + 1
info.description: This infographic visualizes freshwater withdrawal per person in cubic meters for the G7 countries plus Congo. It uses balloons of varying sizes to represent the quantity of water withdrawn. The balloons are connected to a pipe, suggesting a common source. The size of the balloon is proportional to the amount of water usage.

info.title: T.G.I.B.F. - Thank God It's Beer Friday: Beverage Consumption
info.description: An infographic showcasing the beverage consumption on a typical "Beer Friday" at Column Five, featuring the consumption in ounces of beer, coffee, soda, tea, shake, juice, liquor, and energy drinks.

info.title: Annual Hours Worked by Country
info.description: The infographic uses horizontal bars represented as pencils to compare the annual hours worked across different countries. The length of the pencil represents the number of hours worked per year.

info.title: Contacts in Street Work Deployment
info.description: This infographic shows the number of contacts in street work deployment from 2004 to 2011, visualized by stones decorated as cake slices.

info.title: British Scientists Prove: Alcohol is the most harmful drug
info.description: This infographic shows research results from 2009 by a British scientific committee on drug addiction, indicating alcohol is the most harmful drug. It visualizes the harm index of various drugs.

info.title: Usage of Chocolate Confectionery in Brazil
info.description: This infographic presents data on the usage of different types of chocolate confectionery in Brazil among adults aged 16+. The data is visualized using chocolate bar pieces of varying sizes to represent the percentage of usage for each type, including any type, milk chocolate, white chocolate, dark chocolate, and light/diet chocolate.

info.title: Metro Kilometer Expansion in Barcelona
info.description: The infographic shows the increase in metro kilometers in Barcelona under different administrations. In 2003 there were 24 kilometers and in 2010 there were 52 kilometers.

info.title: CO2 Emission Reduction per Ton of Plastic Packaging Waste
info.description: This infographic compares the amount of CO2 emission reduction per ton of plastic packaging waste under different deposit systems: current system, abolishing deposit, and expanding deposit. It uses the fill level of plastic bottles to represent the CO2 emission amount, with two bottles representing left and right separating method.

info.title: Gender representation in 'c de c' panel members
info.description: The infographic uses fruit as a metaphor to visualize the proportion of male and female members in the panel members of 'c de c'. It shows that there are 315 male members (represented by a cucumber) and 104 female members (represented by two halves of a melon), implying approximately one in every three members is a woman.

info.title: Food Waste in U.S. Landfills by Source
info.description: This infographic illustrates the percentage of food waste in U.S. landfills, broken down by different sources: Homes, Food Service, Retail, Manufacturing, and Farm Produce.

info.title: Weekly Percentage Lift
info.description: This infographic visualizes the weekly percentage lift using a 3D bar chart representation. It shows the trend of the lift over six weeks, with each week represented by three stacked bars of different colors.

info.title: Macronutrient Composition of a Meal
info.description: An infographic representing the macronutrient composition (carbs, fat, and protein) of a meal using a pie chart analogy with a plate and food.

info.title: Food Waste in the United States
info.description: This infographic illustrates the proportion of food produced in the United States that is never eaten, visualizing it with a pie chart representation using an apple.

info.title: Nutrition Plate
info.description: The image shows a plate with turkey breast and broccoli, along with their weights and calorie information. It provides a simple illustration of a balanced meal.

info.title: Greenpeace: Environmental Impact
info.description: This infographic created by Greenpeace highlights the environmental impact of pollution and deforestation, urging people to take action. It presents data about forest destruction in Nigeria and carbon dioxide emissions, along with the organization's mission and website.

info.title: Electromagnetic Spectrum and Household Appliances
info.description: Infographic illustrating the range of electromagnetic frequencies used by various household appliances and technologies, mapped onto the electromagnetic spectrum. It shows the frequency ranges associated with refrigerator, dishwasher, vacuum, TV, Microwave, Mixer, Blender, Can Opener, Electric Shaver and a mobile phone.

info.title: Change in Glacier Thickness at Hintereisferner Glacier
info.description: The infographic depicts the change in glacier thickness at the Hintereisferner Glacier over time (1960 to 2012). The size of the ice pieces represents the glacier's thickness in meters.

info.title: Top Shipping Companies by TEUs
info.description: This infographic visually represents the top shipping companies and their TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit) capacity, offering a comparison of their size and operations. It uses stacked cubes to represent TEU volume and illustrates the number of ships associated with each company.

info.title: Household appliance energy consumption
info.description: The infographic illustrates monthly energy consumption of various household appliances, highlighting that "Plasma TV is the most gluttonous of household electrical appliances. Working 5 hours a day, it eats 60 kWh per month". The energy consumption of each appliance is visually represented next to a corresponding image of the appliance.

info.title: Bar Chart Constructed in a Field
info.description: An overhead view of people constructing a bar chart using strings and posts in a field. The chart appears to show increasing values across four categories, represented by different colored strings.

info.title: Lion Bar Fat Content
info.description: An infographic showing the fat content of a Lion bar, as visually demonstrated by the bar being broken down into pieces that seem to represent the different percentages of fat.

info.title: Gasoline Price in Latvia (1996-2011)
info.description: The infographic shows the gasoline price in Latvia (1996-2011) through a line graph. The line graph visualizes the price fluctuation over time. The infographic includes a red gas container to represent gasoline.

info.title: Contents of Counseling Sessions
info.description: The infographic uses a creative visual metaphor of stacked speakers of varying sizes to represent the relative proportions of different topics discussed in counseling sessions. Each speaker represents a counseling topic, and the height (or size) of the speaker visually indicates its percentage share of all discussions.

info.title: World Freedom Statistics
info.description: This infographic presents statistics related to freedom of expression and belief in a hypothetical world village of 100 people. It visualizes the proportion of people who can and cannot exercise their faith and conscience without fear of persecution.

info.title: There's Always Room For Pie
info.description: An infographic detailing American pie preferences and a comparison between making your own pie crust versus buying ready-made.

info.title: The Leaders in the Hosting of Internet Porn Websites
info.description: This infographic depicts the distribution of internet porn website hosting among different countries, visualized using a Lego tower metaphor to represent proportions. The United States is shown to host the largest percentage (60%), followed by the Netherlands (26%) and then "Others" countries (14%).

info.title: City Comparison Bar Chart
info.description: This infographic presents a bar chart that visually compares percentages across different cities including Buenos Aires, Barcelona, Bogota, Caracas, La Paz, Lima, Mexico DF, Montevideo, Panama, and Quito. The chart appears to be physically constructed on a wall.

info.title: CO2 Emission in the Food Industry
info.description: The image shows a creative public display on a staircase highlighting the CO2 emissions associated with different food types. Each color-coded step represents a food category with its CO2 emission per kilogram.

info.title: Human Bar Chart
info.description: This image displays a unique visual representation of data, where humans are directly involved in creating a bar chart on a patch of land. Colored mats and ropes are strategically placed to form the bars and axes of the chart. The aerial perspective offers a clear view of the chart's structure and the interaction of people to construct the chart.

info.title: Sleep Hour Distribution on a Pillow
info.description: The infographic depicts the distribution of sleep hours among surveyed individuals. A pillow is visually divided into colored sections, each representing a sleep duration category (2-4 hrs, 4-6 hrs, 6-8 hrs, and more than 8hrs). The size of each section corresponds to the percentage of people who reported sleeping within that duration.

info.title: Evolution of Ship Types Over Time (1982-2002)
info.description: The infographic displays the types and sizes of various ships launched over a 20-year period, from 1982 to 2002. Each ship is represented by its silhouette, along with its length and the number of vessels of that type.

info.title: Births and Deaths in a 100-Person World
info.description: This infographic uses simple visuals to represent the number of births and deaths that would occur in a single year if the world's population were scaled down to a village of 100 people.

info.title: Skin color distribution in a village of 100 people
info.description: This infographic illustrates the distribution of skin colors if the world's population was represented as a village of 100 people. It shows that 70 people would be non-white and 30 people would be white, represented using a zebra, which is a creative way to show distributions.

info.title: Sexual Orientation in a Hypothetical Village of 100 People
info.description: The infographic presents a simplified view of sexual orientation in a hypothetical world represented as a village of 100 people. It shows the distribution between homosexual (10 people) and heterosexual (90 people) individuals using a banana illustration as a representation.

info.title: Computers in a Global Village of 100
info.description: This infographic presents a simplified view of computer ownership in the world, imagining the world as a village of 100 people. It shows that only 7 people would have computers, while 93 would not.

info.title: World Population Age Distribution: A Kangaroo Analogy
info.description: The infographic uses a kangaroo analogy to represent the age distribution of the world's population if it were a village of 100 people. It shows the proportion of adults (70) and children (30).

info.title: Fear in a village of 100 people
info.description: The infographic visualizes the proportion of people living in fear of death in a hypothetical village of 100 people. It shows that 20 people live in fear of death due to violence, while 80 do not.

info.title: Women's Fashion Export: Almost a Record
info.description: This infographic analyzes the export and import of women's fashion and related statistics. It uses visual elements like spools of thread to represent export/import volume across years and displays tabular data about the industry.

info.title: La Moda Bimbi Gioca Sulla Replica dei Genitori
info.description: An infographic about the children's fashion industry in Italy, discussing trends, exports, and leading companies.

info.title: Sales of Made in Italy Shoes
info.description: This infographic illustrates the countries driving the highest increases in orders for Italian brands, with China leading the pack. It also highlights the export record of the Italian leather industry.

info.title: Emerging Markets: Growth Through Top Fashion
info.description: An infographic showing the growth of the Italian fashion market in emerging markets, specifically focusing on top-tier fashion. It visualizes data related to market share and export increases, highlighting the influence of consumers in Russia, China, Korea, the United States, and Japan. The infographic includes a column chart showing the share from different countries.

info.title: Innovation in tanning and price cuts for selling to brands
info.description: This infographic depicts the changes in environmental impact and consumption in the leather tanning industry using a line chart constructed with ribbons on a textured background. Data includes chemical product consumption, waste production, water consumption, energy consumption, and solvent consumption across the years from 2002 to 2011. An accompanying article discusses the innovations and cost-cutting measures employed by tanneries to serve high-end brands and maintain European leadership in production volume.

info.title: The "Hidden" Value of Luxury Prices
info.description: This infographic illustrates the price multiples for various merchandise categories across three market segments. It highlights the opportunities for stretching price points, particularly in cosmetics, shoes, and hotels. The visualization compares core-luxury versus mass-market and ultra-luxury versus core-luxury pricing, showing how much more expensive luxury items are relative to their mass-market counterparts. The data is sourced from the Boston Consulting Group.

info.title: How the business of the white dress is changing
info.description: This infographic illustrates the average and maximum costs of wedding dresses in ten Italian cities using a visual representation of cakes with prices listed next to each city name.

info.title: Jeans, Long Seller Globale Che Non Invecchia
info.description: This infographic discusses the global market for jeans. It highlights key statistics such as the number of jeans purchased annually, the leading countries in jeans sales, and the emergence of premium brands. The infographic also includes data on Italian jeans exports and a section on textile waste recycling.

info.title: India Primatista Nei Gioielli Erode Quote Ai Competitor
info.description: This infographic discusses the shifts in the jewelry market, with a focus on India's growing dominance and the challenges faced by Italian manufacturers due to tariff barriers.

info.title: Men's Fashion Export in Europe
info.description: This infographic presents data about the export of men's fashion in European countries in the first six months of 2012. It highlights key trends, such as the overall increase in exports, the significant growth in exports to the United States, and the varying performance of different countries like Hong Kong and China. It also touches upon the challenges faced by the tie market and strategic market considerations.

info.title: Surprise Punctuality in Payment Times
info.description: An infographic showing the percentage of fashion companies that pay their invoices on time across several European countries. The data is presented using radial bars shaped like credit cards, each labeled with a country's name and flag.

info.title: Leadership da Difendere (e da Conquistare)
info.description: This infographic presents an analysis of the countries to which the Italian goldsmith industry exported in 2011, with an emphasis on countries outside of Europe. It compares import and export ratios, highlighting the industry's success in retaining and expanding market share in various regions.

info.title: Leather Goods Exports: Doubling Towards China
info.description: This infographic analyzes the leather goods exports and highlights the increase towards China, with specific data on the percentage of exports to China, Singapore, Quanda, Hong Kong, Emirati Arab, Turchia, and Corea. It also touches upon the booming luxury segment in the Tuscan district.

info.title: Capturing the Chinese Middle Class Via the Internet
info.description: This infographic, serving as a cover story for 'Industria & Finanza', visualizes the retail costs and the middle class in China. The infographic uses a world map with pins showing the cost of luxury retail space in major global cities, highlighting the importance of the Chinese market for the luxury goods industry. Additionally, text discusses the strategies needed to capture the Chinese middle class via the internet, touching upon the shifts in consumer behavior and the significance of online platforms.

info.title: Languages Spoken in a Hypothetical Village of 100 People
info.description: This infographic presents a hypothetical scenario where the world's population is reduced to a village of 100 people, illustrating the distribution of language speakers within that village. The graphic highlights the number of people who speak various languages, such as Chinese, Hindi, Arabic, and English, among others. The visual uses a speaker icon and sound waves to implicitly suggest communication and auditory perception, enhancing the theme of language.

info.title: Religion in a Hypothetical Village of 100 People
info.description: This infographic visualizes the distribution of religions within a hypothetical village of 100 people, using a stylized candle flame to represent the different religions and their respective proportions.

info.title: If the World Were a Village of 100 People: Money
info.description: This infographic illustrates the distribution of wealth in a hypothetical village of 100 people. It uses a piggy bank graphic to represent the distribution, showing how a small percentage of the population owns a large percentage of the world's wealth.

info.title: HIV Prevalence in a Hypothetical 100-Person Village
info.description: This infographic illustrates the prevalence of HIV by depicting what it would look like if the world were a village of 100 people. It uses the iconic red ribbon, symbol of AIDS awareness, to highlight that only 1 person in such a village would have HIV, while 99 would not.

info.title: Gender Pay Gap Visualization
info.description: This infographic visually represents the gender pay gap, stating that women earn 77% per dollar of men's earnings. The visualization uses a clock-like figure with movable hands to represent the percentage.

info.title: German Election Results Visualized with Food
info.description: An infographic showing the results of a German election, represented as a pie chart made from different types of food on a wooden cutting board. Each political party is associated with a specific food item, and the size of the food portion corresponds to the percentage of votes received. It is explicitly specified that the numbers represent votes for "Zweitstimmen" which are the votes cast for political party lists rather than individual candidates, it is a preliminary result, and the source is Infratest/Dimap.

info.title: Rise in International Tourism in Game of Thrones Filming Locations Since 2011
info.description: The infographic displays the increase in international tourism in different locations where Game of Thrones was filmed since 2011. Each location is represented by an image (a building or landscape) and a percentage, which indicates the rise in tourism. Andalusia is represented by Seville's Real Alcázar, Northern Ireland is represented by a castle, Dubrovnik is represented by King's Landing and Iceland is represented by a landscape with a river.

info.title: Palestinian Civilian Deaths in Conflicts
info.description: This infographic presents a comparison of the estimated number of Palestinian civilian deaths caused by Israeli military actions during various wars or combat periods. The data is visualized using watermelon slices of varying heights, representing the scale of casualties in each event, with the deadliest being the ongoing war in Gaza since late 2023.

info.title: Water footprint of food
info.description: Infographic showing the amount of water needed to produce one kilogram of various foods, emphasizing the hidden water consumption in everyday items and promoting awareness about water conservation.

info.title: Body Shaving Habits
info.description: An infographic showing the percentage of people who shave different parts of their body. The data is visualized with percentages annotated on a picture of a cactus, with lines indicating which part of the body the percentage refers to, and information on genders.

info.title: Gains and Losses of German Political Parties
info.description: This infographic shows the gains and losses of different German political parties (CDU, SPD, FDP, LINKE, GRÜNE, AfD) using pieces of food to represent the numerical values, presented on a wooden background.

info.title: Happiness Breakdown
info.description: The infographic presents the breakdown of happiness factors, based on Sonia Lyubomirsky's model. It shows genetics, activities, and life conditions contribute to overall happiness at 50%, 40% and 10% respectively.

info.title: Brand All'Assalto Del Mercato USA Target? Le Milionarie
info.description: This infographic discusses the brands that are targeting the US market, specifically millionaires, and the increasing number of wealthy women in the US, along with statistics on their spending habits and preferences.

info.title: A Natale Il Test Di Vendite Per Le Profumerie
info.description: This infographic discusses the sales test for perfumeries during Christmas, focusing on the Italian market. It analyzes the sales quotas of different channels, the total number of perfumeries and employees, and the top perfume chains in Italy. It also touches upon the estimated decline in turnover and strategies to resist the crisis.

info.title: Vivere Bene Piace di Più Che Avere Beni di Lusso
info.description: The infographic discusses the trend of experiential luxury over owning luxury goods, highlighting market growth and consumer preferences in various regions. It compares the annual growth of experiential and traditional luxury consumption from 2009 to 2011. It also mentions the shift in consumer values towards family and well-being, and the rise of luxury tourism in Italy, particularly among tourists from emerging markets. The infographic features a visual representation of growth rates in different regions, a quote by Boston Consulting Group, and data on the size of the experiential luxury market.

info.title: Per lo shopping dei solari Farmacie Superstar
info.description: This infographic presents data on sunscreen sales in pharmacies, highlighting the consumption patterns in 2011 and strategies to enhance skin protection from UVA and UVB rays. It also includes a brief history of sunscreens from ancient times to the present day and an article about eco-friendly sunscreens.

info.title: Doubling Wealth in the USA
info.description: An infographic from an Italian magazine illustrating the projected growth of wealth among millionaires in the United States from 2010 to 2020, broken down by state. The visualization uses a star-based symbolic representation to show relative wealth, and includes a map to highlight areas of high wealth concentration. Articles on sustainable fashion and California's economic performance are included in the same image.

info.title: Italian Eyewear Industry Leader in the World
info.description: This infographic focuses on the Italian eyewear industry, highlighting its global leadership, contributions to the national trade balance, and key production and export figures. It also showcases different eyewear brands and their products, focusing on trends and statistics within the sector, including production, exports, and workforce size.

info.title: Food Distribution in a Hypothetical Village of 100 People
info.description: This infographic visualizes the distribution of food resources in a hypothetical village of 100 people. It illustrates the proportions of people who are overweight, have enough to eat, are undernourished, lack a reliable food source, and are dying of starvation. The pie chart uses a pizza as a visual metaphor for the distribution of food.

info.title: Access to Clean Water: A Global Perspective
info.description: The infographic illustrates the distribution of access to clean and safe water if the world were a village of 100 people. It shows that 17 people do not have access to clean water, while 83 do.

info.title: Gender Distribution in a Hypothetical Village of 100 People
info.description: The infographic illustrates the gender distribution within a hypothetical village of 100 people, presenting the proportion of men and women using gender symbols and corresponding numbers.

info.title: Literacy in a hypothetical village of 100 people
info.description: This infographic presents literacy data, showing that in a hypothetical village of 100 people, 86 can read while 14 cannot. The visualization utilizes an image of sunglasses and simple labels to convey the data.

info.title: Education in a Global Village of 100 People
info.description: This infographic illustrates the proportion of people with college education in a hypothetical world village of 100 people, visualizing that only one person has a college education, while 99 haven't.

info.title: Air Quality in a Hypothetical Village of 100 People
info.description: This infographic illustrates the distribution of air quality among 100 people. It shows that 68 people breathe clean air, while 32 people breathe polluted air. The visual uses a cigarette-like figure to depict this distribution.

info.title: World Village: Fear
info.description: This infographic illustrates the concept of fear in a hypothetical world village of 100 people. It depicts the proportion of people living in fear of death due to violence, contrasting it with those who do not.

info.title: It's High Time: Sea Level Rise Awareness
info.description: This infographic depicts a giraffe partially submerged in water, with a ruler alongside indicating the water level. The years 2009 and 2050 are marked on the ruler, suggesting rising sea levels and a call to action related to the climate conference held in Copenhagen on December 11th. The message is that it's high time to act.

info.title: Customer Service vs. Insurance Direction vs. Customer Advocate
info.description: This infographic presents a single pie chart visualized as a physical arrangement of colored papers within a notebook, displaying proportions related to 'Atencion al Cliente' (Customer Service), 'Direccion General de Seguros' (General Insurance Direction), and 'Defensor del Cliente' (Customer Advocate).

info.title: Visualizations of the Food Crisis: Food Production
info.description: This infographic visualizes food production data related to the food crisis, possibly related to land degradation or changes in production capacity. The graphic uses a unique radial representation combined with a smaller donut chart to illustrate food production statistics and proportions.

info.title: Twenty-Fifty: Visualizations of the Food Crisis - Population Growth
info.description: This infographic visualizes population growth from 2000 to 2050 as part of a larger series on the food crisis. It presents the data using an onion graphic, where each layer represents a different year, and a line chart to show the population growth in a more traditional format.

info.title: Urbanisation and Food Crisis: A Visualisation
info.description: This infographic visualises the relationship between urbanisation and food crisis. It uses a pomegranate cut in half as an artistic base, onto which radial distance rings are added to the visualization to represent the scale of food production. At the lower right of the image is another chart showing population density in urban areas.

info.title: Visualizations of the Food Crisis: Climate Change
info.description: This infographic illustrates the relationship between climate change and its impact on the food crisis. It visualizes the projected temperature increase and CO2 levels from 2000 to 2050, overlaid on an image of an artichoke.  The infographic also includes a small area chart showing a similar trend.

info.title: Agrobiodiversity and Food Crisis Visualizations
info.description: An infographic about agrobiodiversity and its relation to the food crisis, visualizing the percentage of World Crop Diversity using a pie chart and relating it to the target year 2050.

info.title: Consumption Trends and Food Crisis
info.description: This infographic visualizes global calorie consumption trends in the context of a potential food crisis. It uses a creative visual representation of a durian, with calorie counts radiating outwards. A pie chart shows the distribution of different consumption levels (overconsumption, median, poverty, and malnutrition).

info.title: Methane vs. CO2 Warming Potential
info.description: This infographic visually compares the warming potential of methane and carbon dioxide (CO2) over a 20-year period. It uses matches to represent the relative warming power, showing that methane has significantly more warming potential (80x) than CO2.

info.title: Tree Ring Data Visualization
info.description: An infographic visualizing data related to a tree, using the tree rings as a basis for data representation. It includes a line graph overlaid on a grid, connected points to the tree trunk, suggesting a relationship between the tree and some external data (perhaps related to growth, health or environment)

info.title: Passengers/Baggage/Flights
info.description: The infographic visualizes data on passengers, baggage, and flights, presented as percentages within a circular design element containing images of water drops.

info.title: Sprinting Speed Comparison
info.description: An infographic comparing the top sprinting speeds of various animals and Usain Bolt, presented with illustrated animals and speed data in MPH.

info.title: Who Lifts More? Olympians vs. Land Animals
info.description: This infographic compares the lifting capabilities of an olympian (Hossein Rezazadeh) and an African elephant. It shows the weight lifted by Hossein Rezazadeh in the clean and jerk, and the weight an African elephant can lift with its trunk and bite.

info.title: Who Swims Faster? Olympians vs. Land Animals
info.description: This infographic compares the swimming speed of Michael Phelps, an Olympic swimmer, to that of the Indo-Pacific Sailfish. It shows the average speed of Michael Phelps and the top speed of the Sailfish on a shared axis.

info.title: Olympian vs. Land Animal Jump Comparison
info.description: This infographic compares the jumping distance of an Olympic long jumper, Mike Powell, to that of a snow leopard. It uses a visual scale to represent the distances achieved by each.

info.title: Who Runs Faster? Olympians vs. Land Animals
info.description: This infographic compares the running speeds of Usain Bolt, an olympian, and a cheetah, a land animal, presenting their world record, fastest time for 200m, average speed and top speed.

info.title: Shaving Habits Survey Results
info.description: An infographic showing the percentage of people who shave different body parts, broken down by gender where applicable. The visualization is creatively presented using burnt matchsticks to represent the shaved areas.

info.title: Food Nutritional Content Comparison
info.description: An infographic comparing the nutritional content of various foods including candy, cheese, and chocolate bars. It visually represents the amount of sugar, fat, calories, carbs, and protein in each food item using physical arrangement. It also compares percentage fat in different types of cheese.

info.title: U.S. Yoga Practitioners
info.description: This infographic visualizes the number of yoga practitioners in the U.S. in millions, comparing the numbers from 2008 to 2016. The data is presented as a bar chart integrated with an illustration of a yoga pose.

info.title: Non-Alcoholic Beer Awareness Survey
info.description: This infographic presents the results of a survey regarding the acceptance and opinions on drinking non-alcoholic beer in the office environment. It covers topics such as reasons for approval or disapproval, and the situations where people think it's acceptable to drink non-alcoholic beer.

info.title: NBA Career Scoring Leaders and Top 3 Sports by Popularity
info.description: The infographic displays two separate topics: the top ten NBA career scoring leaders and the top three most popular sports globally by fans.

info.title: Shelf Life
info.description: This infographic compares the shelf life of various food products and the lifespan of electronic devices, showing how long they last before becoming unusable or outdated.

info.title: Frequency of Tissue/Paper Towel Usage
info.description: This infographic presents data on the frequency of tissue or paper towel usage, segmented by gender. It visualizes the percentage of people who use these items a certain number of times (e.g., 1-3 times, 4-5 times) and further breaks down these percentages by male and female.

info.title: Food Waste Awareness
info.description: An infographic raising awareness about food waste, showing that 1/3 of food is thrown away and the average family wastes £400 worth of food a year.

info.title: Addiction Statistics in Styria, Austria
info.description: The infographic presents statistics on various types of addiction affecting the population of Styria, Austria. It lists the number of individuals affected by alcohol, medication, gambling, and opioid addiction, visually associating these numbers with individuals bowing their heads in what appears to be shame or despair. The infographic also contains a brief text description above the visualization.

info.title: Top-Selling Living Female Artists & Prizes for Women at the Venice Biennale
info.description: The infographic presents two separate visualizations: the first showcases the top-selling living female artists between 1985 and 2014, represented by a bar chart. The second visualizes the prizes awarded to women at the Venice Biennale since 1986, presented as a timeline along a ribbon.

info.title: Industrial Greenhouse Gas Emissions Since 1988
info.description: The infographic presents the myth versus the reality of pollution. The myth is that people start pollution and can stop it. The reality is that 100 producers account for 71% of global industrial greenhouse gas emissions since 1988. It also visualizes the increase in gigatonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent from 1988 to 2015 with a painted area chart style, highlighting the impact of the top fossil fuel producers.

info.title: Global World Temperature Index from 1880 to 2019
info.description: This infographic visualizes the global world temperature index, showing temperature anomalies from 1880 to 2019. The temperature anomaly is measured in degrees Celsius, with the period from 1951-1980 used as a baseline. The visual representation uses a line graph with a stylized, textured line that transitions from black/white to orange/red to represent increasing temperatures. A person standing next to the x-axis in 2019 visually emphasizes the current state.

info.title: Mental Burden During Pandemic
info.description: This infographic visualizes the prevalence of depression symptoms before and during the pandemic. It uses a line graph superimposed on an image of a person to convey the emotional impact of the data.

info.title: The Gap: Median net wealth of US Households
info.description: This infographic illustrates the wealth gap between white and black households in the US from 1998 to 2016, using a line graph with a creative visual element. The data is represented by lines indicating the median net wealth of each group over time, and the graph is partially obscured by an image to emphasize the subject.

info.title: The German Problem: Why Its Surplus is Damaging the World Economy
info.description: The infographic is a cover of The Economist magazine. It visually represents the German current account balance as a percentage of GDP using a bar chart integrated into the silhouette of a German eagle.

info.title: Births Registered in Australia in 2012 by States
info.description: This infographic illustrates the number of births registered in each state of Australia in 2012. The visualization uses a stacked paper/documents metaphor where the height of the stack represents the number of births. Each stack is associated with one of Australia's states.

info.title: Weekly Revenue Bar Chart
info.description: A bar chart showing the revenue trend over five weeks, with the bars represented by stacks of sesame bars.

info.title: Studientage: Regional Distribution of Participants
info.description: This infographic visualizes the regional distribution of participants in the 'Studientage' ('Study Days') event of 2011. The event focused on addiction research and work, providing a communication platform for interested individuals. The data is represented using a bar chart metaphor, where each bar is depicted by a colored pencil of varying height, corresponding to the percentage of participants from each region. The background is a photograph of barren or desert land, with the pencils embedded in the ground.

info.title: Employment at Piraeus Bank Group (2011)
info.description: This infographic shows the average time of employment in years at Piraeus Bank Group in 2011. The visualization uses a stylized track field to represent the data for Piraeus Bank S.A., International Subsidiaries, and Domestic Subsidiaries.

info.title: French People and Musical Instruments
info.description: The infographic shows that 19% of French people know how to play a musical instrument. The accordion image is used to represent musical instruments in general.

info.title: Proportion of young workers earning less than 2 million won per month
info.description: The infographic presents a visual comparison of the proportion of young male and female workers earning less than 2 million won per month. It uses figures filled with color to represent the percentages, showing 85.0% for men and 79.8% for women.

info.title: Don't be bananas! Reduce food waste
info.description: This infographic is a call to action to reduce food waste, specifically targeting British consumers. It uses a visual metaphor of fresh and rotten bananas to highlight the issue, stating that British people waste 50% of the food they buy. It advises consumers to make a shopping list and buy only what they need to reduce food waste, giving more context about food waste statistics in the UK.

info.title: Fight Food Waste: Preventing Spoilage During Ocean Transport
info.description: Infographic promoting the use of Super Dry desiccants to prevent food spoilage, specifically showing the difference between fresh bread and moldy bread to emphasize the impact of spoilage during ocean transport.

info.title: Annual Food Waste
info.description: This infographic illustrates annual food waste, showing the amount of food wasted per person in Italy (146 kg), the proportion of global food production that ends up in the trash (1/3), and the total amount of food wasted globally (1.3 billion tons). The food waste is visually depicted as overflowing a plate.

info.title: Pacman Food Waste Eating Earth
info.description: The infographic uses the visual metaphor of Pac-Man made of food waste consuming the Earth to highlight the issue of food waste and its impact on the planet. The visual emphasizes that food waste will consume our planet if it is not taken seriously.

info.title: Food Waste Awareness
info.description: This infographic raises awareness about global food waste, stating that a third of food is wasted globally and urging people to reduce waste. It uses a plate divided into three sections, visually representing the proportion of food wasted.

info.title: Food Waste Prevention
info.description: This infographic aims to raise awareness about food waste. It visually represents the proportion of food wasted (1/3) using a pie chart segment showing a picture of food and the rest of the pie represented with a coin. The message is further emphasized with the call to action: "STOP IT RESPECT FOOD".

info.title: Don't be a bad apple!
info.description: This infographic is designed to raise awareness about food waste, specifically in the UK. It uses the visual metaphor of a "bad apple" to represent wasted food and encourages consumers to shop responsibly by making a list and only buying what they need. It highlights that British people waste 50% of the food they buy.

info.title: 30% of bananas end up in the trash
info.description: This infographic highlights that 30% of bananas end up in the trash to bring awareness of food waste, aiming to stop food waste.

info.title: 60-30-10 Colour Rule for Suit
info.description: This infographic explains the 60-30-10 color rule, demonstrating how to apply it to a suit for a simple and effective color scheme. It breaks down the color distribution for a suit, shirt, and tie, visualizing the proportions with a stacked bar chart.

info.title: Seat at the Table: Women CEOs in Fortune 500 Companies
info.description: This infographic uses a pie chart and physical objects (stools) to represent the percentage of women CEOs in Fortune 500 companies. The pie chart shows a small yellow slice representing the 5% of women CEOs, which is also displayed separately on the ground. The surrounding stools symbolize the seats at the table, highlighting the underrepresentation of women in top leadership positions.

info.title: Gender Income Gap by Ethnicity
info.description: This infographic illustrates the gender income gap in the United States, focusing on how much women of different ethnicities are paid for every dollar paid to white men. It visualizes the disparity in earnings for Latina women, Black women, Asian women, Native Hawaiian & Pacific Islander women, and American Indian & Alaska Native men.

info.title: Renewable Energy Shares in Heat Generation and Electricity Consumption
info.description: This infographic presents the shares of renewable energy in heat generation (Wärmeproduktion) and electricity consumption (Elektrizitätsverbrauch) in Germany. It uses a segmented radiator graphic to show that 18.9% of heat production is generated by renewable energy, and a segmented electrical cord coil to illustrate that 55.8% of the electricity consumption comes from renewable energy sources.

info.title: Popcorn Growth Chart
info.description: A creative visualization using popcorn to represent a scatter plot, showing the '% LIFT' over '# OF DAYS'. Different types of popcorn symbolize varying levels of growth or lift, with a range from corn kernels to white popcorn to yellow popcorn to orange popcorn to red popcorn.

info.title: Transport Bar Graph
info.description: An infographic illustrating the distribution of different modes of transport with percentage shown in a bar graph format.

info.title: European's Views on Cannabis
info.description: The infographic presents European's views on cannabis, showing percentage breakdowns of agreement and disagreement for statements related to cannabis consumption, legalization, societal impact, and harm comparison with alcohol and tobacco. The visualization uses a combination of stylized 3D block charts to represent the percentage data.

info.title: Europeans' preferences for cannabis sales types
info.description: The infographic illustrates the types of cannabis sales Europeans prefer, categorizing preferences for regulated stores, home grow, and social clubs. It shows the percentage of people who support, oppose, or have neutral opinions on each type of sales. Additionally, for those who support cannabis legalization, it shows their preferences.

info.title: Cassina ixc. Christmas Research
info.description: The infographic presents data related to Christmas spending habits, likely as part of a research study conducted by Cassina ixc. It utilizes a pie chart representation with each section depicting a different spending range and corresponding percentage. People are placed around the pie chart.

info.title: Time and Growth
info.description: An illustration showing a watch with the watch strap visualized as a line chart, indicating growth or progress over time.

info.title: Gross Gathering of Crops
info.description: An infographic showing the gross gathering of various crops, including legumes, vegetables, potatoes, cereals, and forage. It presents the total tonnage and the percentage of each crop in the total gathering.

info.title: Animals Killed Per Second Worldwide (2014)
info.description: This infographic visually represents the number of animals killed per second worldwide in 2014. Each animal type (chicken, duck, pig, etc.) is represented by its silhouette, with the quantity of silhouettes corresponding to the number killed per second.

info.title: Pink Tahini Smoothie Recipe
info.description: The image shows a visual list of ingredients for making a 'Pink Tahini Smoothie'. The ingredients, almond milk, raspberries, tahini and bananas, are arranged within an outlined drawing of a smoothie glass to illustrate the recipe.

info.title: Florida Wildlife
info.description: This infographic presents information about Florida's wildlife and environment, including coastline length, beach length, the status of the Everglades, and impacts on wildlife. The infographic uses 3D pie chart slices and simple percentages to visualize the data.

info.title: Land Ownership Pie Chart
info.description: This infographic depicts land ownership distribution, showing the percentage of land that is privately-owned versus government-owned using a pie chart. The pie chart is stylized to resemble a cross-section of land with trees.

info.title: Forest Certification in the U.S.
info.description: This infographic visualizes the percentage of certified versus non-certified working forests in the U.S., and breaks down the certification percentages by type (ATFS, FSC, SFI).

info.title: Land Bank Distribution
info.description: This infographic presents the distribution of a 70,000-hectare land bank across different agricultural uses, including sheep grazing, forage cows, agricultural premises, vegetables and perennial herbs, feeds, crops and legumes, and agricultural technical units. The distribution is represented in a visually appealing, segmented 3D pie chart.

info.title: Sustainable Forest Management
info.description: This infographic visually represents the increase in U.S. forest lands today compared to 100 years ago, highlighting the success of sustainable forest management despite population growth. It compares forest land cover from 100 years ago to the present day, suggesting responsible land management practices by private landowners.

info.title: Evolution of forest area in metropolitan France
info.description: This infographic depicts the evolution of forest area in metropolitan France in millions of hectares over time, using leaves of different types and sizes to represent forest cover in 1830, 1985, and 2018.

info.title: Commute Time Change by Time Group
info.description: The infographic depicts the number of employees whose commute lengthened or shortened, grouped by time intervals. The data is visualized using a creative representation of test tubes filled with different amounts of colored liquid to represent the number of employees in each category. It shows that the longer the time interval, the more commute time lengthened, and vice-versa.

info.title: Green City Infographics
info.description: An infographic depicting the elements of a green city, including renewable energy, green buildings, and environmental initiatives, presented with percentages and illustrative graphics. It also contains a world map showing percentage distributions across different regions.

info.title: Distribution of Drinking Water on Earth
info.description: The infographic illustrates the distribution of drinking water on Earth, showing the proportion of salt water, fresh water, and its various forms such as ice caps, glaciers, groundwater, soil water, lake water, atmospheric water vapor, water in living organisms, and rivers. The visualization uses stacked pie charts to represent the proportional distribution.

info.title: Distribution of the World's Water
info.description: The infographic shows the distribution of the world's water, breaking it down into all water, freshwater, and accessible surface freshwater. It uses a series of stacked pie charts to represent the proportions of each category.

info.title: Distribution of Water on Earth
info.description: This infographic visualizes the distribution of water on Earth, breaking it down from total water to freshwater, and then to surface and atmospheric water. It shows the percentage of water found in each category, such as oceans, glaciers, groundwater, freshwater lakes, etc.

info.title: Earth's Water Distribution
info.description: This infographic illustrates the distribution of water on Earth, breaking it down into oceans, freshwater, and then further detailing the components of freshwater such as ice caps/glaciers, groundwater, easily accessible freshwater (lakes, soil moisture, rivers, water vapor, and water in living things).

info.title: Earth's Surface by Type
info.description: This infographic shows the distribution of Earth's surface by type, measured in hectares. It breaks down the surface into ocean, glaciers, barren land, and habitable land, showing the percentage and size in billions of hectares for each category.

info.title: Beliefs about afterlife
info.description: The infographic depicts percentages associated with different beliefs about the afterlife. The percentages are represented using candles of varying heights, giving a visual comparison of the proportions. The data suggests different levels of belief in various concepts. The values are 37%, 24%, 13%, 14%, 13% associated with 'nichts' (nothing), 'Leben im Jenseits' (life in the afterlife), 'Wiedergeburt' (reincarnation), 'nichts davon' (none of that), and 'weiß nicht' (don't know), respectively.

info.title: German Election Results: 18-24 Year Old Voters
info.description: This infographic visualizes the hypothetical election results in Germany if only voters aged 18-24 had participated. The data is represented by clothes hanging on a clothesline, with each piece of clothing corresponding to a political party. The percentage of votes each party received is displayed above the corresponding item.

info.title: Daily Nutrition Breakdown for Friday
info.description: Infographic visualizing the daily nutritional intake, broken down into macronutrient percentages and a tabular presentation of food items with their corresponding calorie, carb, fat, and protein values.

info.title: Sausage Fest: Cooking Habits
info.description: The infographic humorously compares the cooking habits of men and women in home settings versus five-star restaurants, using food items and numerical values to represent the data.

info.title: Top 10 Most Valuable Brands
info.description: The infographic depicts the ranking of the top 10 most valuable brands, visualized using cow-shaped icons, each branded with the respective company's logo and value in millions of dollars.

info.title: Designer Satisfaction Levels
info.description: The infographic illustrates the satisfaction levels of designers, differentiating between self-employed (selbstständig) and employed (angestellt) designers. Satisfaction is represented by a hand constructed of thumbs-up signs, with each finger corresponding to a different satisfaction percentage for each employment type.

info.title: Plastic Bag in the Environment
info.description: This infographic uses a plastic bag as a pie chart to illustrate the distribution of plastic bags in different locations in the environment. It shows that 70% of plastic bags sink to the seabed, while 15% reach the coasts and beaches, and another 15% float on the water surface.

info.title: Nutritional Information of Churros
info.description: This infographic visually represents the nutritional information of 100 grams of churros, highlighting the amounts of proteins, fats, carbohydrates, and fiber using liquid levels in bottles to represent the proportions. A scale on the side provides a reference for the amounts.

info.title: European Commercial Property: Q4 2013 Investment Levels
info.description: The infographic visualizes the investment levels in European commercial property between Q4 2012 and Q4 2013. It shows a comparison of investment amounts using buildings as a visual metaphor, with a rocket illustrating the percentage increase.

info.title: Components of Gasoline Price in Russia
info.description: This infographic illustrates the breakdown of the average retail price of 1 liter of Ai-92 gasoline in Russia, which is approximately 33 rubles. It displays the percentage and monetary value allocated to different factors such as crude oil cost, transportation expenses, refinery markup, gas station markup, and government taxes.

info.title: Twitter User Growth: 2008-2012
info.description: This infographic snippet visualizes the growth of Twitter users from 6 million in 2008 to 500 million in 2012. It uses a creative, isometric design featuring a stylized representation of an athlete leaping to demonstrate the exponential increase in users over time. Numbers are placed near the leaping athlete to show the timeline of the growth.

info.title: Channels used by top Olympic sponsors
info.description: This infographic illustrates the percentage of top Olympic sponsors utilizing various digital channels, ranked from highest to lowest adoption rate. The channels include Corporate Site, Corporate YouTube, Corporate Twitter, Corporate Facebook Page, Microsite, Hashtag, Facebook Campaign Page, YouTube Campaign, and Campaign Twitter Handle.

info.title: Growing the Green Job Boom
info.description: This infographic illustrates how stimulus funds are allocated to various initiatives aimed at creating green jobs through energy efficiency and weatherization programs. It breaks down the distribution of funds across different states and programs, showing how the money is being used to improve communities.

info.title: Food Waste in Daily Life
info.description: This infographic illustrates the problem of food waste in daily life. It shows the percentage of different food categories that are wasted, and visualizes the amount of food wasted with a pizza pie chart. Also, it compares food waste to land and water usage.

info.title: Soyuz-5 Rocket Family
info.description: An infographic illustrating the characteristics and development timeline of the Soyuz-5 family of carrier rockets, comparing three different configurations. It highlights key features like fuel components, payload capacity, and developmental milestones, along with a map indicating launch sites.

info.title: Proton-M Rocket Carrier Infographic
info.description: This infographic provides technical specifications and key milestones of the Proton-M rocket carrier. It highlights details such as fuel, oxidizer, launch mass, launch cost, launch dates, and the location of launch sites. It further breaks down the rocket into sections, indicating dimensions of each and other attributes.

info.title: Bread Consumption Statistics in Times of Hardship
info.description: The infographic presents statistics related to bread consumption and costs in Germany during a period of economic hardship, specifically referencing 'Hartz IV,' a German unemployment benefit system. The infographic uses images of different types of bread to represent numerical data.

info.title: Food Supply Distance in the Ile-de-France Region
info.description: This infographic illustrates the increase in the average distance food travels to reach plates in the Ile-de-France region from the end of the 19th century to the present day. It visualizes the change in distance using the size of forks, with a smaller fork representing 150km and a larger fork representing 660km.

info.title: Energy Bill Breakdown by Consumption
info.description: This infographic shows the breakdown of energy consumption in a household, highlighting the percentage of energy used by various appliances and systems.

info.title: Liquid Assets: Access to Liquid Assets by Population Group
info.description: This infographic visualizes the percentage of different population groups who have access to liquid assets. It uses glasses filled with liquid to represent the percentages for US White, US Black, Caribbean Black, Dominican, and Puerto Rican populations.

info.title: Smoothie Ingredients Breakdown
info.description: The infographic shows the percentage breakdown of ingredients in a smoothie with visual representations of fruits.

info.title: Bagel Facts
info.description: This infographic presents fun facts about bagels using data visualizations. It shows the popularity of different cream cheese flavors, preferences for toasting bagels, and the favorite type of bagels.

info.title: Age Distribution of Contacts
info.description: An infographic showing the age distribution of contacts in the Kontaktladencafé and within the framework of Streetworkeinsätze. The infographic presents the age ranges with corresponding percentages above a photo of five people blowing bubbles. The age ranges include 'bis 19 Jahre', '20-25 Jahre', '26-30 Jahre', '31-40 Jahre', and 'über 40 Jahre'.

info.title: Balloon Survey Results
info.description: This image presents the results of a survey, visualized with balloons representing different response percentages. The size and color of the balloons are used to correlate with the percentage value of each option.

info.title: Oats So Good!: Mintel News on British Breakfast Habits
info.description: This infographic from Mintel presents data on British breakfast preferences, focusing on porridge and cereal consumption. It uses imagery of bowls of food with overlaid proportional charts to highlight key statistics about the popularity of these breakfast options among Brits.

info.title: Mr. Android 2011
info.description: This infographic, titled "Mr. Android 2011," visually represents statistical data about characteristics and behaviors associated with Android users, presented using a person's body as the canvas to show the percentage in question.

info.title: Incandescent vs. LED Bulb Comparison
info.description: This infographic compares the energy consumption, lumens, projected lifespan, and costs associated with incandescent light bulbs versus LED light bulbs. It uses visually appealing light bulb illustrations to display the data.

info.title: Nescafé Coffee Volume Ad
info.description: A Nescafé advertisement portraying a coffee cup as a volume knob set to 8 out of 10, implying a high level of enjoyment or intensity.

info.title: Commercial Advertising Breakdown
info.description: This infographic shows a breakdown of the most advertised product categories during commercials, using an Oreo cookie as a pie chart. It also includes information about the percentage of people who don't care who is playing during the commercial breaks.

info.title: What you can buy for one euro
info.description: The infographic visualizes how much of different liquids you can buy for one euro. It uses circle sizes to represent the relative quantities of various liquids in the categories of food, cosmetic/agriculture/technology, and medicine/research.

info.title: Weight Gain Reasons in Quarantine: A Couple's Perspective
info.description: This infographic presents a humorous analysis of weight gain reasons for a couple during quarantine, attributing the contributing percentages for 'He' and 'She' to factors like 'Fridge assault,' 'Delivery meals,' and 'Boring meetings.' The data is visually represented using donuts, where different toppings symbolize the different causes.

info.title: Physical activity level in percent by gender
info.description: The infographic illustrates the percentage of physical activity among women and men, represented by two separate images. The image on the left shows a woman's shoe and the percentage of 23%, while the image on the right shows a man's shoe with the percentage of 32%.

info.title: The Stakes Have Changed: Top 5 Activities During the Pandemic
info.description: The infographic presents the top 5 activities people have been doing more than usual during the pandemic, ranked by percentage. The activities are: reflecting on what we want in life (46%), appreciating nature (36%), learning new skills (36%), exercising (30%), and cooking (40%).

info.title: Movie Waves in 21st Century: Domestic Box Office
info.description: An infographic displaying the domestic box office performance of top movies each week from 2001 to 2020, using stacked area charts to represent the cumulative gross of the top films.

info.title: The Olympics 1896-2008
info.description: This infographic shows the participation of countries in the Olympic Games from 1896 to 2008. Each country is represented around a circular axis, with colored blocks indicating the years they participated. The infographic is shaped like the number '0'.

info.title: Refugee FDP IDP - A helping hand
info.description: This infographic visualizes the refugee resettlement program in the US, focusing on the flow of refugees from various countries of origin to different states within the US. It highlights the scale and impact of the program, the countries most impacted by displacement, and some additional data about religion of the resettled refugees.

info.title: The challenges of a sea that doesn't stop rising
info.description: This infographic illustrates the potential consequences of rising sea levels due to climate change. It showcases how various coastal cities around the world, such as Venice, Lisbon, Los Angeles, and Shanghai, will be impacted, indicating specific height increases and corresponding visual representations of the cities at different sea-level rise scenarios. The infographic also provides brief textual explanations of the measures each city is taking, or the challenges they face, due to the rising sea levels.

info.title: The Lowest Temperatures Ever Recorded
info.description: An infographic showing the lowest temperatures ever recorded in the world at various locations, visually represented using icicles of varying sizes, and temperatures.

info.title: America's Top 25 Newspapers by Print Circulation in 2021
info.description: This infographic presents the top 25 newspapers in America by print circulation in 2021. It illustrates the circulation numbers and year-over-year changes for each newspaper, using stacks of newspaper images to visually represent circulation volume.

info.title: Waste of Perishable Products in Europe
info.description: This infographic shows the total waste per food category, in percentage of amount produced in Europe.

info.title: Food Stamp Program Awareness in California
info.description: This infographic uses a pie chart analogy (visualized as a pie) to illustrate the percentage of Californian people who needed the food stamp program but did not participate due to lack of awareness. The infographic features a retro design style, incorporating an image of an old food coupon.

info.title: Bicycle Ride Elevation and Performance Metrics
info.description: This infographic visualizes data from a bicycle ride, showing elevation changes, distance covered, watts generated, and other performance metrics. The primary visualization is a 3D-rendered elevation profile with color-coded gradient, supplemented by smaller charts and icons representing different performance metrics.

info.title: A Matter of Life and Death: Fruit Rotting Time
info.description: This infographic illustrates how long it takes for various fruits to rot beyond edibility, highlighting the nutritional facts, the process of decay, and the benefits of each fruit.

info.title: Food Stamps in California
info.description: The infographic depicts the percentage of Californian people who are on food stamps, which is 10% of 40 million people.

info.title: Recidivism Rate of Prisoners Released in 1994
info.description: This infographic shows the recidivism rate of prisoners released in 1994, broken down by the type of offense. The data is presented using a pie chart shaped like handcuffs.

info.title: Youth Unemployment Rate in Spain
info.description: This infographic illustrates the youth unemployment rate in Spain from 2007 to 2012. It showcases the increasing unemployment rate among youth (15-24 year olds) with accompanying visual elements representing people holding up balloons displaying the youth unemployment percentage on top of a bar chart showing the total unemployment rate.

info.title: Fraud Cases Detected in Private Companies by Method
info.description: This infographic shows the percentage of fraud cases detected in private companies by various methods. The data is presented within a stylized image of a whistle, with each section of the whistle representing a different method and its corresponding percentage.

info.title: Comparative Sales of Fast Food Chains and Afghanistan's GDP
info.description: The infographic visually compares the sales of various fast-food companies with Afghanistan's GDP, using a combination of logos and a modified bar chart.

info.title: Top 5 Largest Coffee Chains in the US
info.description: This infographic illustrates the top 5 largest coffee chains in the US, showcasing their number of locations using a visual representation of spilled coffee from tilted cups, with each cup displaying the logo of a respective chain.

info.title: Go Light When You Grab a Bite: Eating Out vs. Eating at Home
info.description: This infographic illustrates the shift in American eating habits from 1960 to 2011, highlighting the increased consumption of meals away from home and its potential impact on health. It also offers tips for making healthier choices when eating on the go.

info.title: America's Rising Obesity Rate
info.description: The infographic illustrates the rising obesity rate in America from 1980 to 2008. It visually represents the percentage of obese Americans in different years, using stacked burgers to represent an increasing obesity rate from 1980 to 2008.

info.title: US Population by Race/Ethnicity: 1960, 2010, 2060 (Projected)
info.description: The infographic presents a series of pie charts, styled as heads, illustrating the racial and ethnic composition of the United States population in 1960, 2010, and a projected composition for 2060. Each chart displays the percentage breakdown of Whites, Blacks, Hispanics, Asians, and Other groups, providing a visual comparison of demographic shifts over time.

info.title: Comparison of commuting methods
info.description: The infographic presents a comparison of different modes of transport for commuting to work, showing the percentage of people who use each mode: on foot, bicycle, public transport, and car. The image combines illustrative elements (city skyline) with bar-like representation to show the percentages.

info.title: Daytona 500, el vértigo de la Nascar
info.description: This infographic explains the steepness of the turns on Nascar tracks compared to other racing circuits. It shows different locations and their corresponding angles of inclination, along with cost breakdown of a Nascar racing team.

info.title: Facebook Growth and Coca-Cola's "Move to the Beat" Campaign
info.description: The infographic illustrates the growth of Facebook users between 2008 and 2012, juxtaposed with the impact of Coca-Cola's "Move to the Beat" music video campaign on Facebook. It uses visual elements like a pole vaulter to represent Facebook's growth and isometric blocks.

info.title: YouTube Views Per Day: 2008 vs 2012
info.description: This infographic depicts the increase in YouTube views per day from 2008 (133 million) to 2012 (4 billion). The increase is visually represented using 3D bars and a high jump athlete figure to symbolize overcoming the initial amount of view.

info.title: European E-commerce Market Share
info.description: This infographic visualizes the market share of e-commerce sales in various European countries. The countries are listed along the y-axis, and the numbers are represented by the sizes of stacked 3D shopping bags and boxes. It shows the relative distribution of e-commerce activity among the shown European nations.

info.title: What Entrepreneurs Sacrificed to Start Their Own Businesses
info.description: This infographic illustrates the sacrifices entrepreneurs make when starting their own businesses, presented as a "time sacrifice".

info.title: Taiwan Pineapple Export Ratio to China (2005-2020)
info.description: This infographic shows the change in the ratio of Taiwan's pineapple exports to China from 2005 to 2020. The ratio is represented by the proportion of the pineapple slice shown each year.

info.title: Total Number of Registered Violence Crimes
