info.description: This infographic shows the total number of registered violence crimes. It uses bandage-shaped bars to represent the data points, and the values are labeled above each bar. The infographic also includes a brief description of the different forms of violence and the places where it occurs.

info.title: Urban Leaks: The Sustainability of Water
info.description: This infographic visualizes data about the global water crisis, focusing on progress made, challenges in overconsumption, limitations of fresh water, and potential crisis prevention strategies. It uses a combination of visualizations and textual information.

info.title: Real Change: Millions of Euros Agreed with the State
info.description: The infographic shows the financial difference between the two parties, CIU and MONTILLA, regarding millions of euros agreed with the state.

info.title: Daily Calorie Intake Expressed Using Pastries
info.description: This infographic visualizes daily calorie intake from Friday to Thursday using the sizes of pastries to represent the amount of calories consumed on each day.

info.title: Gross Monthly Income Comparison
info.description: The infographic compares the gross monthly income of different professions and positions in Germany as of 2012. The data is represented by piles of green peas, where the size of the pile corresponds to the income amount in euros.

info.title: Greenhouse Gas Emission Trends in Taiwan (1990-2012)
info.description: This infographic illustrates the trend of greenhouse gas emissions in Taiwan from 1990 to 2012. It displays the total emissions in kilotons of carbon dioxide equivalent, broken down by carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases, for each year.

info.title: Greenhouse Gas Emission Trends in Taiwan
info.description: The infographic presents the emission trends of various greenhouse gases in Taiwan from 1990 to 2012. It uses line charts to illustrate the changes in emission levels of CO2, SF6, N2O, HFCS, CH4, and PFCs. A pie chart shows the proportion of each gas to the total greenhouse gas emissions in 2012.

info.title: Greenhouse Gas Emission Trends and Explanation
info.description: The infographic presents the trends in emissions of various greenhouse gases in Taiwan and their contribution to total emissions in 2012. It uses bar charts to visualize the emission trends of CO2, SF6, N2O, HFCS, CH4, and PFCs from 1990 to 2012, along with a pie chart to show the percentage of each gas in the total emissions for 2012.

info.title: Trends and Explanations of Various Emission Sources
info.description: This infographic illustrates the trends and explanations of greenhouse gas emissions from various sources in Taiwan, categorized into energy, industrial processes, agriculture, and waste management sectors. It shows the percentage contribution of each sector in 2012 and plots emission trends over time, along with explanations for observed changes.

info.title: Greenhouse Gas Emission Trends by Source in Taiwan
info.description: This infographic illustrates the greenhouse gas emission trends in Taiwan from 1990 to 2012, broken down by different sectors: energy, industry, agriculture, waste management, and land use/forestry. It uses a line chart to show the overall trend and a bar chart to show the proportions of each sector in 2012. It also provides a brief explanation for each sector.

info.title: Test Tube Data Flow Infographic
info.description: This infographic depicts data flow using test tubes filled with different colored liquids, each representing a different data point. The liquids 'pour' down the page, and beside each test tube is an indicator and text placeholder.

info.title: Visualizing the Biomass of Life
info.description: This infographic visualizes the biomass of different animal groups, measured by the amount of carbon they contain. The infographic uses stacked cubes to represent the biomass of different animal groups, with each cube representing 1 million metric tons of carbon. The animal groups are ordered by their biomass, from Arthropods Marine to Wild Birds.

info.title: Earth: Satellites and Orbit
info.description: This infographic visualizes the Earth's orbit and highlights the timeline of satellite launches, as well as comparing Earth to other planets and their missions.

info.title: 2015 Taiwan Bicycle Export Situation
info.description: This infographic visualizes Taiwan's bicycle export situation in 2015. It shows the total sales volume, average unit price, and the main export destinations with corresponding percentages and unit prices.

info.title: Big Mac Price Comparison by Country
info.description: An infographic comparing the price of a Big Mac in different countries, using a unique bar chart representation where the bars are stylized to resemble the Big Mac itself.

info.title: Which countries eat the most eggs in the world?
info.description: This infographic presents data on the average annual egg consumption per person in different countries, displaying the data using egg-shaped icons filled with the national flags of those countries. It also showcases representative egg dishes from each country.

info.title: Desalination Worldwide
info.description: This infographic visualizes data about desalination around the world, including the number of countries using it, demand growth, desalination capacity by country, the number of desalination plants, desalination methods, and the cost of desalination.

info.title: Beauty in Numbers: An Overview of the Cosmetics Industry
info.description: This infographic provides an overview of the beauty and cosmetics industry, highlighting the largest and most profitable manufacturers, the breakdown of the global cosmetics market, predicted sales growth, and top beauty and personal care markets worldwide.

info.title: The Perfect Pour: A Citizen's Guide to Coffee
info.description: This infographic provides a visual guide to the ingredients and proportions for various coffee drinks. Each drink is represented by a circle divided into segments corresponding to the ratio of different components like espresso, milk, water, and other additions.

info.title: Golden Cadres: Number of Civil Servants in Russia
info.description: This infographic shows the number of government employees in Russia per 1000 people employed in the economy, the dynamics of oil prices and historical events related to the reduction in the number of federal civil servants.

info.title: Seoul Citizens' Smoking Cessation Diary (2017)
info.description: An infographic presenting statistics on smoking habits and smoking cessation efforts among Seoul citizens. It includes data on smoking rates, daily cigarette consumption, attempts to quit, and reasons for quitting.

info.title: Heatstroke Patients and 119 Heatwave Emergency Response Teams
info.description: This infographic provides information about heatstroke patients and the efforts of the 119 heatwave emergency response teams. It includes statistics on heat-related illnesses, early heatwave warnings, and resources provided by the National Fire Agency.

info.title: Cigarettes Smoked by the Average City Resident Of...
info.description: This infographic compares the number of cigarettes smoked by the average resident in various cities worldwide, visualizing the data by stacking the equivalent number of cigarettes and comparing the height of these stacks to well-known structures.

info.title: Nicotine and Tar Exposure in Cigarettes by Country
info.description: The infographic compares the estimated average nicotine exposure and estimated average tar in cigarettes from different countries. It ranks countries by nicotine and tar levels, using modified bar charts and simple tabular data.

info.title: Comparison of Nuclear Explosion Yields
info.description: An infographic illustrating and comparing the approximate yields of several nuclear explosions, including 'Bunker Buster,' 'Hiroshima,' 'Trinity,' 'Mike,' 'Bravo,' and 'Tzar Bomba (Soviet).' info.title: Casualties in Wars and Disasters Compared to the American Flag
info.description: This infographic uses an American flag design with red stripes to represent the number of casualties from various wars and disasters. The height of each stripe is proportional to the death toll, offering a visual comparison of the human cost of each event. The earthquake in Haiti is depicted with the blue part of the flag.

info.title: EL CANVI REAL: MÉS MESTRES (The Real Change: More Teachers)
info.description: The infographic compares the number of teachers under CIU (49,160) and Montilla (66,570). The number of teachers is represented by blue and red cylindrical chalks/sticks, respectively.

info.title: Fossil Fuels: How Much Do You Consume in a Lifetime?

It also includes a brief description of the primary uses of each fuel and the methodology used to calculate the presented values.

info.title: Global Fossil Fuel Production in 2021
info.description: This infographic visualizes the global production volume of crude oil, liquefied natural gas, and coal in 2021, represented by cubic volumes scaled to reflect production quantities. Burj Khalifa is used as a comparison to emphasize the production amounts.

info.title: Highest Fossil Fuel Consumption per Capita
info.description: This infographic illustrates the highest fossil fuel consumption per capita for different countries and regions, visualized as the height of smokestacks with corresponding flags and numerical data. It includes data for the United States, Australia, Germany, Europe, China, UK, South Africa, France, and India.

info.title: Percentage of workers based on team size

The red arrow visually represents a significant downward trend, while the character's expression and falling motion emphasize the negative consequences of the economic situation. The percentages represent the degree of gain or loss at different points.

info.title: Where Does One U.S. Tax Dollar Go?
info.description: This infographic illustrates how one U.S. tax dollar is allocated across various sectors like Social Security, Health, National Defense, and others, based on government outlays for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2023.

info.title: Who owns the most satellites?
info.description: This infographic shows the distribution of satellite ownership across different entities, using a ring chart representation where each dot signifies 10 satellites.

info.title: America's Beer Consumption
info.description: This infographic depicts the annual per capita ethanol consumption (in gallons) from beer across the United States. The data is visually represented on a map of the U.S., where each state is colored according to its beer consumption level. A color scale provides context for the consumption range, and specific values for the lowest, overall U.S., and highest consumption are provided.

info.title: The Time It Takes New Technologies to Go Mainstream
info.description: This infographic shows the timeline from invention to mass adoption for various technologies, including radio, TV, internet, email, mobile phones, smartphones, USB, blockchain and Gen AI.

info.title: The Rise to 1 Million Investment Choices
info.description: The infographic illustrates the growth of managed investment products over time, highlighting the rise to 1 million, and notes that increased choices are causing decision paralysis among investors. It also presents the statistic that 26% of people feel uncomfortable making investment decisions due to a lack of knowledge.

info.title: Main Causes of Death for Children Under Five
info.description: This infographic visualizes the main causes of death for children under the age of five. It uses a donut chart to represent the proportion of each cause contributing to the total number of deaths. The chart shows that prematurity, pneumonia, birth asphyxia, malaria, diarrhea, congenital anomalies, injuries, sepsis, TB, and other factors contribute to the overall mortality rate.

info.title: Spending Power by Generation
info.description: This infographic illustrates the spending power of different generations as a percentage of the global population and their total spending.

info.title: Europe's Declining GHG Emissions
info.description: The infographic shows the greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions in CO2 equivalent tonnes per capita for various European countries in 1990 and 2022. It uses a horizontal bar chart to compare emissions between the two years, highlighting the overall decline in emissions across Europe.

info.title: Breaking Down $2.4 Trillion in Military Spending
info.description: An infographic depicting the distribution of global military spending in 2023, showing the amounts spent by different countries using a pie chart. The data is sourced from SIPRI Military Expenditure Database.

info.title: Top 15 Countries by Carbon Tax Revenue
info.description: This infographic visualizes the top 15 countries by carbon tax revenue. It uses a horizontal bar chart to compare the annual revenue generated by each country in 2022. The chart includes the country's flag, name, and the revenue amount in billions of US dollars.

info.title: U.S. States Producing the Most Turkeys in 2024
info.description: The infographic displays the top 10 U.S. states producing the most turkeys in 2024. A modified bar chart presents turkey production data for each state, visually arranged to suggest a turkey's plumage. The text notes that 4 out of 5 turkeys come from these 10 states, emphasizing their importance for Thanksgiving supply. The data source is the U.S. Department of Agriculture as of October 28, 2024.

info.title: Top 10 Tax Havens
info.description: This infographic displays the top 10 tax havens globally, ranked by the amount of offshore wealth held in USD. The locations are visually represented on a map, each associated with a numbered indicator and a money bag icon that is scaled to represent the held offshore wealth.

info.title: Avoidable Deaths per 100,000 Females
info.description: A visualization showing avoidable deaths per 100,000 females in different countries, indicating the number of deaths before age 75 from conditions that can be prevented or treated.

info.title: Top 10 Stocks on Instagram & TikTok
info.description: This infographic displays the top 10 stocks based on the number of video hashtags on Instagram and TikTok. The size of the circles represents the popularity of each stock based on the number of video hashtags. It also shows views for each stock.

info.title: Busiest Airports of 2023
info.description: This infographic presents a ranked list of the busiest airports in 2023 based on international airline capacity. The airports are listed in descending order, with the number of seats provided.

info.title: Countries that Mined the Most Silver in 2023
info.description: This infographic visualizes the top countries that mined the most silver in 2023, showing the amount in million ounces. Each country is represented by a differently shaped section in the whole, with its corresponding rank, amount of silver mined, and flag.

info.title: What Does Financial Success Look Like for Americans?
info.description: An infographic showing what financial success looks like for Americans across different generations (Boomers, Gen X, Millennials, Gen Z) based on a survey of 2,203 U.S. adults conducted on Sept. 13-14, 2024. It compares the minimum net worth and minimum annual salary of different generations, along with an actual average.

info.title: What's "America's Sport"?
info.description: This infographic presents the results of a poll asking U.S. adults what they consider to be "America's Sport". The poll results are displayed as percentages for different sports, including Football, Baseball, Basketball, Soccer, Auto Racing, and an "Other" category.

info.description: This infographic illustrates the top U.S. jobs with the most projected growth from 2023 to 2033, including the number of new jobs expected and the 2023 median annual wage for each occupation.

It also highlights the impact of hyper-competition among operators on lower prices, particularly in India.

info.description: This infographic visualizes the number of acres leased to the oil and gas sector during the fiscal year under the Obama, Trump, and Biden administrations. The visualization uses a chart representing oil rigs, with height corresponding to the area leased, to present the data.

info.title: Pharmaceutical R&D Spending Growth (2022-2023)

The infographic also highlights Eli Lilly's pioneering role in diabetes and weight loss drugs and mentions the decline in Pfizer's stock due to reduced COVID-19 vaccine demand.

info.title: Countries with the Largest Chinese Populations
