info.title: Consumer Spending on Apps in 2023
info.description: This infographic presents a ranking of app categories based on consumer spending in 2023. It showcases the top 15 categories, starting with Digital Entertainment and ending with Fitness, along with the corresponding spending in billions of dollars. It contains example app icons associated with these categories.

info.title: Global Nuclear Reactor Count by Country (May 2024)
info.description: This infographic shows the number of nuclear reactors per country as of May 2024. The reactor counts are visualized using reactor-shaped icons scaled according to the number of reactors and adorned with the country's flag.

info.title: Comparing the Largest Chinese & American Companies by Revenue
info.description: This infographic compares the largest Chinese and American companies by revenue based on 2022 data, presenting a radial bar chart displaying company revenues and relative rankings.

info.title: America's Largest Health Insurers by Market Share
info.description: This infographic illustrates the market share of the largest health insurance companies in America, based on total U.S. enrollments. It highlights the dominant players like UnitedHealth Group, Elevance Health, Aetna, and Cigna, along with several other smaller companies, showing their respective percentages of the market.

info.title: Countries that Rely Heavily on Mining Exports
info.description: The infographic displays the percentage of exports from mining for various countries. The countries are listed along with their primary mineral export, sorted from highest to lowest percentage. A legend indicates the geographical location of the countries (Africa, Americas, Asia). The data, averaged between 2019-2021, includes only countries with 60%+ concentration in mining exports.

info.title: Industrial Robots Exports by Country in 2022
info.description: An infographic showing the export sales of industrial robots by country in 2022. It includes a bar chart showing the top exporting countries, along with a graphic representing global logistics.

info.title: Employed Students: Share of U.S. Students Employed (aged 16-24) from 1995 to 2023
info.description: This infographic shows the percentage of employed U.S. students aged 16-24 from 1995 to 2023, differentiating between college and high school students using two separate line graphs.

info.title: Global Births vs Deaths
info.description: This infographic visualizes the global trends in births and deaths from 1950 to 2100. It shows historical data up to the present and projects future trends, also includes a 95% confidence interval for predictions.

info.title: Real Wage Growth by Income Group in the U.S.
info.description: This infographic presents the real wage growth by income group in the U.S. from 1980 to 2023. It also shows the average hourly wages by income group in 2023 using stacks of coins.

info.title: Nvidia Beats Revenue Estimates
info.description: This infographic visualizes Nvidia's revenue from Q1 2021 to Q2 2025. It shows a trend of increasing revenue over time, with a dip in late 2022 due to a post-pandemic slump in the gaming industry. The graphic highlights that Nvidia beat revenue estimates of $28.7B in its latest earnings report for the quarter ended July 28, 2024.

info.title: How American Income Has Changed Since 1967
info.description: This infographic visualizes the change in the distribution of American household income between 1967 and 2023, categorized by income brackets. It shows the share of U.S. households within each income range, adjusted for inflation, with specific median and average income figures provided for both years.

info.title: Nike Rules the Sneaker World
info.description: This infographic displays worldwide footwear sales of selected sports brands in 2022. The data is presented as a bar chart, with Nike having the highest sales at $29.1 billion, followed by Adidas, Skechers, Puma, Asics, Converse, and Under Armour.

info.title: Countries With The Largest Indian Populations
info.description: This infographic visualizes the top 12 countries with the largest Indian populations, presenting the data through a horizontal bar chart and a map highlighting the location of each country.

info.title: Annual Births by Region, 1950-2023
info.description: This infographic shows the trend of annual births in different regions from 1950 to 2023 using a line chart.

info.title: The Average Lifespans of Mammals
info.description: This infographic visually compares the average lifespans of various mammals, including humans, with representative silhouettes and corresponding numerical data.

info.title: Conceptual Spaghetti: Connecting Design and Impact
info.description: This infographic uses a stylized illustration of spaghetti strands to represent the relationships and flow between various concepts related to design thinking and its impact on society. The spaghetti strands, emerging from a fork at the top and culminating in a bowl at the bottom, connect elements such as 'Change Agents,' 'Systemic Change,' 'Products,' 'Services,' 'Concept,' 'Inclusive Design,' 'Impact,' 'Switzerland,' 'Commons' and 'Planet,' illustrating a network of interconnected ideas.

info.title: The Extinction of Cash
info.description: An infographic illustrating the projected decline in cash usage across various countries from 2019 to 2027, showing the percentage point change in cash transaction value. It highlights that India is expected to see the biggest drop in cash transaction value and that in many countries, cash has already fallen below the 10% transaction value threshold.

info.title: Tesla vs. World: Market Cap and Gross Revenue Comparison
info.description: This infographic compares Tesla's market capitalization and gross revenue with that of several other prominent automotive manufacturers. It visually highlights the difference between Tesla's valuation and the combined valuation of these competitors, despite the loss in market cap since April 25th. The infographic also compares gross revenues.

info.title: Jobless & disengaged youth in 2015
info.description: An infographic showing the percentage of 15-29 year olds who are not in employment, education, or training (NEETs) in various countries in 2015. The data is represented as a horizontal bar chart, showing the breakdown of inactive and unemployed NEETs for each country. The data is sorted by total percentage from highest to lowest.

info.title: World's Tallest Natural Waterfalls
info.description: This infographic shows a bar chart that lists the world's tallest natural waterfalls by name and height (in meters). It also includes the country flag of each waterfall.

info.title: America's Trading Partners in 2021
info.description: An infographic visualizing trade in goods by selected countries and areas in 2021 for America, showing both annual imports and exports. It highlights the total value of imports and exports, and presents a breakdown by region and country, while also showing the trade balance.

info.title: Labour Productivity in 2017
info.description: This infographic presents a horizontal bar chart displaying the labor productivity, measured as GDP per hour worked in US dollars, for various countries and the OECD average in 2017. It includes a visual element of gears being pushed by a figure, which serves a decorative purpose.

info.title: Vector-borne Diseases and Traveler's Medicine in South America
info.description: This infographic provides information about vector-borne diseases prevalent in South America and medical advice for travelers visiting the region. It covers transmission routes, common diseases, and preventative measures.

info.title: Commute Satisfaction and Workplace Stress in South Korea
info.description: The infographic presents data on commute satisfaction and stress among South Korean workers, exploring the relationship between commute experience and job satisfaction, preferred modes of transportation, and primary sources of stress during commutes.

info.title: The Obesity Drug Market Will 5x by 2030
info.description: An infographic showing the projected market value for weight-loss drugs, broken down into US and Non-US revenue, from 2024 to 2030. Morgan Stanley believes the market will be worth $77B by 2030.

info.title: World Cheese Consumption Top 20
info.description: This infographic illustrates the world's top 20 countries in cheese consumption. It features a bar chart showing the amount of cheese consumed in kilograms per country. The infographic also provides a breakdown of different cheese types, categorized as natural cheese (including fresh, ripened, blue cheese), processed cheese, soft, semi-hard, and hard cheeses. Each cheese type includes illustrations and names in Japanese. The infographic also features a pie chart to represent cheeses.

info.title: Survey on Returning Home During Obon Festival 2013
info.description: This infographic presents data from a survey on returning home during the Obon festival in 2013. It covers various aspects such as transportation methods, travel times, costs, peak travel dates, common problems encountered while driving, and measures taken against heatstroke in cars.

info.title: Annual Working Hours and Gender Equality
info.description: This infographic visualizes the annual average working hours across different countries alongside a gender equality metric. It presents a bar chart comparing working hours, each labeled with a country flag and a pie chart indicating gender equality percentage.

info.title: Who Rules the Waves? U.S. and Chinese Fleets, by Tonnage
info.description: This infographic compares the U.S. and Chinese naval fleets by tonnage, illustrating the relative size of different vessel types for each nation. It shows how the fleets stack up against each other by tonnage.

info.title: World Empires Population Comparison
info.description: The infographic visualizes and compares the population sizes of different empires throughout history using pictograms. Each row represents a different empire at a specific time, with each figure representing ten million people.

info.title: Performance of Largest Coins in the Last 2 Weeks
info.description: This infographic shows the performance of the largest cryptocurrencies (BTC, ETH, BNB, SOL, XRP, ADA) over the last two weeks, visualized using a bar chart with percentage values above each bar.

info.title: Best Postal Services In The World
info.description: An infographic showing the index score of the top performing national postal services in 2022. It lists the scores for countries like Switzerland, Austria, Germany, Japan, France, United States, United Kingdom, Netherlands, Canada, and China.

info.title: How Hard Commodities Performed in 2022
info.description: This infographic shows the performance of hard commodities in 2022. It features two bar charts displaying the top 10 best and top 10 worst performing commodities, along with brief explanations for the price changes.

info.title: The World's Most Generous Nations
info.description: This infographic shows a horizontal bar chart of the percentage of people who donated money to charity in the past month, for the top 10 most generous nations. The data is sourced from the Charities Aid Foundation and relates to 2014.

info.title: IRFC Takes Over Top Railway Stocks
info.description: This infographic depicts the top railway stocks with their respective values, presumably related to the Indian Railway Finance Corporation (IRFC) taking over. The data is as of September 5, 2023. The visualization consists of vertical bars representing the stock values, associated with their companies' logos.

info.title: Top 13 Countries with Crypto Ownership 2023
info.description: This infographic presents the top 13 countries with crypto ownership in 2023. It displays the countries, their corresponding crypto ownership numbers, percentages, and national flags arranged around a world map.

info.title: CO2 Emissions Since 1900
info.description: This infographic visualizes annual changes in global fossil CO2 emissions in gigatons (Gt) from 1900 to 2020. It highlights significant historical events and their impact on CO2 emissions, showing periods of increase and decrease. The infographic emphasizes the role of fossil fuels in driving climate change.

info.title: Console Launch Prices Adjusted For Inflation
info.description: This infographic displays the launch prices of various video game consoles adjusted for inflation to August 2024. The consoles are arranged along a timeline from 1975 to 2025, showing the evolution of console pricing over time. The y-axis represents the price in USD.

info.title: U.S. Drug Overdose Deaths by Type (and How They Changed in the Past Decade)
info.description: This infographic visualizes the statistics of drug overdose deaths in the U.S., categorized by drug type. It shows the increase in opioid-related deaths from 2017 to 2023, the decrease in overall drug overdose deaths from 2023 to 2024, and the prevalence of fentanyl in counterfeit pills. It also displays the number of overdose deaths for various drugs in 2022 versus 2012.

info.title: Peaks of poverty
info.description: This infographic visualizes the spread of poverty between different regions of Italy from 2003 to 2006. It uses 3D cones to represent poverty incidence, consumer prices, and error percentage, combining them to describe the incidence of relative poverty.

info.title: Are TGVs often late?
info.description: This infographic, created by Datamatch, analyzes the punctuality of TGV (high-speed train) lines departing from and arriving in Paris, France, between March 2012 and March 2014. It highlights the percentage of late TGVs on various routes and also provides additional information about delays for other modes of transport like planes and TER trains.

info.title: French Prisons Conditions Analysis
info.description: The infographic analyzes the conditions of incarceration and the profile of detainees in French prisons over the past twenty years, covering topics such as prison overcrowding, the age of detainees, the proportion of foreigners, the length of stays, and the types of offenses committed.

info.title: Gardener Names in Movies
info.description: An infographic displaying the prevalence of different names for gardeners in movies, represented visually using rakes of varying heights.

info.title: Central Bank Interest Rates Around the World
info.description: An infographic illustrating the central bank interest rates of various countries around the world using a bar chart. The countries are listed along the x-axis, and the corresponding interest rates are indicated by the height of the bars. Rates vary significantly, with Argentina at the highest and Japan at the lowest.

info.title: Height of Indian Scams
info.description: This infographic visually compares the magnitude of various Indian financial scams by representing their value as the height of stacked 2000 Rupee notes. The heights are compared to recognizable landmarks like the Burj Khalifa and Mount Everest to provide context.

info.title: Best Railway Stocks with Last 6 Month Returns
info.description: An infographic showing the performance of railway stocks based on their last 6-month returns. The infographic lists various railway companies and their corresponding return percentages, visualized using a train-like horizontal bar.

info.title: Best and Worst Nifty 50 Stocks of 2022
info.description: This infographic visualizes the best and worst performing Nifty 50 stocks of 2022. It uses a bar chart to compare the percentage change in stock value for different companies.

info.title: Largest Indian Brokers by NSE Active Clients (April 2023)
info.description: This infographic presents a comparison of the largest Indian brokers based on their total number of NSE (National Stock Exchange) active clients as of April 2023. It includes a bar chart visualizing the number of clients for each broker and features the brokers' logos for easy identification.

info.title: India Deodorant Market Share
info.description: An infographic showing the market share of key players in the deodorant market in India. It displays the percentage held by each brand including 'Others'.

info.title: India Branded Bread Market: Market Share of Key Players
info.description: This infographic displays the market share of key players in the India branded bread market. It uses a modified bar chart visualization, where each bread brand's market share is represented by a red block and the brand's packaging.

info.title: Poverty in Old Age
info.description: This infographic presents a horizontal bar chart comparing the share of individuals aged 65 and over living in relative income poverty across various countries. The data is from 2012 or the latest available year.

info.title: Germany's Dependency on China
info.description: This infographic depicts the German trade balance with China over time. It showcases how Germany's trade deficit with China has increased, highlighting the country's growing dependency on China's economy.

info.title: The Average American's Annual Energy Consumption
info.description: The infographic illustrates the average American's annual energy consumption, showing the breakdown of energy usage in gallons of gasoline, cubic feet of natural gas, and kilowatt hours of electricity. It also shows the sources of the electricity used.

info.title: History of China
info.description: This infographic presents a timeline of Chinese history, highlighting major dynasties and events from 2070 BC to the present day. It includes brief descriptions of each dynasty's key achievements and significance, along with associated maps and timelines.

info.title: Age Breakdown of Social Media Users
info.description: This infographic illustrates the percentage of social media users in different age groups: 13-18, 18-29, 30-49, 50-64, and 65+.

info.title: Forest Fire Activity in Canada from 1959 to 2019
info.description: This infographic shows the trend of forest fire activity in Canada from 1959 to 2019, with the area burned measured in hectares.

info.title: Infographic Wildfire
info.description: This infographic illustrates the increasing severity and impact of wildfires in the United States, highlighting contributing factors, costs, and consequences.

info.title: US Wildfires 1983-2024
info.description: An infographic showing the trend of US Wildfires across four decades, from 1983 to 2024, measured in millions of acres burned. The data is presented using a bar chart, with additional visual elements like trees, birds, and a firefighter silhouette added for context and visual appeal.

info.title: The Great British Bake Off: Race to the top
info.description: The infographic illustrates the ranking of contestants on the tenth season of 'The Great British Bake Off' based on their technical scores. Each contestant is represented by a 'drip' on a tiered cake, with the length of the drip indicating their position in the technical challenge. The cake layers represent the elimination stages of the competition, with the top layer showing the final three.

info.title: Business Success Metaphor
info.description: An illustration symbolizing business success. A businessman stands on top of a large, mostly yellow pie chart segment, holding a flag. A group of other businessmen stand on the smaller, uncolored segment.

info.title: Business Growth and Success
info.description: An infographic illustrating business growth using a bar chart with a line graph overlayed. A figure of a businessman is shown progressing along the growth line, and a hand is shown drawing the graph, suggesting creation and management of growth.

info.title: Illustration of investment and growth
info.description: An illustration showing a man watering a graph that is growing.

info.title: COVID-19 Cases Trend and Recovery
info.description: The image depicts a line graph drawn on a chalkboard showing the trend of COVID-19 cases. The red line represents the fluctuation of the virus spread and the green arrow signifies the recovery. There are cartoon drawings of COVID-19 viruses along the line graph. People are holding the trend line, symbolizing attempts to control it.

info.title: Economic Decline and Struggle
info.description: The infographic depicts a stylized representation of economic decline and the struggle to overcome it. A large, red downward-pointing arrow, symbolizing a market crash or economic downturn, dominates the background. The world map graphic in the background suggests a global impact. A figure is shown using a pole vault to try and overcome the economic downturn.

info.title: Falling Gas Prices
info.description: This infographic depicts a downward trend in gas prices. It uses a candlestick chart as background and an arrow to indicate a drop, overlaying it with an illustration of a gas pump nozzle to represent gas prices.

info.title: Business growth illustration
info.description: An illustration depicting business growth with cartoon characters, a pie chart representing market share or investment allocation, and a growing bar chart.

info.title: Market Manipulation
info.description: An illustration depicting market manipulation using a hand like a puppet master controlling a combined bar and line chart, which symbolizes economic data or stock prices.

info.title: Financial Crisis Illustration
info.description: This illustration depicts a financial crisis or economic downturn, represented by a sharply declining red arrow. Business professionals are shown falling alongside the arrow, symbolizing the impact of the crisis on individuals and their careers. The arrow crashes through the ground, further emphasizing the severity of the situation.

info.title: COVID-19 Impact on Market Fluctuations
info.description: An infographic visualizing the impact of COVID-19 on market fluctuations represented by a bar chart and a line graph. The visualizations are rendered in 3D, with holes in the bars representing the virus's impact, and the line demonstrates the market fluctuations.

info.title: World Population Ageing
info.description: An infographic showing world population ageing. It uses a bar chart and a red arrow to show the increasing population size. The bar chart is represented by white cubes that elderly people are climbing on.

info.title: Economic Crisis Illustration
info.description: This illustration depicts an economic crisis using a line graph that is styled like a fiery arrow pointing downwards towards a bomb, symbolizing a potential economic collapse. The background features faint bar graphs and a city skyline, setting a business context.

info.title: Financial Growth and Investment
info.description: The infographic shows a line chart representing financial growth, emerging from a pot with a dollar sign and eventually pointing upwards. Two observers are on the left side of the image and a musician with his instrument is located on the right side.

info.title: Financial Growth Illustration
info.description: A cartoon-style illustration depicting a red arrow chart rising from a pot with a dollar sign, symbolizing financial growth. A man playing a trumpet accompanies the rising trend, with a blue sky background.

info.title: Inflation's Impact on Citizens
info.description: This cartoon depicts inflation, represented by a red line graph trending upwards, tightening the belt of citizens, highlighting its economic impact. The line chart shows the rise of inflation over time. The image uses a metaphorical representation of inflation as a tightening belt, causing distress to the people represented behind.

info.title: Economic Downturn
info.description: This image depicts a bar chart showing a decreasing trend, with a red arrow emphasizing the downward direction. A figure falling is used to convey the negative consequences of this economic decline.

info.title: Business Growth Cartoon
info.description: A cartoon style illustration depicting a businessman struggling to hold up a large red arrow, representing business growth, against a grid background.

info.title: House Market Trends
info.description: An illustration depicting a house perched atop an upward-trending arrow, symbolizing rising house prices. A couple stands at the base of the arrow, looking up at the house, which suggests concerns or aspirations regarding home ownership.

info.title: Business Growth Illustration
info.description: An infographic that represents business growth or market trends. The infographic features a line chart showing a dip and subsequent rise in a business metric, alongside an illustration of a businessman in boxing gloves celebrating, suggesting overcoming challenges and achieving success.

info.title: Inflation Cartoon
info.description: A cartoon style image showing business people struggling to control a rising 'inflation' line graph.

info.title: Car Sales Growth
info.description: An infographic depicting the concept of car sales growth, represented by a red arrow chart, with a car on top moving upward. A man in a suit is shown running alongside the arrow, suggesting the rising trend of car sales.

info.title: Global Business Growth
info.description: Illustration depicting a business person running up a red arrow that symbolizes business growth, while carrying the world on their shoulders.

info.title: Rising House Prices
info.description: This infographic illustrates rising house prices using an upward-pointing arrow to show the price increase. The cartoon house sitting on the arrow reinforces the theme.

info.title: Burning Trend Line Chart
info.description: An artistic rendering of a trend line, depicted as a flame, overlaid on a grid. It visually communicates upward growth or an increase in value.

info.title: Rising Grocery Prices
info.description: The infographic shows a woman struggling to push a grocery cart up a rising line graph, with food items falling out, symbolizing the burden of increasing grocery prices.

info.title: Economic Decline Cartoon
info.description: This is a cartoon illustration depicting an economic downturn. It features a red arrow pointing downwards, breaking through the floor, representing a decline. There are caricatured politicians present, one giving a speech and another struggling to hold up the falling arrow. The visual metaphor conveys a crisis or downturn in a humorous yet critical way.

info.title: Light Bulb with Arrow Shaped Filament
info.description: An image of a light bulb where the filament is shaped like an arrow moving upwards, simulating growth or progress, against a red gradient background.

info.title: Decline in Housing Market
info.description: This infographic visually represents a decline in the housing market, symbolized by a red arrow pointing downward. The image features a stylized house placed at the peak of the arrow and a person is standing on the line. The overall design is minimalistic and uses a limited color palette.

info.title: Taming Inflation
info.description: The infographic depicts a red, downward-pointing arrow shaped like a horse, labeled "INFLATION," being tamed by a businessman holding a whip. The arrow's trajectory is shown against a grid background, suggesting a visual representation of inflation's fluctuations.

info.title: Economic Inequality
info.description: This cartoon depicts the distribution of wealth. A tap of money flows into a bucket of a man, and he transfers some to another man, who again passes some to a smaller man and very little trickles down to the last man who can't even stand up straight.

info.title: Building a Pie Chart
info.description: This infographic shows an illustration of business people constructing a pie chart. Each person contributes a section of the chart, suggesting teamwork and collaboration in reaching a common goal.

info.title: Financial Loss Cartoon
info.description: A cartoon depicting a businessman with a sad expression, overlaid with a line graph showing a downward trend, symbolizing financial loss or market decline.

info.title: Falling Stock Market
info.description: An illustration depicting a businessman carrying a large red arrow (representing a stock market decline) while a line graph shows a downward trend with open notebooks.

info.title: Downward Trend Breaking Ground
info.description: A visual representation of a sharp decline, depicted by a red arrow breaking through the floor. The background features a grid pattern, with alternating blue and white columns that give the appearance of a bar graph. The overall image suggests a market crash or significant financial loss.

info.title: Bank Failure
info.description: The infographic shows a bank building with a downward trending arrow piercing through it, causing the ground to crack. A man is trying to balance on the arrow. Coins with dollar signs are also falling. It illustrates the concept of bank failure or financial crisis.

info.title: Pulling up the Line Graph
info.description: An illustration depicting a person pulling up a line graph that is shaped like an arrow, symbolizing growth or progress.

info.title: Market Downturn Protection
info.description: The infographic illustrates the concept of protecting investments or financial stability during a market downturn. It uses a line chart to depict the rise and subsequent fall of the market, with a downward arrow indicating the negative impact. A person holding an umbrella represents the protection against this downfall.

info.title: Shoe Industry Growth
info.description: An infographic depicting the growth of the shoe industry, represented by a bar chart within a shoe illustration, accompanied by a character with a flag standing on the shoe and additional shoe illustrations nearby.

info.title: Stock Price Chart Illustration
info.description: This infographic depicts a stock price chart being 'painted' or drawn by a stylized hand holding a paintbrush. The chart shows the stock price fluctuating over a period of six months, from January to June.

info.title: Bank Failure and Market Volatility
info.description: This infographic illustrates the concept of bank failure and market volatility using symbolic representations. A collapsing bank structure is depicted, along with a red arrow that signifies a fluctuating trend, possibly representing market performance. A concerned figure stands beside, portraying the stress or worry associated with such financial instability.

info.title: Rising Housing Market
info.description: The infographic depicts a rising housing market, symbolized by a house atop an upward-trending arrow. People are shown running alongside, potentially representing the rush to buy or invest in real estate as prices increase.

info.title: Business Growth Illustration
info.description: This image is an illustration representing business growth. It features a businesswoman climbing a red arrow pointing upwards, symbolizing progress and success. The arrow has a rocket engine effect at the beginning, depicting the boost for rapid growth. There are clouds in the background and stars next to the arrow.

info.title: Stock Market Rise and Fall
info.description: This infographic depicts the fluctuation in stock prices with a visual representation of a line graph showing a rising trend, combined with arrows indicating up and down movements, and a businessman.

info.title: Attracting Growth
info.description: A visual representation of growth, depicted by a line graph showing an upward trend. A person holding a magnet stands on top of a column, symbolizing attracting or achieving that growth.

info.title: Downward Trend
info.description: An illustration depicting a businessman desperately attempting to control a rapidly declining red line graph against a grid backdrop, symbolizing economic downturn or failure.

info.title: Man Climbing Growth Chart
info.description: A cartoon illustration depicts a businessman climbing a red arrow that symbolizes growth, set against a green background. The man is drawn in a simple, stylized manner, and the arrow represents an upward trend.

info.title: Cartoon Depiction of a Line Graph Showing Growth
info.description: This is a cartoon image showing a line graph with an upward trend, visually represented by a large red arrow. A cartoon man is depicted as pushing or controlling the arrow upwards, suggesting efforts in driving growth or success. The overall style is simple and illustrative.

info.title: Analyzing Financial Growth
info.description: An illustration depicting financial growth analysis. It features a rising line graph represented by a blue arrow that symbolizes an upward trend, dollars as data points, along with two businessmen, one examining the trend with a magnifying glass.

info.title: Stock Market Trend Illustration
info.description: This illustration depicts a stock market trend with a bar chart and an overlaid line graph. A person on a skateboard is placed on the line graph, giving a conceptual view of navigating market ups and downs.

info.title: The Future of Gaming Is Digital: Computer and Video Game Sales in the United States from 2009 to 2012
info.description: This infographic displays the trend of computer and video game sales in the United States from 2009 to 2012, showing both consumer spending and unit sales. It highlights the breakdown of spending across different delivery formats like video games (new physical retail), PC games (new physical retail), and other delivery formats.

info.title: DC Commuters Spend the Most Time Stuck in Traffic
info.description: This infographic illustrates the annual hours of delay per commuter in U.S. metropolitan areas with more than 500,000 residents in 2012. It combines a map of the United States with an isotypes (pictorial chart) to show the ranking of cities with the most traffic delays.

info.title: Global Smartphone Traffic to Increase by 2020
info.description: The infographic presents a forecast of global smartphone subscriptions and monthly smartphone data traffic from 2014 to 2020. It visually compares the number of smartphone subscriptions, monthly traffic per active subscription, and total monthly smartphone traffic between the two years, showing significant increases in all categories.

info.title: Annual Traffic Delay in Europe's Most Congested Cities
info.description: This infographic visualizes the annual hourly delays experienced by commuters in Europe's most congested cities. It uses a combination of a pictorial chart (each car represents a certain amount of delay time) and a map to show the location of each city. The lengths of the rows of cars represent the amount of delay time.

info.title: Anti-Obamacare Ad Expenditure by City in 2013
info.description: This infographic shows the highest estimated spending on anti-ACA (Affordable Care Act) advertising by city in 2013, along with the percentage of uninsured individuals in those cities. It presents a bar chart comparing ad spending and a map indicating the general location of the cities listed, along with the uninsured rate.

info.title: Netflix's Share Price Performance in 2013
info.description: This infographic illustrates the stock performance of selected tech companies in 2013, highlighting Netflix's significant growth compared to its competitors. The data is presented using a bar chart and a stylized line graph to show Netflix's growth.

info.title: Commute Times in U.S. Cities
info.description: This infographic illustrates the percentage of workers with a 60-minute commute and the mean travel time in minutes for several major U.S. cities. It includes a map to show the locations of the cities and an interesting bar-chart-like visualization using car icons to represent the proportion of workers with a 60-minute commute. The mean travel time is shown in a separate column.

info.title: NFL Teams with the Most Super Bowl Titles and Appearances
info.description: This infographic shows the number of Super Bowl titles and appearances by NFL teams from 1967-2013. The visualization consists of a horizontal bar chart displaying the number of Super Bowl titles and small football icons with numbers indicating the Super Bowl appearances for each team.

info.title: Most-Followed FIFA World Cup Players on Twitter
info.description: This infographic illustrates the most followed FIFA World Cup players on Twitter as of June 5, 2014. The visualization uses a modified bar chart where the length of the bar is represented by a sequence of soccer ball icons corresponding to the number of followers. The players are listed along with their Twitter handles, their national flag, and the number of followers in millions.

info.title: The World Cup's Most Valuable Teams
info.description: Market value of national team players at the 2014 FIFA World Cup (in million U.S. dollars). The infographic ranks the teams from the most to the least valuable. Each team is represented by a number of player icons next to its flag. The values are provided in million U.S. dollars.

info.title: World Cup Humiliations Are a Rare Event
info.description: This infographic displays a listing of the biggest World Cup wins in history, showing the score difference using soccer balls as a visualization for the goal difference.

info.title: Müller vs. Klose: FIFA World Cup Goal Records
info.description: This infographic visualizes the players with the most goals scored at FIFA World Cup tournaments as of June 14, 2018, highlighting Miroslav Klose's record and Thomas Müller's position as the only active player challenging it. It shows the number of goals and also number of world cups competed in.

info.title: American Tourists' Spending in the UK (2013)
info.description: This infographic displays the top spending countries during visits to the UK for at least one night in 2013, measured in millions of British pounds (£). It uses stacked coin icons to represent the amount spent by tourists from each country, providing a visual comparison of tourism spending.

info.title: Non-Marital Births: U.S. and Europe Comparison
info.description: This infographic compares the share of live births occurring outside marriage in the U.S. and selected European countries. It visually represents the percentage of non-marital births for each country using a proportional representation of colored dots.

info.title: Americans' Reluctance to Visit Doctors: A Cross-National Comparison
info.description: This infographic illustrates the average number of doctor visits per person annually across selected countries, highlighting that Americans visit doctors less frequently compared to other nations like Japan and Germany.

info.title: Banknote Lifespan by Denomination
info.description: An infographic showing the estimated lifespan of different US dollar banknotes. The visualization showcases how the lifespan varies based on the denomination of the bill, ranging from $1 to $100.

info.title: The 10 Most Charitable U.S. Cities
info.description: Infographic showing the top 10 most charitable U.S. metropolitan areas based on the percentage of gross income given to charity.

info.title: International Space Agency Budgets in 2013
info.description: This infographic presents the annual budgets of various international space agencies in 2013, visualizing their relative expenditures.

info.title: The World's Largest Family Businesses
info.description: This infographic presents the top family-controlled firms by revenue in 2013, measured in billion US dollars. It uses a modified bar chart to compare the revenues of different companies, with each bar representing a company's revenue. The companies are ranked from highest to lowest revenue. The infographic includes company logos for easy identification.

info.title: Americans Living With Roommates: A Growing Trend
info.description: This infographic shows the percentage of adults living in "doubled up" households in selected US cities in 2002 and 2012. It uses a bar chart to visualize the change in percentages over the decade, for each selected US city.

info.title: Asia and the Middle East Lead the Skyscraper Race
info.description: The infographic illustrates the tallest buildings worldwide in 2024, focusing on structures located in Asia and the Middle East. It presents a bar chart variation showcasing the height of each building along with its name, number of floors, and completion year.

info.title: The Most Heavily Policed Countries in the World
info.description: The infographic shows the number of police personnel per 100,000 of the population in different countries. It uses a visual representation of police hats to indicate the number of personnel. Each row represents a country, along with its flag, and the data point for that country.

info.title: Graphic Warnings On Cigarette Packages: A Growing Trend
info.description: The infographic illustrates the increasing number of countries and jurisdictions that require picture warnings on cigarette packages from 2001 to 2015. The data is presented using a modified bar chart, where the bars are designed to resemble cigarettes.

info.title: Christmas Trees: Real vs Fake (2007-2013)
info.description: This infographic compares the sales of real and fake Christmas trees in the U.S. from 2007 to 2013. It shows the number of real and fake trees sold in millions and the mean average dollars spent and retail value for both types of trees.

info.title: 2014's Best-Selling Vinyl Albums in the United States
info.description: This infographic visualizes the top selling vinyl albums in the United States in 2014. It lists the artist, title, and sales numbers, with a visual representation of the sales using a series of vinyl record icons.

info.title: British Public Opinion on Flying the Saudi Flag at Half-Mast
info.description: The infographic presents the results of a survey on British public opinion regarding the government's decision to fly the Saudi flag at half-mast. It shows the percentage of people who believed the government should not have, should have, or didn't know.

info.title: Social Media Growth in 2014
info.description: An infographic showing the growth in members and active users on various social media platforms in 2014, highlighting Facebook's decline in active users.

info.title: Global Smartphone Traffic to Increase Tenfold by 2019
info.description: The infographic presents a forecast of global smartphone data traffic in exabytes per month from 2014 to 2019, visualized using filled smartphone shapes to represent increasing data usage.

info.title: E-Cigarette Use Tripled In Schools Between 2013 & 2014
info.description: This infographic illustrates the percentage of U.S. high school students who reported using e-cigarettes and cigarettes in the past 30 days between 2011 and 2014. It highlights the increase in e-cigarette use during this period.

info.title: Brands Expected to Act Environmentally Responsible
info.description: This infographic shows the percentage of people who agree that brands and companies should be environmentally responsible, broken down by country. It includes the percentages that strongly agree and agree, shown with tree-like visual metaphors.

info.title: Where Women Face the Highest Risk of Maternal Death
info.description: This infographic shows a comparison of the lifetime risk of maternal death in different countries. It lists countries where women face the highest risk of maternal death, displaying each country's flag, and using pictograms of pregnant women to represent the number of women at risk for each maternal death.

info.title: Smartphone App Usage in the US: Time vs. Number of Apps
info.description: This infographic illustrates the average monthly app usage by smartphone users in the United States from Q4 2011 to Q4 2015. It compares the time spent per month on apps with the number of apps used per month, showing a significant increase in time spent while the number of apps used remained relatively stable.

info.title: Apple Dominating the Smartwatch Market in 2015
info.description: This infographic shows the estimated unit shipments and global market share of leading smartwatch vendors (Apple, Samsung, and others) in Q2 2014 and Q2 2015. It highlights Apple's significant dominance in the smartwatch market.

info.title: The Most Error-Strewn Movies of All Time
info.description: This infographic shows the top 10 movies with the most mistakes in history, with the movie title, release year, and the total number of mistakes.

info.title: Cities with the Highest Rents for Prime Office Space
info.description: This infographic shows a bar chart visualizing the annual average cost to rent a square foot of prime office space in 2015 across different cities.  The cities are ranked from highest to lowest rental cost.

info.title: Top 10 Box Office Record Breakers
info.description: This infographic visualizes the global box office revenue of the top 10 highest-grossing movies in history as of November 22nd, 2015. It includes information about the movie titles, their revenue in billion U.S. dollars, and their release years. Movies released from 2015 are highlighted in blue while those older than 2015 are in red.

info.title: Osborne's Policy Changes and Tax Revenue
info.description: This infographic illustrates the extra tax revenue in billion GBP generated from policy changes in the 2015 Autumn Statement by Osborne, spanning from 2015-16 to 2020-21. The visualization uses stacks of coins to represent the increasing tax revenue over the years.

info.title: Decline in Frequent Drinking Among Young British Adults (2005-2013)
info.description: The infographic illustrates the percentage of young adults in Britain who frequently drink (defined as drinking on 5 or more days in the week) from 2005 to 2013. The visualization uses a series of beer bottle shapes, with the fill level representing the percentage of frequent drinkers for each year. The percentage decreases over time.

info.title: The most frequent causes of selfie-fatalities
info.description: The infographic presents the reported selfie-related deaths by cause since 2014.

info.title: Laser Incidents Reported to the UK CAA from 2009 to 2015
info.description: This infographic depicts the number of laser incidents reported to the UK Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) between 2009 and 2015. The incidents are represented by yellow lines topped with a "laser" symbol, resembling sunbursts, to symbolize the lasers. The height of the lines corresponds to the number of incidents, effectively creating a bar chart. There's also a faint airplane graphic in the background, and the infographic is sourced from Statista and Independent.

info.title: Chinese Soccer Clubs Flex Their Financial Muscle
info.description: The infographic displays the winter transfer market expenditure in selected soccer leagues in 2016. The sizes of the soccer ball icons correspond to the amount of money spent, with larger balls indicating higher expenditure. The leagues are identified by their respective flags and names, along with the specific dollar amounts spent.

info.title: Job Automation Risk by Country in 2016
info.description: An infographic illustrating the risk of jobs being replaced by automation in selected countries in 2016. It uses a horizontal bar chart to compare the percentage of jobs at risk, with Ethiopia showing the highest risk and the United Kingdom showing the lowest among the listed countries.

info.title: Primary School Teacher Salaries in OECD Countries (2014)
info.description: The infographic shows the average salary for primary school teachers with 10 years of experience in 2014 in selected OECD countries. Salaries are in USD, converted using PPPs for private consumption. The countries are ranked from highest to lowest salary. It also features a chalk board icon with a money bag drawn.

info.title: The Highest Starting Salaries For Elementary School Teachers
info.description: The infographic shows the average starting salary for elementary school teachers in selected OECD countries in 2014. It uses a horizontal bar chart to visualize the salary for each country, and the countries are ranked in descending order of salary.

info.title: Tax Contributions of Undocumented Immigrants
info.description: This infographic illustrates the estimated annual contribution of undocumented immigrants to U.S. state and local taxes, broken down by type of tax.

info.title: Presidential Mentions in Hip Hop Lyrics (1989-2016)
info.description: The infographic illustrates the mentions of Donald Trump and Hillary Clinton in hip hop lyrics from 1989 to 2016. It presents a year-by-year comparison using stacked bar charts.

info.title: Apple's Astonishing Profit in Context
info.description: This infographic compares Apple's net income with that of other companies in the past four fiscal quarters. It uses colored bars to represent different companies and their net income. The infographic includes visual elements such as stacks of coins and money to represent wealth. The data is as of November 2012.

info.title: Wealth Comparison: Chinese vs. American Politicians in 2013
info.description: The infographic compares the individual wealth of American and Chinese politicians in 2013, showcasing the lowest, average, and highest wealth values in million U.S. dollars. It utilizes visual representations of the countries and segmented circles to represent wealth levels.

info.title: Reasons People Use Facebook
info.description: The infographic shows the reasons why U.S. Facebook users use the platform. The data indicates that most people use Facebook to see what friends and family are up to, see photos and videos of friends and family, and chat or message with family and friends.

info.title: IBM Tops U.S. Patent Ranking for 21st Consecutive Year
info.description: This infographic shows the top 15 recipients of U.S. patents in 2013. The data is visualized using lightbulb icons, with the size of each bulb representing the number of patents received.  The exact values of patents per company are presented above each lightbulb.

info.title: UK Ice Cream: Gains and Losses by Category
info.description: This infographic presents the gains and losses in take-home value share of various ice cream categories in the UK as of November 8, 2015. It displays the change on the previous year using ice cream cone icons to represent the change in sales. Additionally, it shows the sector value for each ice cream category using circles of varying sizes.

info.title: UK Hard Surface Cleaners: Gains and Losses
info.description: The infographic presents the gains and losses in total spend change on previous year for various types of UK hard surface cleaners, including hand wipes, powder, mousse, cream, gel, erasers, liquid, and sprays.  It also shows spend, spend per buyer, volume (packs), and average pack price of hand wipes.

info.title: Top five confectionery formats
info.description: This infographic shows the top five confectionery formats ranked by growth in UK sales for the 52 weeks ending April 24, 2016. It visualizes revenue and growth percentages for different confectionery types.

info.title: Bewildering Causes of Death in the US
info.description: An infographic showing various causes of death in the US, comparing the number of deaths caused by different unusual factors.

info.title: Mexico More Obese Than USA
info.description: This infographic compares the obesity rate of Mexico with other countries, highlighting the causes and consequences of obesity in Mexico.

info.title: Landing on the Moon: Successful Moon Lander and Impactor Missions by Country
info.description: This infographic presents a horizontal bar chart visualizing the number of successful moon lander and impactor missions by country. The chart displays the data for United States, USSR, China, India, and Japan, differentiating between lander and impactor missions using color-coded bars (yellow for lander, red for impactor). The data is current as of January 22, 2024, and excludes impacts resulting from mission failures and the final stage of orbiter missions.

info.title: The evolution of Meta's LLaMa
info.description: This infographic visualizes the evolution of Meta's LLaMa large language model, including its different versions, parameter counts, and training costs. The infographic compares different sizes of the models and mentions parameter numbers and when each was released, and a total cost to train the latest model.

info.title: The Most Popular Generative AI Tools
info.description: An infographic showing the top 15 generative AI tools based on web traffic in March 2024. It uses circles of varying sizes to represent the number of visits for each tool, with ChatGPT having the highest number of visits.

info.title: The Fall in America's Working Hours
info.description: This infographic illustrates the trend of average weekly hours worked by private employees in the U.S. from 2006 to 2025, highlighting a decline, especially comparing pre-pandemic levels to 2025 data. It visually represents the fluctuation in working hours, including a noticeable drop during the recession and the impact of the pandemic. The design incorporates an illustration of a person walking down stairs to represent the falling trend.

info.title: Winning the AI Race: Top 10 Countries by AI Startup Numbers
info.description: An infographic illustrating the top 10 countries with the highest number of AI startups, along with their private investment amounts, between 2013 and 2022. The data is presented using a skyscraper metaphor where each 'floor' of the building represents 50 startups. The infographic also mentions that the US has invested 1.9 times more in AI companies than China and the EU combined since 2013.

info.title: AI Ecosystem: Interconnected Layers
info.description: The infographic illustrates the interconnected layers of the AI ecosystem, starting from Artificial Intelligence and narrowing down to more specific subfields like Machine Learning, Neural Networks, Deep Learning, and Generative AI. Each layer is represented by a concentric sphere-like object, with corresponding sub-components listed beside each sphere.

info.title: Humanoid Robots 2024 Comparison
info.description: This infographic compares the physical characteristics and specifications of various humanoid robots, including height, weight, and speed. It features a height comparison using a scale, robot images, and key metrics for each model.

info.title: AI and Machine Learning in the Enterprise
info.description: This infographic presents data from a survey of 234 IT professionals regarding their experience with AI and machine learning in the enterprise. It covers awareness, personal experience, company plans for implementation, and top use cases.

info.title: Is Cable TV Still Worth It?
info.description: This infographic compares the total monthly cost of ad-free streaming services versus the average cable package, showing that they both cost $79.

info.title: India's Top Telecom Companies
info.description: Infographic showing the top telecom companies in India based on total users. It presents data for Jio, Airtel, VI, and BSNL, with each company's user base represented by a curved bar. The curved bars visually represent the user base count for each company, with Jio having the largest user base and BSNL having the smallest.

info.title: Pointing the Finger: Iran-Contra Affair Chain of Command
info.description: This infographic depicts the chain of command in the Iran-Contra affair, highlighting the roles and responsibilities of key figures like Oliver North, Robert McFarlane, John Poindexter, and Ronald Reagan. It uses a visual flow to show how the events unfolded, including trading arms for hostages, diverting funds, arming the contras, and the subsequent cover-up.

info.title: Halloween Spending by Adults
info.description: This infographic visualizes how adults plan to spend money and celebrate Halloween. It includes statistics on spending, popular activities, and preferred shopping locations for Halloween-related items.

info.title: Slices of the Pie: Pizza Chain Comparison
info.description: This infographic visualizes the market share and number of locations for various pizza chains in the U.S. The graphic employs a pizza pie as a backdrop, with pepperoni circles representing the number of locations. A horizontal bar chart compares the 2014 sales in billions of dollars for each chain. It focuses on Sbarro's planned comeback and how it stacks up against the top competitors.

info.title: A Day in the Life: Average Time Spent by Americans in 2014 vs. 2004
info.description: The infographic visualizes the average time Americans spent per daily activity in 2014 compared to 2004. It uses a pixelated human figure as the base, with different body parts representing various activities. The color of the pixels indicates whether the time spent on an activity increased, decreased, or remained the same between the two years. The actual time in hours and minutes is also displayed for each activity.

info.title: Price Check: Comparing Prices in Brazil and the U.S.
info.description: This infographic compares the prices of various items and Alibaba's annual revenue in Brazil and the U.S. It highlights the difference in store prices between the two countries, showing that prices are generally higher in Brazil. It also displays the monthly unique visitors in Brazil to AliExpress and Alibaba's annual revenue in China and internationally.

info.title: US Beer Sales Market Share
info.description: This infographic illustrates the total US beer sales by dollars, presenting market share percentages for Anheuser-Busch InBev, Modelo, MillerCoors, Heineken, and other brands. The percentages are visually represented by the relative areas occupied by each brand within a beer bottle shape.

info.title: Toyota Payout Costs Breakdown
info.description: An infographic illustrating the breakdown of costs associated with a tentative deal covering losses related to used car value, installation of new safety gear, and extension of warranties. The costs are segmented into several categories, each with corresponding descriptions and amounts.

info.title: Profit Leverage: Safeway, IBM, and Autonation
info.description: The infographic illustrates how share buybacks influence earnings per share (EPS) by comparing the number of outstanding shares and profit gains for Safeway, IBM, and Autonation. It utilizes a balance scale metaphor to visually represent the relationship between shares outstanding and EPS gains.

info.title: Small Screen, Small Price: Mobile Ad Costs vs. Other Outlets
info.description: This infographic compares the cost-effectiveness of advertising on mobile devices to other media channels like TV, online, and print. It highlights the relatively lower cost of mobile ads compared to traditional outlets, showcasing the average ad rates and U.S. ad spending distribution across different media.

info.title: NJ Transit Bus Delays
info.description: This infographic illustrates the percentage of New Jersey Transit buses that leave more than 5 minutes late from the Port Authority Bus Terminal to New Jersey during the evening commute. It compares the delay rates for specific bus routes (161 and 193) and the average for all routes, across the years 2010, 2011, and 2012.

info.title: Checking Out: Sales at Grocers
info.description: Infographic illustrating the financial performance of major grocery store chains, including their fiscal year sales, sales change from 2011, and 52-week stock performance. The infographic uses a shopping cart as a visual metaphor, positioning financial data within it.

info.title: Piecing Together BlackBerry Technology
info.description: This infographic illustrates the various technologies used in the new BlackBerry phone and highlights whether they were acquired or licensed from other companies. It uses a puzzle piece metaphor, with each piece representing a different component or feature of the phone.

info.title: Tobacco Tolls: Cigarette Excise Taxes in Select States
info.description: The infographic visualizes cigarette excise taxes across several states, represented by a cigarette graphic. The cigarette is divided into segments, with each segment corresponding to the excise tax rate in a particular state. The length of the segment corresponds to the tax amount. The proposed increase in California is also highlighted.

info.title: Crop Shrinkage: Global Wheat Production Decline
info.description: The infographic illustrates the decline in global wheat production for the U.S. Department of Agriculture's forecast in 2012-13, showing significant drops in major exporting countries and the European Union. Production values are presented in million metric tons for Argentina, Australia, E.U., Kazakhstan, Russia, and the U.S., with percentage changes from the previous year.

info.title: Anheuser-Busch InBev and SABMiller Market Share in 2014
info.description: This infographic shows Anheuser-Busch InBev and SABMiller market share by region in 2014, along with global market share, beer volume sales by region, and top-selling brands.

info.title: Who's Buying Luxury Goods?
info.description: This infographic analyzes the luxury goods market, focusing on sales trends in the U.S. It compares top luxury brands, tracks sales increases in accessories, jewelry, and apparel, and identifies key countries contributing to these sales.

info.title: How Big Are Music Festivals?
info.description: This infographic visualizes data related to music festivals in the U.S., including attendance, popular festivals by location, fan demographics, and sponsoring companies.

info.title: Smooth Sales: Online Men's Razor and Blade Market
info.description: The infographic shows the growth of the online men's razor and blade market in the U.S. from 2013 to 2015. Sales figures for each year are displayed within a visual representation of shaving cream and a razor.

info.title: Canadian Fur Trade: A History
info.description: This infographic illustrates the history and economics of the Canadian fur trade, focusing on the types of animals hunted for their pelts, their value, and the geographic distribution of these animals in Canada. It also provides a historical timeline of beaver pelt values and significant events impacting the fur trade.

info.title: Nuclear Energy Around the World
info.description: The infographic shows the share of nuclear energy in total energy generation by country in 2023. The visualization is a modified bar chart using nuclear reactor images with flags to represent each country.

info.title: Greenhouse Gas Contributions to Warming
info.description: This infographic shows the contributions of different greenhouse gases to the warming effect from the pre-industrial era to 2021. It visually represents the percentage contribution of each gas, including carbon dioxide, methane, CFCs, N2O, HCFCs, and HFCs.

info.title: Typical Turf Heights
info.description: An infographic showing the typical heights of turf (grass) in different contexts, such as home lawns, baseball infields, Superbowl fields, tennis courts, and putting greens. The height is represented in both centimeters and inches.

info.title: Music Feature Visualization
info.description: The infographic visualizes several music features (Acousticness, Loudness, Energy, Danceability, Tempo, Valence) in a flower-like structure. Each petal represents a different attribute. The flowers are arranged irregularly, suggesting a garden or artistic display.

info.title: Classification of Cheese Based on Animal Source and Texture
info.description: This infographic visually classifies cheese based on the animal from which the milk is derived (cow, sheep, goat, buffalo) and its texture (soft, semi-soft, semi-hard). It uses a radial chart to represent the relationships.

info.title: The Top 10 Rarest UK 50p Coins
info.description: An infographic displaying the top 10 rarest UK 50p coins, ranked by their mintage numbers. The coins are visually represented with their images and stacks of coins to show their mintage numbers.

info.title: Weekly Uncrustable Consumption Across the NFL
info.description: This infographic visualizes the weekly consumption of Uncrustables (a type of sandwich) by NFL teams. Each team's logo is displayed above a number representing the quantity of Uncrustables consumed, with a pile of Uncrustable images illustrating the amount (1 image equals 10 Uncrustables).

info.title: Aircraft Connectivity and Inflight WiFi
info.description: An infographic illustrating the increasing number of aircraft with connectivity from 2010 to 2014, and a detailed explanation of how inflight WiFi works, including the signal path from passenger devices to the internet and back. It also showcases onboard applications that utilize inflight WiFi.

info.title: Airbus Performance Overview
info.description: This infographic provides a brief overview of Airbus's performance, focusing on export credit agency support as a percentage of deliveries, the revenue share of its passenger jet division, and the commercial aircraft order backlog compared to Boeing.

info.title: The Rise Of The Gluten-Free Diet
info.description: This infographic shows the percentage of Americans on a gluten-free diet with or without celiac disease from 2009-2014. It distinguishes between people without celiac disease avoiding gluten (PWAG), undiagnosed celiac disease, and diagnosed celiac disease.

info.title: The World's Most Generous Countries In 2016
info.description: The infographic shows the percentage of people who donated money to charity in the past month in different countries in 2016. The countries are ranked from highest to lowest percentage.

info.title: Coachella vs. Other Music Festivals: Price Paid Per Band (2015)
info.description: This infographic compares the price paid per band at Coachella to that of other music festivals in 2015. The diameter of each record visual represents the price per artist.

info.title: The Highest-Paying Companies in America in 2016
info.description: This infographic displays the median total compensation at U.S. companies in 2016, ranking the top 10 highest-paying companies according to data from Glassdoor.

info.title: The Worst Countries For Road Traffic Fatalities
info.description: This infographic illustrates the countries with the highest road traffic fatalities per 100,000 inhabitants in 2013. It features a horizontal bar chart comparing the number of road deaths in different countries. Libya has the highest fatalities, with 73.4 road deaths per 100,000 inhabitants.

info.title: Gender Representation Behind the Scenes in Hollywood
info.description: This infographic shows a bar chart comparing the gender representation of behind-the-scenes personnel (directors, writers, producers, etc.) in the 250 highest-grossing domestic films across the years 1998, 2001, 2005, 2014, and 2015. It highlights the disparity between men and women in these roles.

info.title: Champagne Is Love: Rosé Champagne Imports to the US (2003-2014)
info.description: This infographic illustrates the increasing trend of Rosé Champagne being shipped to the United States from 2003 to 2014. It uses creatively shaped champagne bottles to represent data values on the y-axis.

info.title: The 10 Most Social MLB Fans on Social Media
info.description: An infographic showing the top 10 most social Major League Baseball fanbases on social media platforms like Twitter, Facebook, and Instagram, according to Klear, from July 14th to August 13th, 2015. It includes the number of impressions, mentions, and top age group.

info.title: The Annual Economic Impact Of Global Violence
info.description: This infographic shows the economic impact of violence and conflict to the world economy in trillion U.S. dollars from 2008 to 2014.

info.title: Global Arms Sales Share by Country in 2014
info.description: This infographic displays the global share of arms sales by companies in various countries for the year 2014, excluding China. It uses a bar chart to show the percentage of arms sales for each country, with the United States leading by a significant margin. The image also includes a graphical element (gun) to represent the topic.

info.title: U.S. Prison Escapes (1993-2013)
info.description: The infographic shows the number of inmates that went AWOL/escaped from U.S. State Institutions between 1993 and 2013. It uses a line chart to display the trend, which shows a steep decline in prison escapes over the specified period.

info.title: US Craft Beer Production 2008-2014
info.description: This infographic shows the growth of the U.S. craft beer industry from 2008 to 2014, visualizing the number of operating craft breweries and the barrels of craft beer produced each year.

info.title: The Wealthiest Universities in the United States
info.description: This infographic shows America's top 10 universities by wealth in fiscal year 2014, measured in billions of U.S. dollars. It presents a bar chart comparing the wealth of each university, with Harvard University being the wealthiest.

info.title: Greeks Put In The Longest Working Hours In Europe
info.description: The infographic shows the average weekly working hours in selected EU countries in 2013, highlighting that Greece has the longest working hours.

info.title: Graphic Warnings On Cigarette Packages: A Growing Trend
info.description: This infographic illustrates the growing trend of countries/jurisdictions requiring picture warnings on cigarette packages from 2001 to 2015.  The chart uses cigarette-shaped bars to represent the number of countries, increasing over time.

info.title: Happiness and Age, World, 2012
info.description: This infographic shows a line graph illustrating the relationship between happiness levels and age across the world in 2012. The graph indicates that happiness tends to decrease slightly from young adulthood until around middle age, after which it gradually increases with age.

info.title: North America Food Sales by Category
info.description: This infographic shows the North America sales of different food categories: Salty, Refrigerated, Vegetables/Fruit, and Cookies/Cakes. The total sales are $124B, a 2% increase compared to the previous year.

info.title: Time for a stiff drink: Average number of drinks per capita consumed in the past week, by decile
info.description: This infographic visualizes the average number of alcoholic drinks consumed per capita in the past week, broken down by decile of the American adult population (18+). It highlights the disparity in alcohol consumption, with a significant portion of adults abstaining or consuming very little, while the top decile consumes a disproportionately high amount. The infographic includes textual data describing the overall distribution and the consumption habits of certain segments.

info.title: Skills Assessment
info.description: This infographic presents a skill assessment across various software programs such as Photoshop, Illustrator, Indesign, Dreamweaver, Flash, After Effects, and WordPress. The skill level is indicated using mustaches to symbolize 'a little bit of awesome', ranging from 'Noob' to 'Average' to 'Awesome'.

info.description: This infographic presents cigarette smoking rates around the world, comparing nations with the highest and lowest smoking rates in 2007. It also illustrates the percentage of the world's population that enacts different tobacco control policies.

info.description: This infographic visualizes the popularity of several television shows based on an unspecified metric, possibly social media mentions.
